16.298.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
ṛṣitoyāpaścime tu tatra gavyūtimātrataḥ ..
saṃgāleśvaranāmāsti sarvapātakanāśanaḥ .. 1 ..
16.298.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ऋषितोयापश्चिमे तु तत्र गव्यूतिमात्रतः ..
संगालेश्वरनामास्ति सर्वपातकनाशनः .. 1 ..
16.298.m: Īśvara said: / To the west of the Ṛṣitoyā, at a distance of only a gavyūti, / there is [the liṅga] named Saṃgāleśvara, the destroyer of all sins.

16.298.s:
guptastatra prayāgaśca devo vai mādhavastathā ..
jāhnavī yamunā caiva devī tatra sarasvatī .. 2 ..
16.298.d:
गुप्तस्तत्र प्रयागश्च देवो वै माधवस्तथा ..
जाह्नवी यमुना चैव देवी तत्र सरस्वती .. 2 ..
16.298.m: There is hidden Prayāga, and indeed the god Mādhava, / and the Jāhnavī, the Yamunā, and the goddess Sarasvatī are there.

16.298.s:
anyāni tatra tīrthāni bahūni ca varānane ..
snātvā dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.298.d:
अन्यानि तत्र तीर्थानि बहूनि च वरानने ..
स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 3 ..
16.298.m: Many other sacred fords are there, O fair-faced lady. / Having bathed, having seen, and having worshipped [him], one becomes freed from all sins.

16.298.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
kathaya tvaṃ maheśāna sarvadevanamaskṛta ..
tīrtharājaḥ prayāgastu kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ .. 4 ..
16.298.d:
.. पार्वत्युवाच .. ..
कथय त्वं महेशान सर्वदेवनमस्कृत ..
तीर्थराजः प्रयागस्तु कथं विष्णुः सनातनः .. 4 ..
16.298.m: Pārvatī said: / Tell me, O Maheśāna, worshipped by all gods: / How did Prayāga, the king of sacred fords, how did the eternal Viṣṇu,

16.298.s:
kathaṃ gaṃgā ca yamunā tathā devī sarasvatī ..
anyānyapi bahūnyeva tīrthāni vṛṣabhadhvaja .. 5 ..
16.298.d:
कथं गंगा च यमुना तथा देवी सरस्वती ..
अन्यान्यपि बहून्येव तीर्थानि वृषभध्वज .. 5 ..
16.298.m: and how did the Gaṅgā, the Yamunā, and also the goddess Sarasvatī, / and many other sacred fords as well, O one with the bull on his banner,

16.298.s:
samāyātāni tatraiva saṃgāleśvarasaṃnidhau ..
saṃgāleśeti kiṃ nāma hyetanme vada kautukam .. 6 ..
16.298.d:
समायातानि तत्रैव संगालेश्वरसंनिधौ ..
संगालेशेति किं नाम ह्येतन्मे वद कौतुकम् .. 6 ..
16.298.m: come to that very place, near Saṃgāleśvara? / And what is this name, Saṃgāleśa? Tell me this out of curiosity.

16.298.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
purā vai liṃgapatane sarvadevasamāgame ..
sārdhatritayakoṭīni puṇyāni surasundari .. 7 ..
16.298.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पुरा वै लिंगपतने सर्वदेवसमागमे ..
सार्धत्रितयकोटीनि पुण्यानि सुरसुन्दरि .. 7 ..
16.298.m: Īśvara said: / Formerly, upon the falling of the liṅga, when all the gods assembled, / three and a half crores of sacred [waters], O lovely lady among the gods,

16.298.s:
tīrthāni tīrtharājo'yaṃ prayāgaḥ samupasthitaḥ ..
ātmānaṃ gopayāmāsa tīrthakoṭibhirāvṛtam .. 8 ..
16.298.d:
तीर्थानि तीर्थराजोऽयं प्रयागः समुपस्थितः ..
आत्मानं गोपयामास तीर्थकोटिभिरावृतम् .. 8 ..
16.298.m: Sacred fords: Prayāga, this king of sacred fords, was present there; / he concealed himself, surrounded by crores of sacred fords.

16.298.s:
tatastatra samāyātā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ ..
vibudhāstīrtharājaṃ taṃ dadṛśurdivyacakṣuṣā .. 9 ..
16.298.d:
ततस्तत्र समायाता ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः ..
विबुधास्तीर्थराजं तं ददृशुर्दिव्यचक्षुषा .. 9 ..
16.298.m: Then the gods, led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, arrived there; / with their divine vision they beheld that king of sacred fords,

16.298.s:
tīrthakoṭibhirākīrṇaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ..
liṃgasya patanaṃ śrutvā mahāduḥkhena saṃvṛtāḥ .. 7.1.298.10 ..
16.298.d:
तीर्थकोटिभिराकीर्णं पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ..
लिंगस्य पतनं श्रुत्वा महादुःखेन संवृताः .. 7.1.298.10 ..
16.298.m: Thronged with crores of sacred fords, holy and destroying sins. / Having heard of the falling of the liṅga, overcome with great sorrow,

16.298.s: sthitāḥ sarve tadā devi brahmādyāḥ surasattamāḥ .. 11 ..
16.298.d: स्थिताः सर्वे तदा देवि ब्रह्माद्याः सुरसत्तमाः .. 11 ..
16.298.m: All the foremost gods, led by Brahmā, stood there at that time, O goddess.

16.298.s:
etasminneva kāle tu devo rudraḥ sanātanaḥ ..
nirānaṃdaḥ samāyāto vākyametaduvāca ha .. 12 ..
16.298.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवो रुद्रः सनातनः ..
निरानंदः समायातो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 12 ..
16.298.m: At that very time, however, the eternal god Rudra / arrived, devoid of joy, and spoke these words:

16.298.s:
śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ devā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ ..
ṛṣiśāpānnipatitaṃ mama liṃgamanuttamam ..
tasmālliṃgaṃ pūjayata sarva kāmārthasiddhaye ..13 ..
16.298.d:
शृणुध्वं वचनं देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः ..
ऋषिशापान्निपतितं मम लिंगमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्माल्लिंगं पूजयत सर्व कामार्थसिद्धये ..13 ..
16.298.m: "Listen to my words, O gods led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu! / By the curse of the seers, my unsurpassed liṅga has fallen. / Therefore worship the liṅga for the attainment of all desired aims!"

16.298.s:
evamuktvā mahādevo deśe tasminsthitaḥ priye ..
brāhmaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ raudraṃ tatra kuṇḍatrayaṃ smṛtam .. 14 ..
16.298.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो देशे तस्मिन्स्थितः प्रिये ..
ब्राह्मं च वैष्णवं रौद्रं तत्र कुण्डत्रयं स्मृतम् .. 14 ..
16.298.m: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva remained in that place, O beloved. / A triad of kuṇḍas is remembered there: belonging to Brahmā, to Viṣṇu, and to Rudra.

16.298.s:
caturthaṃ trisaṃgamākhyaṃ nadīnāṃ yatra saṃgamaḥ ..
gaṃgāyāśca sarasvatyāḥ sūryaputryāstathaiva ca .. 15 ..
16.298.d:
चतुर्थं त्रिसंगमाख्यं नदीनां यत्र संगमः ..
गंगायाश्च सरस्वत्याः सूर्यपुत्र्यास्तथैव च .. 15 ..
16.298.m: A fourth is called Trisaṅgama, where there is the confluence of the rivers: / of the Gaṅgā, the Sarasvatī, and the daughter of the sun [Yamunā].

16.298.s:
koṭirekā ca tīrthānāṃ brahmakuṇḍe vyavasthitā ..
tathā ca vaiṣṇave kuṇḍe koṭirekā prakīrtitā .. 16 ..
16.298.d:
कोटिरेका च तीर्थानां ब्रह्मकुण्डे व्यवस्थिता ..
तथा च वैष्णवे कुण्डे कोटिरेका प्रकीर्तिता .. 16 ..
16.298.m: One crore of sacred fords resides in the Brahmakuṇḍa, / and likewise one crore is proclaimed in the Viṣṇukuṇḍa.

16.298.s:
sārdhakoṭistu saṃproktā śivakuṇḍe prakīrtitā ..
paścime brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca pūrve vai vaiṣṇavaṃ smṛtam .. 17 ..
16.298.d:
सार्धकोटिस्तु संप्रोक्ता शिवकुण्डे प्रकीर्तिता ..
पश्चिमे ब्रह्मकुण्डं च पूर्वे वै वैष्णवं स्मृतम् .. 17 ..
16.298.m: One and a half crores are said to be proclaimed in the Śivakuṇḍa. / In the west is Brahmakuṇḍa, and in the east indeed Viṣṇukuṇḍa is remembered,

16.298.s:
madhyabhāge sthitaṃ yacca rudrakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam ..
kuṇḍamadhyādvinirgatya yatra gaṃgā varānane .. 18 ..
16.298.d:
मध्यभागे स्थितं यच्च रुद्रकुण्डं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
कुण्डमध्याद्विनिर्गत्य यत्र गंगा वरानने .. 18 ..
16.298.m: While that which is situated in the middle part is proclaimed as Rudrakuṇḍa. / Emerging from the middle of the kuṇḍas where the Gaṅgā, O fair-faced one,

16.298.s:
sūryaputryā sametā ca tattrisaṃgama ucyate ..
anayoraṃtare sūkṣme tatra guptā sarasvatī .. 19 ..
16.298.d:
सूर्यपुत्र्या समेता च तत्त्रिसंगम उच्यते ..
अनयोरंतरे सूक्ष्मे तत्र गुप्ता सरस्वती .. 19 ..
16.298.m: Unites with the daughter of the sun, that is called Trisaṅgama. / In the subtle space between these two, the Sarasvatī is hidden there.

16.298.s:
eṣu sannihito nityaṃ prayāgastīrthanāyakaḥ ..
atrāgatya naro yastu māghamāse varānane .. 7.1.298.20 ..
16.298.d:
एषु सन्निहितो नित्यं प्रयागस्तीर्थनायकः ..
अत्रागत्य नरो यस्तु माघमासे वरानने .. 7.1.298.20 ..
16.298.m: In these, Prayāga, the lord of sacred fords, is ever present. / Whichever man comes here in the month of Māgha, O fair-faced one,

16.298.s:
snāyātprabhātasamaye makarasthe ravau priye ..
kiñcidabhyudite sūrye śṛṇu tasya ca yatphalam .. 21 ..
16.298.d:
स्नायात्प्रभातसमये मकरस्थे रवौ प्रिये ..
किञ्चिदभ्युदिते सूर्ये शृणु तस्य च यत्फलम् .. 21 ..
16.298.m: And bathes at dawn when the sun is in Capricorn, O beloved, / when the sun has slightly risen—hear the fruit of that!

16.298.s:
ādyenaikena snānena pāpaṃ yanmanasā kṛtam..
vyapohati naraḥ samyakchraddhāyukto jitendriyaḥ .. 22 ..
16.298.d:
आद्येनैकेन स्नानेन पापं यन्मनसा कृतम्..
व्यपोहति नरः सम्यक्छ्रद्धायुक्तो जितेन्द्रियः .. 22 ..
16.298.m: With the first, single ritual ablution, whatever sin has been committed by the mind / a man who is full of faith and has conquered his senses fully wipes away.

16.298.s:
vācikaṃ tu dvitīyena kāyikaṃ tu tṛtīyakāt ..
saṃsargajaṃ caturthena rahasyaṃ pañcamena tu .. 23 ..
16.298.d:
वाचिकं तु द्वितीयेन कायिकं तु तृतीयकात् ..
संसर्गजं चतुर्थेन रहस्यं पञ्चमेन तु .. 23 ..
16.298.m: By the second [he removes] that of speech, and by the third that of the body; / by the fourth, that born of association; by the fifth, secret [sin];

16.298.s: upapātakāni ṣaṣṭhena snānenaiva vyapohati..24..
16.298.d: उपपातकानि षष्ठेन स्नानेनैव व्यपोहति..24..
16.298.m: By the sixth ritual ablution indeed he wipes away secondary sins.

16.298.s:
abhiṣekeṇa kuṇḍānāṃ saptakṛtvo varānane..
mahāṃti caiva pāpāni kṣālyaṃte puruṣaiḥ sadā..25..
16.298.d:
अभिषेकेण कुण्डानां सप्तकृत्वो वरानने..
महांति चैव पापानि क्षाल्यंते पुरुषैः सदा..25..
16.298.m: By an ablution in the kuṇḍas seven times, O fair-faced one, / even great sins are constantly washed away by men.

16.298.s:
yaḥ snāti sakalaṃ māsaṃ prayāge guptasaṃjñake ..
brahmādibhirna tadvaktuṃ śakyate kalpakoṭibhiḥ .. 26 ..
16.298.d:
यः स्नाति सकलं मासं प्रयागे गुप्तसंज्ञके ..
ब्रह्मादिभिर्न तद्वक्तुं शक्यते कल्पकोटिभिः .. 26 ..
16.298.m: Whoever bathes for the entire month at Prayāga called Guptaprayāga, / that cannot be described by Brahmā and the others even in crores of kalpas.

16.298.s:
yāni kāni ca tīrthāni prabhāse saṃti bhāmini ..
tebhyo'tivallabhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 27 ..
16.298.d:
यानि कानि च तीर्थानि प्रभासे संति भामिनि ..
तेभ्योऽतिवल्लभं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 27 ..
16.298.m: Whatever sacred fords there are in Prabhāsa, O passionate lady, / dearer than them all is this sacred ford, which destroys all sins.

16.298.s:
eṣāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya mayā vai tatra mātaraḥ ..
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena naivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 28 ..
16.298.d:
एषां संरक्षणार्थाय मया वै तत्र मातरः ..
पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नेन नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः शुभैः .. 28 ..
16.298.m: For the protection of these, the Mothers must be worshipped there by me with diligence, / with various auspicious food-offerings,

16.298.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ śraddhāyuktena cetasā ..
tāsāmanucarā devi bhūtapretāśca koṭiśaḥ .. 29 ..
16.298.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां श्रद्धायुक्तेन चेतसा ..
तासामनुचरा देवि भूतप्रेताश्च कोटिशः .. 29 ..
16.298.m: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, with a mind full of faith. / Their followers, O goddess, are spirits and ghosts by the crores.

16.298.s:
teṣāṃ bhayavināśāya tā mātṝśca prapūjayet ..
asmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ..7.1.298.30..
16.298.d:
तेषां भयविनाशाय ता मातॄश्च प्रपूजयेत् ..
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति ..7.1.298.30..
16.298.m: To destroy the fear caused by them, one should worship those Mothers. / Having bathed in this sacred ford, a man removes the sin of killing a brahmin.

16.298.s:
yaḥ kaścitkurute śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ ..
uddharecca piturvargaṃ māturvargaṃ narottamaḥ ..31..
16.298.d:
यः कश्चित्कुरुते श्राद्धं पितॄनुद्दिश्य भक्तितः ..
उद्धरेच्च पितुर्वर्गं मातुर्वर्गं नरोत्तमः ..31..
16.298.m: Any best of men who performs a śrāddha dedicated to the ancestors with devotion / delivers the line of his father and the line of his mother.

16.298.s:
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..
evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ tasya phalamanantakam .. 32 ..
16.298.d:
वृषभस्तत्र दातव्यः सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..
एवं यः कुरुते यात्रां तस्य फलमनन्तकम् .. 32 ..
16.298.m: A bull should be given there by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage. / For one who performs the pilgrimage in this manner, the fruit is endless.

16.298.s:
evaṃ guptaprayāgasya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tava ..
śrutvābhinandya puruṣaḥ prāpnuyācchaṃkarālayam .. 33 ..
16.298.d:
एवं गुप्तप्रयागस्य माहात्म्यं कथितं तव ..
श्रुत्वाभिनन्द्य पुरुषः प्राप्नुयाच्छंकरालयम् .. 33 ..
16.298.m: Thus has the māhātmya of Guptaprayāga been narrated to you; / having heard and rejoiced in it, a man attains the abode of Śaṅkara.

16.298.s: iti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye guptaprayā gamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 298 ..
16.298.d: इति श्रीस्कांदेमहापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गुप्तप्रया गमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टनवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 298 ..
16.298.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-eighth chapter, named "Description of the Māhātmya of Guptaprayāga", in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [sub-section] in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.299.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam..
śaṃkhacakragadādhārī mādhavastatra saṃsthitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.299.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम्..
शंखचक्रगदाधारी माधवस्तत्र संस्थितः .. 1 ..
16.299.m: Īśvara said: / Situated on its very southern side, not very far away, / Mādhava, bearing the conch, the discus, and the mace, is stationed there.

16.299.s:
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gaṃdhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānamapunarbhavadāyakam .. 2 ..
16.299.d:
एकादश्यां सिते पक्षे सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या गंधपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
स याति परमं स्थानमपुनर्भवदायकम् .. 2 ..
16.299.m: He who, fasting and with senses conquered on the eleventh day of the bright fortnight, / worships him with devotion with scents, flowers, and ointments, / goes to the supreme state that grants freedom from rebirth.

16.299.s:
atra gāthā purā gītā brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā ..
viṣṇukuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā yo vai mādhavamarcayet ..
sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam .. 3 ..
16.299.d:
अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा ..
विष्णुकुण्डे नरः स्नात्वा यो वै माधवमर्चयेत् ..
स यास्यति परं स्थानं यत्र देवो हरिः स्वयम् .. 3 ..
16.299.m: On this point a verse was sung in ancient times by Brahmā, the creator of the world: / "A man who, having bathed in the Viṣṇukuṇḍa, worships Mādhava, / shall go to the supreme state where the god Hari is himself present."

16.299.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam.. 4 ..
16.299.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं माहात्म्यं विष्णुदैवतम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां सर्वपातकनाशनम्.. 4 ..
16.299.m: All this māhātmya relating to the deity Viṣṇu has been recounted to you; / it grants all desires to men and destroys all sins.

16.299.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mādhavamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navanavatyuttaradvi śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 299 ..
16.299.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये माधवमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवनवत्युत्तरद्वि शततमोऽध्यायः .. 299 ..
16.299.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-ninth chapter, named "Description of the Māhātmya of Mādhava", in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [sub-section] in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.300.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāge kiñcidvāyavyasaṃsthitam ..
saṃgāleśvaranāmāsti sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.300.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे किञ्चिद्वायव्यसंस्थितम् ..
संगालेश्वरनामास्ति सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.300.m: Īśvara said: / On its northern side, situated slightly toward the northwest, / is that named Saṅgāleśvara, destroying all sins.

16.300.s:
tatra brahmā ca viṣṇuśca liṃgasyārādhanodyatau ..
śakraścaiva mahātejā liṃgaṃ pūjitavānpriye .. 2 ..
16.300.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च लिंगस्याराधनोद्यतौ ..
शक्रश्चैव महातेजा लिंगं पूजितवान्प्रिये .. 2 ..
16.300.m: There Brahmā and Viṣṇu were intent upon worship of the liṅga, / and Indra of great splendour worshipped the liṅga, O beloved.

16.300.s:
varuṇo dhanadaścaiva dharmarājo'tha pāvakaḥ ..
ādityairvasubhiścaiva lokapālaiḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 3 ..
16.300.d:
वरुणो धनदश्चैव धर्मराजोऽथ पावकः ..
आदित्यैर्वसुभिश्चैव लोकपालैः समंततः .. 3 ..
16.300.m: Varuṇa, Kubera, Dharmarāja, and Agni, / together with the Ādityas, the Vasus, and the world-protectors on all sides,

16.300.s:
ārādhitaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ saṃgāleśvaranāmabhṛt ..
pūjayitvā tu te sarve dṛṣṭvā māhātmyamuttamam .. 4 ..
16.300.d:
आराधितं महालिंगं संगालेश्वरनामभृत् ..
पूजयित्वा तु ते सर्वे दृष्ट्वा माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .. 4 ..
16.300.m: Worshipped the great liṅga bearing the name Saṅgāleśvara. / Having worshipped it, all of them, seeing its excellent greatness,

16.300.s:
ūcuśca sahasā devi paramānaṃdasaṃyutāḥ ..
devānāṃ nivahairyasmātsamāgatya pratiṣṭhitam ..
saṃgāleśvaranāmāsya bhaviṣyati dharātale .. 5 ..
16.300.d:
ऊचुश्च सहसा देवि परमानंदसंयुताः ..
देवानां निवहैर्यस्मात्समागत्य प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
संगालेश्वरनामास्य भविष्यति धरातले .. 5 ..
16.300.m: Spoke at once, O goddess, filled with supreme bliss: / "Because it was installed having gathered by hosts of gods, / its name on the surface of the earth shall be Saṅgāleśvara."

16.300.s:
saṃgāleśvaranāmānaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
na teṣāmanvaye kaścinnirdhanaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 6 ..
16.300.d:
संगालेश्वरनामानं पूजयिष्यंति मानवाः ..
न तेषामन्वये कश्चिन्निर्धनः संभविष्यति .. 6 ..
16.300.m: Men who will worship the one named Saṅgāleśvara— / no one in their lineage will become poor.

16.300.s:
gosahasrasya dattasya kurukṣetre ca yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti saṃgāleśvaradarśanāt .. 7 ..
16.300.d:
गोसहस्रस्य दत्तस्य कुरुक्षेत्रे च यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति संगालेश्वरदर्शनात् .. 7 ..
16.300.m: Whatever fruit is attained from the giving of a thousand cows at Kurukṣetra, / that fruit one obtains from the darśana of Saṅgāleśvara.

16.300.s:
amāvāsyāṃ ca saṃprāpya snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ..
yaḥ karoti naraḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ roṣavarjitaḥ ..
pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 8 ..
16.300.d:
अमावास्यां च संप्राप्य स्नानं कृत्वा विधानतः ..
यः करोति नरः श्राद्धं पितॄणां रोषवर्जितः ..
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यंति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 8 ..
16.300.m: Reaching the new-moon day, having bathed according to the rules, / whatever man, free from anger, performs a śrāddha for the ancestors, / his ancestors are satisfied until the dissolution of all beings.

16.300.s:
ardhakrośaṃ ca tatkṣetraṃ samaṃtātparimaṇḍalam ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 9 ..
16.300.d:
अर्धक्रोशं च तत्क्षेत्रं समंतात्परिमण्डलम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 9 ..
16.300.m: That sacred field measures half a krośa circular on all sides; / it grants all desires to men and destroys all sins.

16.300.s:
asminkṣetre mahādevi jīvā uttamamadhyamāḥ ..
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptāste'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim ..7.1.300.10...
16.300.d:
अस्मिन्क्षेत्रे महादेवि जीवा उत्तममध्यमाः ..
कालेन निधनं प्राप्तास्तेऽपि यांति परां गतिम् ..7.1.300.10...
16.300.m: In this sacred field, O Great Goddess, creatures superior and mediocre, / having met their end through time, they too attain the supreme state. (7.1.300.10)

16.300.s:
gṛhītvānaśanaṃ ye tu prāṇāṃstyakṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
niścayaṃ te mahādevi līyaṃte parameśvare ..11..
16.300.d:
गृहीत्वानशनं ये तु प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यंति मानवाः ..
निश्चयं ते महादेवि लीयंते परमेश्वरे ..11..
16.300.m: Those men, however, who abandon their life-breaths having undertaken fasting to death, / they surely merge into the Supreme Lord, O Great Goddess. (11)

16.300.s:
gavā hatā dvijahatā ye ca vai daṃṣṭribhirhatā..
ātmano ghātakā ye tu sarpadaṣṭāśca ye mṛtāḥ .. 12 ..
16.300.d:
गवा हता द्विजहता ये च वै दंष्ट्रिभिर्हता..
आत्मनो घातका ये तु सर्पदष्टाश्च ये मृताः .. 12 ..
16.300.m: Those killed by cows, those killed by brahmins, and those killed by tusked animals, / those who committed suicide, and those who died bitten by serpents, (12)

16.300.s:
śayyāyāṃ vigataprāṇā ye ca śaucavivarjitāḥ ..
asmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye apunarbhavadāyake.. 13 ..
16.300.d:
शय्यायां विगतप्राणा ये च शौचविवर्जिताः ..
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे महापुण्ये अपुनर्भवदायके.. 13 ..
16.300.m: those whose life-breaths departed on their bed, and those devoid of purification— / in this supremely meritorious sacred ford which grants non-rebirth, (13)

16.300.s:
dattaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śrāddhairvṛṣotsarge kṛte punaḥ ..
vidhivadbhojitairviprairbhavenmuktirna saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
16.300.d:
दत्तैः षोडशभिः श्राद्धैर्वृषोत्सर्गे कृते पुनः ..
विधिवद्भोजितैर्विप्रैर्भवेन्मुक्तिर्न संशयः .. 14 ..
16.300.m: when the sixteen śrāddhas have been given and a bull released, / and brahmins have been fed according to rule, liberation is attained: there is no doubt. (14)
Having spoken thus, all the gods went to heaven. (15)

16.300.s:
saṃgāleśvaramāhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ tava ..
śrutaṃ harati pāpāni duḥkhaśokāṃstathaiva ca .. 16 ..
16.300.d:
संगालेश्वरमाहात्म्यं संक्षेपात्कथितं तव ..
श्रुतं हरति पापानि दुःखशोकांस्तथैव च .. 16 ..
16.300.m: The māhātmya of Saṅgāleśvara has been recounted to you in brief; / heard, it destroys sins as well as sorrow and grief. (16)

16.300.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 300 ..
16.300.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संगालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 300 ..
16.300.m: Thus ends the three hundredth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Saṅgāleśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (300)

16.301.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi siddheśvaramanuttamam ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.301.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सिद्धेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.301.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O Great Goddess, to the unexcelled Siddheśvara, / situated on its eastern side, not very far away. (1)

16.301.s:
yadā devaiḥ sametyāśu śivaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
saṃgāleśvara nāmāḍhyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham .. 2 ..
16.301.d:
यदा देवैः समेत्याशु शिवलिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
संगालेश्वर नामाढ्यं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् .. 2 ..
16.301.m: When the gods assembled and swiftly consecrated the Śiva-liṅga, / richly named Saṅgāleśvara, auspicious and dispelling all sins, (2)

16.301.s:
tadā siddhagaṇāḥ sarve samārādhya vṛṣadhvajam ..
sthāpayāṃcakrire liṃgaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam .. 3 ..
16.301.d:
तदा सिद्धगणाः सर्वे समाराध्य वृषध्वजम् ..
स्थापयांचक्रिरे लिंगं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. 3 ..
16.301.m: then all the hosts of Siddhas, having propitiated him whose banner bears a bull, / established a liṅga that bestows all perfections, (3)

16.301.s:
tatsiddheśvara nāmāḍhyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ..
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraistadā siddhagaṇāḥ śivam .. 4 ..
16.301.d:
तत्सिद्धेश्वर नामाढ्यं महापातकनाशनम् ..
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैस्तदा सिद्धगणाः शिवम् .. 4 ..
16.301.m: richly named Siddheśvara, the destroyer of great sins. / Then the hosts of Siddhas praised Śiva with various hymns. (4)

16.301.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo yācyatāṃ varamuttamam ..
namaskṛtya tataḥ sarve procuśca śaśiśekharam .. 5 ..
16.301.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो याच्यतां वरमुत्तमम् ..
नमस्कृत्य ततः सर्वे प्रोचुश्च शशिशेखरम् .. 5 ..
16.301.m: Then Mahādeva was pleased: 'Ask for an excellent boon!' / Bowing down, they all then said to the moon-crested Lord: (5)

16.301.s:
ihāgatya naro yastu snātvā ca vidhipūrvakam ..
arcayetsiddhanāthaṃ ca japecca śatarudriyam .. 6 ..
16.301.d:
इहागत्य नरो यस्तु स्नात्वा च विधिपूर्वकम् ..
अर्चयेत्सिद्धनाथं च जपेच्च शतरुद्रियम् .. 6 ..
16.301.m: 'Whoever, coming here and bathing according to the rules, / should worship Siddhanātha and recite the Śatarudrīya, (6)

16.301.s:
aghoraṃ vā japenmantraṃ gāyatryaṃ ca maheśvaram ..
ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇaiva japecca munisattamāḥ ..
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ saṃsiddhiṃ prāpnuyāddhruvam ..7 ..
16.301.d:
अघोरं वा जपेन्मन्त्रं गायत्र्यं च महेश्वरम् ..
षण्मासाभ्यन्तरेणैव जपेच्च मुनिसत्तमाः ..
अणिमादिगुणैश्वर्यं संसिद्धिं प्राप्नुयाद्ध्रुवम् ..7 ..
16.301.m: or should recite the Aghora mantra, or the Gāyatrī to Maheśvara, / and recite it within six months, O best of sages, / he will surely attain perfection and the sovereign power of [siddhis like] minuteness and the rest.' (7)

16.301.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyaṃtardhānaṃ gato haraḥ ..
siddheśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya hyaghoraṃ ca japennaraḥ .. 8 ..
16.301.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा ह्यंतर्धानं गतो हरः ..
सिद्धेश्वरं तु संपूज्य ह्यघोरं च जपेन्नरः .. 8 ..
16.301.m: The Lord said: / Having said, 'So shall it be,' Hara disappeared. / Having worshipped Siddheśvara and recited the Aghora [mantra], (8)

16.301.s:
āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ mahāniśi ..
dhairyamālaṃbya nirbhīkaḥ sa siddhiṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 9 ..
16.301.d:
आश्वयुक्कृष्णपक्षे तु चतुर्दश्यां महानिशि ..
धैर्यमालंब्य निर्भीकः स सिद्धिं प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 9 ..
16.301.m: in the dark fortnight of Āśvina on the fourteenth day at dead of night, / relying on courage, fearless, that person attains perfection. (9)

16.301.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
siddheśvarasya devasya sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 7.1.301.10 ..
16.301.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
सिद्धेश्वरस्य देवस्य सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 7.1.301.10 ..
16.301.m: Thus this sin-destroying māhātmya of god Siddheśvara / that grants the fruit of all desires has been related, O Goddess. (7.1.301.10)

16.301.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikottaratriśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 301 ..
16.301.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोत्तरत्रिशत तमोऽध्यायः .. 301 ..
16.301.m: Thus ends the three hundred and first chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Siddheśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (301)

16.302.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃdharveśvaramuttamam ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam ..1..
16.302.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गंधर्वेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे धनुषां पंचके स्थितम् ..1..
16.302.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O Great Goddess, to the excellent Gandharveśvara, / situated to the north of it, at a distance of five bow-lengths. (1)

16.302.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mahādevi rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ ..
gaṃdharvaiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ snātvā saṃpūjayetsakṛt ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti raktakaṇṭhaśca jāyate .. 2 ..
16.302.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा च महादेवि रूपवाञ्जायते नरः ..
गंधर्वैः स्थापितं लिंगं स्नात्वा संपूजयेत्सकृत् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति रक्तकण्ठश्च जायते .. 2 ..
16.302.m: Beholding it, O Great Goddess, a man becomes handsome. / Bathing and worshipping once the liṅga established by the Gandharvas, / he attains all desires and becomes sweet-voiced. (2)

16.302.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃdharveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 302 ..
16.302.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गंधर्वेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्व्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 302 ..
16.302.m: Thus ends the three hundred and second chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gandharveśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (302)

16.303.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi uttare devamuttamam ..
yastamārādhayeddevaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. .. 1 ..
16.303.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि उत्तरे देवमुत्तमम् ..
यस्तमाराधयेद्देवं महापातकनाशनम् .. .. 1 ..
16.303.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O Great Goddess, to the excellent god in the north. / Whoever propitiates that god, the destroyer of great sins— (1)

16.303.s:
tasyaiva paścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam ..
śeṣādipramukhairnāgairmahatā tapasā yutaiḥ ..
samārādhya mahādevaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam .. 2 ..
16.303.d:
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् ..
शेषादिप्रमुखैर्नागैर्महता तपसा युतैः ..
समाराध्य महादेवं स्थापितं लिंगमुत्तमम् .. 2 ..
16.303.m: situated on its western side, at a distance of three bow-lengths, / the excellent liṅga established by the serpents led by Śeṣa / possessing great austerity, having propitiated Mahādeva— (2)

16.303.s:
yastamārādhayeddevaṃ sarpairārādhitaṃ purā ..
na viṣaṃ kramate dehe tasya janmāvadhi priye .. 3 ..
16.303.d:
यस्तमाराधयेद्देवं सर्पैराराधितं पुरा ..
न विषं क्रमते देहे तस्य जन्मावधि प्रिये .. 3 ..
16.303.m: whoever worships that god formerly worshipped by serpents, / poison does not affect his body for the duration of his life, O dear one. (3)

16.303.s:
sarpāstasya prasīdanti na kuṃthaṃti kadācana ..
tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena talliṃgaṃ pūjayennaraḥ .. 4 ..
16.303.d:
सर्पास्तस्य प्रसीदन्ति न कुंथंति कदाचन ..
तस्मात्सर्वं प्रयत्नेन तल्लिंगं पूजयेन्नरः .. 4 ..
16.303.m: Serpents are pleased with him and never torment him. / Therefore, with all effort, a person should worship that liṅga. (4)

16.303.s:
tatra liṃgānyanekāni ṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitāni tu ..
gaṃgātīre mahāpuṇye paścime varavarṇini .. 5 ..
16.303.d:
तत्र लिंगान्यनेकानि ऋषिभिः स्थापितानि तु ..
गंगातीरे महापुण्ये पश्चिमे वरवर्णिनि .. 5 ..
16.303.m: There are many liṅgas there established by the seers / on the supremely sacred bank of the Gaṅgā to the west, O fair-complexioned lady. (5)

16.303.s:
tāni dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 6 ..
16.303.d:
तानि दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 6 ..
16.303.m: Having seen and worshipped them, a person is freed from all sins / and attains the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices. (6)

16.303.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgāleśvaramāhātmya uttareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 303 ..
16.303.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संगालेश्वरमाहात्म्य उत्तरेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 303 ..
16.303.m: Thus ends the three hundred and third chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Uttareśvara in the Māhātmya of Saṅgāleśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (303)

16.304.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm ..
saṃgāleśādathaiśānyāṃ dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitām.. 1 ..
16.304.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गंगां त्रिपथगामिनीम् ..
संगालेशादथैशान्यां धनुषां सप्तके स्थिताम्.. 1 ..
16.304.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O Great Goddess, to the Gaṅgā that courses through the three paths, / situated to the northeast of Saṅgāleśa at a distance of seven bow-lengths. (1)

16.304.s:
tasyāṃ trinetrā matsyāḥ syurnityamāṃbhasikāḥ priye ..
kalauyuge'pi dṛśyaṃte satyaṃsatyaṃ mayoditam .. 2 ..
16.304.d:
तस्यां त्रिनेत्रा मत्स्याः स्युर्नित्यमांभसिकाः प्रिये ..
कलौयुगेऽपि दृश्यंते सत्यंसत्यं मयोदितम् .. 2 ..
16.304.m: In it there are three-eyed fish, perpetual water-dwellers, O dear one; / they are visible even in the Kali age: it is the truth, the truth that I have spoken. (2)

16.304.s: tasyāṃ snātvā mahādevi mucyate pañcapātakaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.304.d: तस्यां स्नात्वा महादेवि मुच्यते पञ्चपातकैः .. 3 ..
16.304.m: Having bathed in it, O Great Goddess, one is freed from the five [great] sins. (3)

16.304.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismitā girijā satī ..
uvāca taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ pracalaccaṃdraśekharam ..4..
16.304.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मिता गिरिजा सती ..
उवाच तं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रचलच्चंद्रशेखरम् ..4..
16.304.m: Sūta said: / Having heard those words of his, the chaste daughter of the mountain was amazed / and spoke, O best of brahmins, to him who wears the trembling moon on his crest. (4)

16.304.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ tatra samāyātā gaṃgā tripathagāminī ..
kathaṃ trinetrāḥ saṃjātā matsyā āṃbhasikāḥ śiva .. 5 ..
16.304.d:
.. पार्वत्युवाच .. ..
कथं तत्र समायाता गंगा त्रिपथगामिनी ..
कथं त्रिनेत्राः संजाता मत्स्या आंभसिकाः शिव .. 5 ..
16.304.m: Pārvatī said: / How did the Gaṅgā that courses through the three paths arrive there? / How did the aquatic fish come to have three eyes, O Śiva? (5)

16.304.s: etadvistarato brūhi yadyahaṃ te priyā vibho .. 6 ..
16.304.d: एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि यद्यहं ते प्रिया विभो .. 6 ..
16.304.m: Tell this in detail, O All-pervading Lord, if I am dear to you. (6)

16.304.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yadi pṛcchasi māṃ śubhe ..
āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca bhavaṃtīti matirmama .. 7..
16.304.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यदि पृच्छसि मां शुभे ..
आस्तिकाः श्रद्दधानाश्च भवंतीति मतिर्मम .. 7..
16.304.m: The Lord said: / Listen, O Goddess; I will explain if you ask me, O auspicious one. / My thought is that they are faithful and full of faith. (7)

16.304.s:
yadā śapto mahādevo hyajñānatimirāvṛtaiḥ ..
ṛṣibhiḥ kopayuktaiśca kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare .. 8 ..
16.304.d:
यदा शप्तो महादेवो ह्यज्ञानतिमिरावृतैः ..
ऋषिभिः कोपयुक्तैश्च कस्मिंश्चित्कारणांतरे .. 8 ..
16.304.m: When Mahādeva was cursed by the seers shrouded in the darkness of ignorance / and filled with wrath, on account of some underlying cause, (8)

16.304.s:
tadā te munayaḥ sarve śaptaṃ jñātvā maheśvaram ..
nirānaṃdaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā cātmānameva ca .. 9 ..
16.304.d:
तदा ते मुनयः सर्वे शप्तं ज्ञात्वा महेश्वरम् ..
निरानंदं जगत्सर्वं दृष्ट्वा चात्मानमेव च .. 9 ..
16.304.m: then all those sages, knowing Maheśvara to be cursed, / and seeing the entire world and their own selves devoid of joy, (9)

16.304.s:
ārādhya parameśānaṃ dadhataṃ gajarūpakam ..
unnataṃ sthānamānīya sānaṃdaṃ cakrire dvijāḥ .. 7.1.304.10 ..
16.304.d:
आराध्य परमेशानं दधतं गजरूपकम् ..
उन्नतं स्थानमानीय सानंदं चक्रिरे द्विजाः .. 7.1.304.10 ..
16.304.m: propitiated the Supreme Lord who was bearing the form of an elephant; / having led him to an elevated place, the twice-born made it full of joy. (7.1.304.10)

16.304.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti sarve te śivadrohakaraṃ param ..
ātmānaṃ menire nityaṃ prasanne'pi maheśvare .. 11 ..
16.304.d:
ततः प्रभृति सर्वे ते शिवद्रोहकरं परम् ..
आत्मानं मेनिरे नित्यं प्रसन्नेऽपि महेश्वरे .. 11 ..
16.304.m: From then on, they all constantly considered themselves / to be the worst traitors against Śiva, even though Maheśvara was pleased.

16.304.s:
mahodayānmahātīrthaṃ sarva āgatya satvaram ..
tapastepurmahāghoraṃ saṃgāleśvarasannidhau .. 12 ..
16.304.d:
महोदयान्महातीर्थं सर्व आगत्य सत्वरम् ..
तपस्तेपुर्महाघोरं संगालेश्वरसन्निधौ .. 12 ..
16.304.m: They all came swiftly from Mahodaya to the great sacred ford, / and performed fierce austerity near Saṃgāleśvara.

16.304.s:
saṃgāleśvaranāmānaṃ sarve pūjya yathāvidhi ..
bhṛguratristathā maṃkiḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇva eva ca .. 13 ..
16.304.d:
संगालेश्वरनामानं सर्वे पूज्य यथाविधि ..
भृगुरत्रिस्तथा मंकिः कश्यपः कण्व एव च .. 13 ..
16.304.m: Having duly worshipped the [liṅga] named Saṃgāleśvara, / Bhṛgu, Atri, Maṅki, Kaśyapa, and Kaṇva,

16.304.s:
gautamaḥ kauśikaścaiva kuśikaśca mahātapāḥ ..
śūkaro'tha bharadvājo bhārgaviśca mahātapāḥ .. 14 ..
16.304.d:
गौतमः कौशिकश्चैव कुशिकश्च महातपाः ..
शूकरोऽथ भरद्वाजो भार्गविश्च महातपाः .. 14 ..
16.304.m: Gautama, Kauśika, Kuśika of great austerity, / Śūkara, then Bharadvāja, and Bhārgavi of great austerity,

16.304.s:
jātūkarṇyo vasiṣṭhaśca sāvarṇiśca parāśaraḥ ..
śāṃḍilyaśca pulastyaśca vatsaścaiva mahātapāḥ .. 15 ..
16.304.d:
जातूकर्ण्यो वसिष्ठश्च सावर्णिश्च पराशरः ..
शांडिल्यश्च पुलस्त्यश्च वत्सश्चैव महातपाः .. 15 ..
16.304.m: Jātūkarṇya, Vasiṣṭha, Sāvarṇi, Parāśara, / Śāṇḍilya, Pulastya, and Vatsa of great austerity,

16.304.s: ete cānye ca bahavo hyasaṃkhyātā maharṣayaḥ .. 16 ..
16.304.d: एते चान्ये च बहवो ह्यसंख्याता महर्षयः .. 16 ..
16.304.m: these and many other countless great seers,

16.304.s:
saṃgāleśvaramāsādya prabhāse pāpanāśane ..
tapaḥ kurvaṃti satataṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram .. 17 ..
16.304.d:
संगालेश्वरमासाद्य प्रभासे पापनाशने ..
तपः कुर्वंति सततं प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् .. 17 ..
16.304.m: having reached Saṃgāleśvara in sin-destroying Prabhāsa, / constantly performed austerity after installing Maheśvara.

16.304.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā te sarve munipuṃgavāḥ ..
dhyānāttrilocanasyaiva adṛṣṭe tu maheśvare .. 18 ..
16.304.d:
ततः कालेन महता ते सर्वे मुनिपुंगवाः ..
ध्यानात्त्रिलोचनस्यैव अदृष्टे तु महेश्वरे .. 18 ..
16.304.m: Then, after a long time, all those foremost sages, / because of meditating on the Three-eyed Lord though Maheśvara was not visible,

16.304.s:
trinetratvamanuprāptāstaponiṣṭhāstapodhanāḥ ..
parasparaṃ vīkṣamāṇāstrinetrasyābhiśaṃkayā .. 19 ..
16.304.d:
त्रिनेत्रत्वमनुप्राप्तास्तपोनिष्ठास्तपोधनाः ..
परस्परं वीक्षमाणास्त्रिनेत्रस्याभिशंकया .. 19 ..
16.304.m: attained three-eyed state, intent on austerity, rich in austerity. / Looking at one another in the belief that [the other was] the Three-eyed Lord,

16.304.s:
stuvaṃti vividhaiḥ stotrairmanyamānā maheśvaram ..
jñātvā dhyānena devasya trinetratvamupāgatāḥ .. 7.1.304.20 ..
16.304.d:
स्तुवंति विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्मन्यमाना महेश्वरम् ..
ज्ञात्वा ध्यानेन देवस्य त्रिनेत्रत्वमुपागताः .. 7.1.304.20 ..
16.304.m: they praised [one another] with various hymns, thinking each to be Maheśvara. / Knowing through meditation on the god that they had attained three-eyedness,

16.304.s:
cakurugraṃ tapaste tu pūjāṃ devasya śūlinaḥ ..
teṣu vai tapyamāneṣu kṛpāviṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 21 ..
16.304.d:
चकुरुग्रं तपस्ते तु पूजां देवस्य शूलिनः ..
तेषु वै तप्यमानेषु कृपाविष्टो महेश्वरः .. 21 ..
16.304.m: they performed fierce austerity and worship of the trident-bearing god. / As they were performing austerity, Maheśvara was filled with compassion,

16.304.s:
uvāca tānmunīnsarvāñchṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam..
prasanno'haṃ muniśreṣṭhāstapasā pūjayāpi ca .. 22 ..
16.304.d:
उवाच तान्मुनीन्सर्वाञ्छृणुध्वं वरमुत्तमम्..
प्रसन्नोऽहं मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तपसा पूजयापि च .. 22 ..
16.304.m: and said to all those sages: 'Listen to an excellent boon! / Best of sages, I am pleased by your austerity and your worship.'

16.304.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi prasanno deveśa varaṃ no dātumarhasi ..
gaṃgāmānaya vegena hyabhiṣekāya no hara .. 23 ..
16.304.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश वरं नो दातुमर्हसि ..
गंगामानय वेगेन ह्यभिषेकाय नो हर .. 23 ..
16.304.m: The seers said: / 'If you are pleased, Lord of gods, you should grant us a boon: / Bring Gaṅgā swiftly for our ablution, O Hara!

16.304.s:
tasyāṃ kṛtābhiṣekāstu tava drohakarā vayam ..
ajñānabhāvātpūtatvaṃ yāsyāmaḥ pṛthivītale .. 24 .. ..
16.304.d:
तस्यां कृताभिषेकास्तु तव द्रोहकरा वयम् ..
अज्ञानभावात्पूतत्वं यास्यामः पृथिवीतले .. 24 .. ..
16.304.m: Having performed ablution in her, we who committed treason against you / out of ignorance shall attain purity on the surface of the earth.'

16.304.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yūyaṃ pavitrakaraṇāḥ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanāḥ ..
gaṃgāṃ caivānayiṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ cittatuṣṭaye .. 25 ..
16.304.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
यूयं पवित्रकरणाः पावनानां च पावनाः ..
गंगां चैवानयिष्यामि युष्माकं चित्ततुष्टये .. 25 ..
16.304.m: Īśvara said: / 'You are makers of purity, and purifiers of the pure. / I shall indeed bring Gaṅgā for your heart's satisfaction.

16.304.s:
pāvitryādbhavatāṃ jātaṃ trainetryaṃ munisattamāḥ ..
evamuktvā tataḥ śaṃbhurdhyānastimitalocanaḥ ..
sasmāra kṣaṇamātreṇa gaṃgāṃ mīnakulāvṛtām .. 26 ..
16.304.d:
पावित्र्याद्भवतां जातं त्रैनेत्र्यं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततः शंभुर्ध्यानस्तिमितलोचनः ..
सस्मार क्षणमात्रेण गंगां मीनकुलावृताम् .. 26 ..
16.304.m: Your possession of three eyes has arisen from your purity, O best of sages.' / Having spoken thus, Śambhu, his eyes motionless in meditation, / remembered in a mere moment Gaṅgā, crowded with schools of fish.

16.304.s:
smṛtamātrā tadā devī gaṃgā tripathagāminī ..
bhitvā bhūmitalaṃ prāptā tatra mīnakulāvṛtā .. 27 ..
16.304.d:
स्मृतमात्रा तदा देवी गंगा त्रिपथगामिनी ..
भित्वा भूमितलं प्राप्ता तत्र मीनकुलावृता .. 27 ..
16.304.m: As soon as she was remembered, the goddess Gaṅgā, flowing in three streams, / broke through the surface of the earth and arrived there, crowded with schools of fish.

16.304.s:
ṛṣibhiśca yadā dṛṣṭā gaṃgā mīnayutā śubhā ..
dṛṣṭamātrāstu te matsyāstrinetratvamupāgatāḥ .. 28 ..
16.304.d:
ऋषिभिश्च यदा दृष्टा गंगा मीनयुता शुभा ..
दृष्टमात्रास्तु ते मत्स्यास्त्रिनेत्रत्वमुपागताः .. 28 ..
16.304.m: And when the auspicious Gaṅgā accompanied by fish was seen by the seers, / those fish, as soon as they were seen, attained three-eyedness.

16.304.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yuṣmākaṃ darśanādviprāstrinetratvamupāgatāḥ ..
etannidarśanaṃ sarvaṃ lokānāṃ ca pradarśanam .. 29 .. ...
16.304.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
युष्माकं दर्शनाद्विप्रास्त्रिनेत्रत्वमुपागताः ..
एतन्निदर्शनं सर्वं लोकानां च प्रदर्शनम् .. 29 .. ...
16.304.m: Īśvara said: / 'From your darśana, O brahmins, they have attained three-eyedness. / All this is an exemplar and an instruction for the worlds.'

16.304.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
asminkuṃḍe mahādeva matsyānāṃ saṃtatiḥ sadā ..
trinetrā tvatprasādena bhūyātsarvā yugeyuge .. 7.1.304.30 ..
16.304.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अस्मिन्कुंडे महादेव मत्स्यानां संततिः सदा ..
त्रिनेत्रा त्वत्प्रसादेन भूयात्सर्वा युगेयुगे .. 7.1.304.30 ..
16.304.m: The seers said: / 'O Mahādeva, in this pool may the progeny of fish always / be three-eyed in every age by your grace!

16.304.s:
asminkuṃḍe samāgatya naraḥ snānaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
dadāti hema viprāya gāśca vastraṃ tathā tilān .. 31 ..
16.304.d:
अस्मिन्कुंडे समागत्य नरः स्नानं करोति यः ..
ददाति हेम विप्राय गाश्च वस्त्रं तथा तिलान् .. 31 ..
16.304.m: Whatever man comes to this pool and performs a ritual ablution, / gives gold to a brahmin, and cows, cloth, and sesame seeds,

16.304.s:
amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa trinetraḥ sa prajāyatām ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ .. 32 ..
16.304.d:
अमावास्यां विशेषेण त्रिनेत्रः स प्रजायताम् ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा ह्यन्तर्धानं गतो हरः .. 32 ..
16.304.m: especially on the new moon, may he become three-eyed!' / Saying 'So shall it be,' Hara vanished.

16.304.s: brāhmaṇāstuṣṭisaṃyuktā gatāḥ sarve mahodayam .. 33 ..
16.304.d: ब्राह्मणास्तुष्टिसंयुक्ता गताः सर्वे महोदयम् .. 33 ..
16.304.m: The brahmins, filled with satisfaction, all went to Mahodaya.

16.304.s:
etatte kathitaṃ devi gaṃgāmāhātmyamuttamam ..
śrutaṃ pāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 34 ..
16.304.d:
एतत्ते कथितं देवि गंगामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
श्रुतं पापप्रशमनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 34 ..
16.304.m: This excellent māhātmya of Gaṅgā has been told to you, O goddess; / when heard, it pacifies sin and bestows the fruits of all desires.

16.304.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgāleśvarasamīpavarti gaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 304
16.304.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संगालेश्वरसमीपवर्ति गंगामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुरुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 304
16.304.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gaṅgā Situated near Saṃgāleśvara', in the First Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the Seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.305.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasyāḥ pūrveṇa saṃsthitam..
nāradādityanāmānaṃ jarādāridryanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.305.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्याः पूर्वेण संस्थितम्..
नारदादित्यनामानं जरादारिद्र्यनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.305.m: Īśvara said: / 'Then one should go, O great goddess, to the [shrine] situated to the east of her, / named Nāradāditya, which destroys old age and poverty,

16.305.s:
paścime mūlacaṃḍīśāddhanuṣāṃ ca śatatraye ..
ārādhya nārado devi bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram ..
jarā nirmuktadehastu tatkṣaṇātsamapadyata ..2 ..
16.305.d:
पश्चिमे मूलचंडीशाद्धनुषां च शतत्रये ..
आराध्य नारदो देवि भास्करं वारितस्करम् ..
जरा निर्मुक्तदेहस्तु तत्क्षणात्समपद्यत ..2 ..
16.305.m: three hundred bows to the west of Mūlacaṇḍīśa. / Having worshipped the Sun, the stealer of waters, O goddess, / Nārada immediately became one whose body was freed from old age.'

16.305.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ jarāmanuprāpto nārado munipuṃgavaḥ ..
kathamārādhitaḥ sūrya etanme vada śaṃkara .. 3 ..
16.305.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं जरामनुप्राप्तो नारदो मुनिपुंगवः ..
कथमाराधितः सूर्य एतन्मे वद शंकर .. 3 ..
16.305.m: The goddess said: / 'How did Nārada, the foremost sage, come to suffer old age? / How did he worship Sūrya? Tell me this, O Śaṃkara.'

16.305.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yadā dvāravatīṃ prāpto nārado munipuṃgavaḥ ..
sarve dṛṣṭāstadā tena viṣṇoḥ putrā mahābalāḥ .. 4 ..
16.305.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
यदा द्वारवतीं प्राप्तो नारदो मुनिपुंगवः ..
सर्वे दृष्टास्तदा तेन विष्णोः पुत्रा महाबलाः .. 4 ..
16.305.m: Īśvara said: / 'When Nārada, the foremost sage, reached Dvāravatī, / all the mighty sons of Viṣṇu were seen by him then,

16.305.s: tadrājakulamadhye tu krīḍamānā parasparam .. āyāṃtaṃ nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vinayasaṃyutāḥ .. 5 ..
16.305.d: तद्राजकुलमध्ये तु क्रीडमाना परस्परम् .. आयांतं नारदं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे विनयसंयुताः .. 5 ..
16.305.m: playing with one another within the royal court. / Seeing Nārada approaching, all of them, endowed with humility,

16.305.s:
namaścakruryathānyāyaṃ vinā sāṃbaṃ tvarānvitāḥ ..
avinītaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ .. 6 ..
16.305.d:
नमश्चक्रुर्यथान्यायं विना सांबं त्वरान्विताः ..
अविनीतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा कथयामास नारदः .. 6 ..
16.305.m: hastily bowed down according to custom, except Sāmba. / Seeing him impolite, Nārada said:

16.305.s:
śarīramadamatto'si yasmātsāṃba hareḥ suta ..
acireṇaiva kālena śāpaṃ prāpsyasi dāruṇam .. 7..
16.305.d:
शरीरमदमत्तोऽसि यस्मात्सांब हरेः सुत ..
अचिरेणैव कालेन शापं प्राप्स्यसि दारुणम् .. 7..
16.305.m: 'Because you are intoxicated with physical pride, O Sāmba, son of Hari, / in no long time you shall incur a terrible curse.'

16.305.s:
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
namaskāreṇa kiṃ kāryamṛṣīṇāṃ ca jitātmanām..
āśīrvādena teṣāṃ ca tapohāniḥ prajāyate .. 8 ..
16.305.d:
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
नमस्कारेण किं कार्यमृषीणां च जितात्मनाम्..
आशीर्वादेन तेषां च तपोहानिः प्रजायते .. 8 ..
16.305.m: Sāmba said: / 'What need is there of bowing to seers whose minds are conquered? / And from their blessing, loss of austerity arises.

16.305.s:
munīnāṃ yaḥ svabhāvo hi tvayi leśo na nārada ..
vidyate brahmaṇaḥ putra ucyate kimataḥ param.. 9 ..
16.305.d:
मुनीनां यः स्वभावो हि त्वयि लेशो न नारद ..
विद्यते ब्रह्मणः पुत्र उच्यते किमतः परम्.. 9 ..
16.305.m: That which is the true nature of sages is not found in you in the least, O Nārada, / son of Brahmā! What more need be said than this?

16.305.s:
na kalatraṃ na te putrā na ca pautraprapautrakāḥ ..
na gṛhaṃ naiva ca dvāraṃ na hi gāvo na vatsakāḥ .. 7.1.305.10 ..
16.305.d:
न कलत्रं न ते पुत्रा न च पौत्रप्रपौत्रकाः ..
न गृहं नैव च द्वारं न हि गावो न वत्सकाः .. 7.1.305.10 ..
16.305.m: You have no wife, no sons, no grandsons or great-grandsons, / no house, no doorway, no cows and no calves.

16.305.s:
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro brahmacarye vyavasthitaḥ ..
ayuktaṃ kurute nityaṃ kasmātprakṛtirīdṛśī .. 11 ..
16.305.d:
ब्रह्मणो मानसः पुत्रो ब्रह्मचर्ये व्यवस्थितः ..
अयुक्तं कुरुते नित्यं कस्मात्प्रकृतिरीदृशी .. 11 ..
16.305.m: Mind-born son of Brahmā, established in celibacy, / he constantly acts improperly; why is such your nature?

16.305.s:
yuddhaṃ vinā na te saukhyaṃ saukhyaṃ na kalahaṃ vinā ..
yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi vāgvādo'pi sadā priyaḥ .. 12 ..
16.305.d:
युद्धं विना न ते सौख्यं सौख्यं न कलहं विना ..
यादृशस्तादृशो वापि वाग्वादोऽपि सदा प्रियः .. 12 ..
16.305.m: Without battle you have no pleasure, no pleasure without quarrel; / of whatever sort it may be, even verbal dispute is always dear to you.

16.305.s:
snānaṃ saṃdhyā japo homastarpaṇaṃ pitṛdevayoḥ ..
nāradaḥ kurute cānyadanyatkurvaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ .. 13 ..
16.305.d:
स्नानं संध्या जपो होमस्तर्पणं पितृदेवयोः ..
नारदः कुरुते चान्यदन्यत्कुर्वंति ब्राह्मणाः .. 13 ..
16.305.m: Ablution, twilight prayer, recitation, oblations, libation to ancestors and gods: / Nārada does one thing, while [other] brahmins do another.

16.305.s:
kaumāreṇa tu garviṣṭho yasmānmāṃ śāpayiṣyasi ..
tasmāttvamapi viprarṣe jarāyukto bhaviṣyasi .. 14 ..
16.305.d:
कौमारेण तु गर्विष्ठो यस्मान्मां शापयिष्यसि ..
तस्मात्त्वमपि विप्रर्षे जरायुक्तो भविष्यसि .. 14 ..
16.305.m: Because, arrogant with youth, you would curse me, / therefore you too, O brahmin seer, shall become afflicted with old age.'

16.305.s:
evaṃ śaptastadā devi nārado munipuṃgavaḥ ..
ekānte nirmale sthāne kaṃṭakāsthivivarjite .. 15 ..
16.305.d:
एवं शप्तस्तदा देवि नारदो मुनिपुंगवः ..
एकान्ते निर्मले स्थाने कंटकास्थिविवर्जिते .. 15 ..
16.305.m: Thus cursed then, O goddess, Nārada, the foremost sage, / in a solitary, pure place devoid of thorns and bones,

16.305.s:
kṛṣṇājinaparicchinne hyupaviṣṭo varāsane ..
ṛṣitoyā taṭe ramye pratiṣṭhāpya mahāmuniḥ .. 16 ..
16.305.d:
कृष्णाजिनपरिच्छिन्ने ह्युपविष्टो वरासने ..
ऋषितोया तटे रम्ये प्रतिष्ठाप्य महामुनिः .. 16 ..
16.305.m: sat upon an excellent seat covered with a black antelope skin. / Having installed on the charming bank of the Ṛṣitoyā, the great sage,

16.305.s:
sūryasya pratimāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadāridryanāśinīm ..
tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stotrairādityaṃ timirāpaham .. 17 ..
16.305.d:
सूर्यस्य प्रतिमां रम्यां सर्वदारिद्र्यनाशिनीम् ..
तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तोत्रैरादित्यं तिमिरापहम् .. 17 ..
16.305.m: a charming image of the Sun that destroys all poverty, / praised Āditya, the dispeller of darkness, with various hymns.

16.305.s:
namasta ṛksvarūpāya sāmnāṃ dhāmaga te namaḥ ..
jñānaikarūpadehāya nirdhūtatamase namaḥ .. 18 ..
16.305.d:
नमस्त ऋक्स्वरूपाय साम्नां धामग ते नमः ..
ज्ञानैकरूपदेहाय निर्धूततमसे नमः .. 18 ..
16.305.m: Homage to you whose nature is the Ṛg[veda], to you who dwell in the realm of the Sāman chants, homage! / Homage to you whose body consists of pure knowledge, who have shaken off darkness!

16.305.s:
śuddhajyotiḥsvarūpāya nirmūrtāyāmalātmane ..
variṣṭhāya vareṇyāya sarvasmai paramātmane .. 19 ..
16.305.d:
शुद्धज्योतिःस्वरूपाय निर्मूर्तायामलात्मने ..
वरिष्ठाय वरेण्याय सर्वस्मै परमात्मने .. 19 ..
16.305.m: To the one whose form is pure radiance, who is formless, the spotless self, / the highest, the most desirable, the all, the supreme self;

16.305.s:
namo'khilajagadvyāpisvarūpānaṃdamūrtaye ..
sarvakāraṇapūtāya niṣṭhāyai jñānacetasām .. 7.1.305.20 ..
16.305.d:
नमोऽखिलजगद्व्यापिस्वरूपानंदमूर्तये ..
सर्वकारणपूताय निष्ठायै ज्ञानचेतसाम् .. 7.1.305.20 ..
16.305.m: Homage to the embodiment of bliss whose form pervades the entire universe, / who is purified by all causes, the foundation of those of discerning mind!

16.305.s:
namaḥ sarvasvarūpāya prakāśālakṣyarūpiṇe ..
bhāskarāya namastubhyaṃ tathā dinakṛte namaḥ .. 21 ..
16.305.d:
नमः सर्वस्वरूपाय प्रकाशालक्ष्यरूपिणे ..
भास्कराय नमस्तुभ्यं तथा दिनकृते नमः .. 21 ..
16.305.m: Homage to the one whose form is everything, whose appearance is unseen radiance! / Homage to you, Bhāskara; likewise homage to the Maker of Day!

16.305.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saṃstuvatastasya puratastasya cetasā ..
prādurbabhūva deveśi jagaccakṣuḥ sanātanaḥ ..
uvāca paramaṃ prīto nāradaṃ munipuṃgavam .. 22 ..
16.305.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं संस्तुवतस्तस्य पुरतस्तस्य चेतसा ..
प्रादुर्बभूव देवेशि जगच्चक्षुः सनातनः ..
उवाच परमं प्रीतो नारदं मुनिपुंगवम् .. 22 ..
16.305.m: Īśvara said: / While he was praising thus, O goddess of gods, before him in his mind / the eternal Eye of the World became manifest. / Extremely pleased, he spoke to Nārada, the best of sages:

16.305.s:
.. sūrya uvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya viprarṣe yaste manasi vartate ..
tuṣṭo'haṃ tava dāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 23 ..
16.305.d:
.. सूर्य उवाच .. ..
वरं वरय विप्रर्षे यस्ते मनसि वर्तते ..
तुष्टोऽहं तव दास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 23 ..
16.305.m: Sūrya said: / Choose a boon, O brahmin seer, whatever is in your heart; / pleased as I am, I will grant it to you, even if it is exceedingly difficult to obtain.

16.305.s:
.. nārada uvāca ..
kumāra vayasā yukto jarāyuktakalevaraḥ ..
prasādātsyāṃ hi te deva yadi tuṣṭo divākara .. 24 ..
16.305.d:
.. नारद उवाच ..
कुमार वयसा युक्तो जरायुक्तकलेवरः ..
प्रसादात्स्यां हि ते देव यदि तुष्टो दिवाकर .. 24 ..
16.305.m: Nārada said: / O God, O Maker of Day, if you are pleased, by your grace / may I possess the youth of a boy, though my body is worn with old age.

16.305.s:
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa yastvāṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
tasya roga bhayaṃ mā'stu prasādāttimirāpaha.. 25 ..
16.305.d:
सप्तम्यां रविवारेण यस्त्वां पश्यति मानवः ..
तस्य रोग भयं माऽस्तु प्रसादात्तिमिरापह.. 25 ..
16.305.m: Whatever man beholds you on a Sunday that is a seventh lunar day, / may he have no fear of disease by your grace, O dispeller of darkness!

16.305.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyantardhānaṃ gato raviḥ ..
ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sakalaṃ tava ..
nāradādityadevasya sarvapātakanāśanam.. 26 ..
16.305.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा ह्यन्तर्धानं गतो रविः ..
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं सकलं तव ..
नारदादित्यदेवस्य सर्वपातकनाशनम्.. 26 ..
16.305.m: Īśvara said: / Saying, “So shall it be,” the sun vanished. / Thus has been recounted to you, O goddess, the entire māhātmya / of the deity Nāradāditya, which destroys all sins.

16.305.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāradādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 305 ..
16.305.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नारदादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 305 ..
16.305.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fifth chapter, titled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Nāradāditya,” in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [part] of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.306.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sāṃbādityamanuttamam ..
tasmāduttarabhāge tu sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.306.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सांबादित्यमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्मादुत्तरभागे तु सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.306.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed Sāmbāditya, / situated north of that, which destroys all sins;

16.306.s:
yatra sāṃbastapastaptvā hyārādhya ca divākaram ..
prāptavānsundaraṃ dehaṃ sahasrāṃśuprasādataḥ .. 2 ..
16.306.d:
यत्र सांबस्तपस्तप्त्वा ह्याराध्य च दिवाकरम् ..
प्राप्तवान्सुन्दरं देहं सहस्रांशुप्रसादतः .. 2 ..
16.306.m: Where Sāmba, having performed austerity and worshipped the Maker of Day, / attained a beautiful body through the grace of the thousand-rayed sun.

16.306.s:
yadā roṣeṇa saṃśaptaḥ pitrā jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ..
ārādhayāmāsa tadā viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanam .. 3 ..
16.306.d:
यदा रोषेण संशप्तः पित्रा जांबवतीसुतः ..
आराधयामास तदा विष्णुं कमललोचनम् .. 3 ..
16.306.m: When cursed in anger by his father, Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, / then worshipped Viṣṇu, whose eyes are like lotus petals.

16.306.s:
anugrahārthaṃ śāpasya sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ..
prasannavadano bhūtvā viṣṇuḥ provāca taṃ prati .. 4 ..
16.306.d:
अनुग्रहार्थं शापस्य सांबो जांबवतीसुतः ..
प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा विष्णुः प्रोवाच तं प्रति .. 4 ..
16.306.m: To show favor regarding the curse upon Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, / Viṣṇu, with a benevolent countenance, spoke to him:

16.306.s:
gaccha prābhāsike kṣetre brahmabhāgamanuttamam ..
ṛṣitoyātaṭe ramye brāhmaṇairupaśobhite .. 5 ..
16.306.d:
गच्छ प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे ब्रह्मभागमनुत्तमम् ..
ऋषितोयातटे रम्ये ब्राह्मणैरुपशोभिते .. 5 ..
16.306.m: “Go to the Prabhāsa kṣetra, to the unsurpassed share of Brahmā / on the delightful bank of the Ṛṣitoyā, adorned by brahmins;

16.306.s:
tatrā'haṃ sūryarūpeṇa varaṃ dāsyāmi putraka ..
ityuktaḥ sa tadā sāṃbo viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā .. 6 ..
16.306.d:
तत्राऽहं सूर्यरूपेण वरं दास्यामि पुत्रक ..
इत्युक्तः स तदा सांबो विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना .. 6 ..
16.306.m: There, in the form of Sūrya, I will bestow a boon, my son.” / Addressed thus at that time by the mighty Viṣṇu,

16.306.s:
gataḥ prābhāsike kṣetre ramye śivapure śive ..
tatrārādhya paraṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram .. 7 ..
16.306.d:
गतः प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे रम्ये शिवपुरे शिवे ..
तत्राराध्य परं देवं भास्करं वारितस्करम् .. 7 ..
16.306.m: he went to the Prabhāsa kṣetra, to the delightful, auspicious Śivapura. / There, having worshipped the supreme deity, the sun, the stealer of waters,

16.306.s: prasādayāmāsa tadā stutvā stotrairanekadhā .. 8 ..
16.306.d: प्रसादयामास तदा स्तुत्वा स्तोत्रैरनेकधा .. 8 ..
16.306.m: he propitiated him then, praising him with various hymns.

16.306.s:
pratyuvāca raviḥ sāṃbaṃ prasannaste stavena vai ..
śīghraṃ gaccha naraśreṣṭha ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe .. 9 ..
16.306.d:
प्रत्युवाच रविः सांबं प्रसन्नस्ते स्तवेन वै ..
शीघ्रं गच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ ऋषितोयातटे शुभे .. 9 ..
16.306.m: Ravi replied to Sāmba: “I am pleased with your hymn indeed; / go quickly, O best of men, to the auspicious bank of the Ṛṣitoyā.”

16.306.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā''gatya ṛṣitoyātaṭaṃ śubham ..
nārado yatra brahmarṣistapastapyati caiva hi .. 7.1.306.10 ..
16.306.d:
इत्युक्तः स तदा'ऽगत्य ऋषितोयातटं शुभम् ..
नारदो यत्र ब्रह्मर्षिस्तपस्तप्यति चैव हि .. 7.1.306.10 ..
16.306.m: Addressed thus, he then went to the auspicious bank of the Ṛṣitoyā, / where the brahmin seer Nārada was performing austerity.

16.306.s:
tatra gatvā hareḥ sūnurunnatasthānavāsinaḥ ..
āsanye brāhmaṇāstānsa idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 11 ..
16.306.d:
तत्र गत्वा हरेः सूनुरुन्नतस्थानवासिनः ..
आसन्ये ब्राह्मणास्तान्स इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 11 ..
16.306.m: Having gone there, the son of Hari said these words / to those brahmins who were residents of the elevated place:

16.306.s:
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
eṣa vai brahmaṇo bhāgaḥ prabhāse kṣetra uttame ..
atra vai brāhmaṇā ye tu te vai śreṣṭhāḥ smṛtā bhuvi .. 12 ..
16.306.d:
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
एष वै ब्रह्मणो भागः प्रभासे क्षेत्र उत्तमे ..
अत्र वै ब्राह्मणा ये तु ते वै श्रेष्ठाः स्मृता भुवि .. 12 ..
16.306.m: Sāmba said: / “This indeed is the share of Brahmā in the excellent kṣetra of Prabhāsa; / those who are brahmins here are considered the foremost on earth.

16.306.s:
bhavatāṃ vacanādviprāḥ sūryamārādhayāmyaham ..
mama vai pūrvamādiṣṭaṃ sthānametacca viṣṇunā .. 13 ..
16.306.d:
भवतां वचनाद्विप्राः सूर्यमाराधयाम्यहम् ..
मम वै पूर्वमादिष्टं स्थानमेतच्च विष्णुना .. 13 ..
16.306.m: At your word, O brahmins, I will worship the sun; / this place was previously indicated to me indeed by Viṣṇu.”

16.306.s:
.. viprā ūcuḥ .. ..
siddhiste bhavitā sāṃba ārādhaya divākaram ..
ityuktaḥ sa tadā vipraiḥ praviṣṭo'tha prabhākaram.. 14 ..
16.306.d:
.. विप्रा ऊचुः .. ..
सिद्धिस्ते भविता सांब आराधय दिवाकरम् ..
इत्युक्तः स तदा विप्रैः प्रविष्टोऽथ प्रभाकरम्.. 14 ..
16.306.m: The brahmins said: / “You will attain success, O Sāmba! Worship the Maker of Day.” / Thus spoken to by the brahmins, he then approached the Maker of Light;

16.306.s:
nityamārādhayāmāsa sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ..
taponiṣṭhaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuḥ kāruṇiko mahān .. 15 ..
16.306.d:
नित्यमाराधयामास सांबो जांबवतीसुतः ..
तपोनिष्ठं च तं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुः कारुणिको महान् .. 15 ..
16.306.m: Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, worshipped him daily. / And seeing him devoted to austerity, the great and compassionate Viṣṇu,

16.306.s:
idaṃ vai cintayāmāsa putravātsalyasaṃyutaḥ ..
yathaiśvaryaprado rudro yathā viṣṇuśca muktidaḥ .. 16 ..
16.306.d:
इदं वै चिन्तयामास पुत्रवात्सल्यसंयुतः ..
यथैश्वर्यप्रदो रुद्रो यथा विष्णुश्च मुक्तिदः .. 16 ..
16.306.m: filled with parental affection, reflected upon this: / “Just as Rudra grants sovereignty and Viṣṇu grants liberation;

16.306.s:
yajñairiṣṭo hi devendro yathā svargapradaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
śuddhikartṛ yathā toyaṃ mṛttikābhasmasaṃyutam ..
dahanātmā yathā vahnirvighnaharttā gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 17 ..
16.306.d:
यज्ञैरिष्टो हि देवेन्द्रो यथा स्वर्गप्रदः स्मृतः ..
शुद्धिकर्तृ यथा तोयं मृत्तिकाभस्मसंयुतम् ..
दहनात्मा यथा वह्निर्विघ्नहर्त्ता गणेश्वरः .. 17 ..
16.306.m: Just as the king of gods, worshipped with sacrifices, is remembered as the bestower of heaven; / just as water combined with clay and ash is a purifier; / just as fire has burning for its nature, and Gaṇeśvara removes obstacles;

16.306.s:
svacchaṃdabhāratīdāne yathā brahmasutā nṛṇām ..
tathā''rogyapradātā ca nānyo devo divākarāt .. 18 ..
16.306.d:
स्वच्छंदभारतीदाने यथा ब्रह्मसुता नृणाम् ..
तथा'ऽरोग्यप्रदाता च नान्यो देवो दिवाकरात् .. 18 ..
16.306.m: Just as the daughter of Brahmā grants spontaneous eloquence to mortals; / even so, there is no deity other than the Maker of Day who bestows health.

16.306.s:
anekadhā''rādhito'pi sa devo bhāskaraḥ śuciḥ ..
na dadāti varaṃ yattu tanme śāpasya kāraṇāt .. 19 ..
16.306.d:
अनेकधा'ऽराधितोऽपि स देवो भास्करः शुचिः ..
न ददाति वरं यत्तु तन्मे शापस्य कारणात् .. 19 ..
16.306.m: Although worshipped in various ways, that deity, the pure Maker of Light, / does not grant the boon only because of my curse.”

16.306.s:
evaṃ saṃcintya bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ ..
sūryarūpaṃ samāśritya tasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ .. 7.1.306.20 ..
16.306.d:
एवं संचिन्त्य भगवान्विष्णुः कमललोचनः ..
सूर्यरूपं समाश्रित्य तस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः .. 7.1.306.20 ..
16.306.m: Having reflected thus, the blessed, lotus-eyed Viṣṇu, Janārdana, / pleased with him, took the form of the sun;

16.306.s:
yo'paranārāyaṇakhyastasyaiva sannidhau sthitaḥ ..
pratyakṣaḥ sa tato viṣṇuḥ sūryarūpī divākaraḥ ..
uvāca paramaprīto varadaḥ puṇyakarmaṇām .. 21 ..
16.306.d:
योऽपरनारायणख्यस्तस्यैव सन्निधौ स्थितः ..
प्रत्यक्षः स ततो विष्णुः सूर्यरूपी दिवाकरः ..
उवाच परमप्रीतो वरदः पुण्यकर्मणाम् .. 21 ..
16.306.m: He who is known as another Nārāyaṇa, abiding right beside him, / then became visible—Viṣṇu, possessing the form of Sūrya, the Maker of Day; / the granter of boons to doers of meritorious deeds spoke, exceedingly pleased:

16.306.s:
alaṃ kleśena te sāṃba kimarthaṃ tapyase tapaḥ ..
prasanno'haṃ hareḥ sūno varaṃ varaya suvrata .. 22 ..
16.306.d:
अलं क्लेशेन ते सांब किमर्थं तप्यसे तपः ..
प्रसन्नोऽहं हरेः सूनो वरं वरय सुव्रत .. 22 ..
16.306.m: “Enough of your hardship, O Sāmba! For what purpose do you perform austerity? / I am pleased, O son of Hari! Choose a boon, O you of noble vows!”

16.306.s:
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
nirmalastvatprasādena kuṣṭhamuktakalevaraḥ ..
bhavāni devadeveśa pratyakṣā'mbarabhūṣaṇa ..
asminsthāne sthito ramye nityaṃ sannihito bhava .. 23 ..
16.306.d:
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
निर्मलस्त्वत्प्रसादेन कुष्ठमुक्तकलेवरः ..
भवानि देवदेवेश प्रत्यक्षाऽम्बरभूषण ..
अस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितो रम्ये नित्यं सन्निहितो भव .. 23 ..
16.306.m: Sāmba said: / “O God, Lord of Gods, visible ornament of the sky, / by your grace may I become pure, my body freed from leprosy! / Abiding in this delightful place, be ever present here!”

16.306.s:
.. sūrya uvāca .. ..
adhunā nirmalo dehastava sāṃba bhaviṣyati .. ihāgatya naro yastu saptamyāṃ ravivāsare ..
upavāsaparo bhūtvā rātrau jāgaraṇe sthitaḥ .. 24 ..
16.306.d:
.. सूर्य उवाच .. ..
अधुना निर्मलो देहस्तव सांब भविष्यति .. इहागत्य नरो यस्तु सप्तम्यां रविवासरे ..
उपवासपरो भूत्वा रात्रौ जागरणे स्थितः .. 24 ..
16.306.m: Sūrya said: / “Now your body will become pure, O Sāmba! / Whatever man comes here on a Sunday that is a seventh lunar day, / dedicated to fasting and staying awake during the night,

16.306.s:
aṣṭādaśāni kuṣṭhāni pāparogāstathaiva ca ..
kadācinna bhaviṣyanti kule tasya mahātmanaḥ .. 25 ..
16.306.d:
अष्टादशानि कुष्ठानि पापरोगास्तथैव च ..
कदाचिन्न भविष्यन्ति कुले तस्य महात्मनः .. 25 ..
16.306.m: the eighteen forms of leprosy as well as diseases born of sin / will never occur in the family of that noble soul.

16.306.s:
kṛtvā snānaṃ naro yastu bhaktiyukto jitendriyaḥ ..
pūjayedravivāreṇa sāṃbādityaṃ mahāprabham ..
sa rogahīno dhanavānputravāñjāyate naraḥ .. 26 ..
16.306.d:
कृत्वा स्नानं नरो यस्तु भक्तियुक्तो जितेन्द्रियः ..
पूजयेद्रविवारेण सांबादित्यं महाप्रभम् ..
स रोगहीनो धनवान्पुत्रवाञ्जायते नरः .. 26 ..
16.306.m: Whatever man, having performed his ritual ablution, full of devotion and with subdued senses, / worships Sāmbāditya of great radiance on a Sunday, / that man becomes free of disease, wealthy, and possessed of sons.

16.306.s:
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidīśānamāśritam ..
kuṃḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ svacchodapari pūritam.. 27 ..
16.306.d:
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे किञ्चिदीशानमाश्रितम् ..
कुंडं पापहरं पुण्यं स्वच्छोदपरि पूरितम्.. 27 ..
16.306.m: Directly to the east of it, tending slightly toward the northeast, / is an auspicious pool that removes sins, filled with pure water.

16.306.s:
tatra snātvā c vidhivatkuryācchrāddhaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānyastu sāṃbādityaṃ prapūjayet .. 28 ..
16.306.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा च् विधिवत्कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं विचक्षणः ..
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्यस्तु सांबादित्यं प्रपूजयेत् .. 28 ..
16.306.m: The wise man, having bathed there according to rule, should perform the ancestral rite; / and whoever feeds brahmins and worships Sāmbāditya,

16.306.s: sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sūrya loke mahīyate .. 29..
16.306.d: सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा सूर्य लोके महीयते .. 29..
16.306.m: having all desires fulfilled within himself, is glorified in the world of the sun.”

16.306.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbāditya māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttaratriśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. 306 ..
16.306.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सांबादित्य माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षडुत्तरत्रिशततमोध्यायः .. 306 ..
16.306.m: Thus ends the three hundred and sixth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Sāmbāditya," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.307.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sāṃbādityācca pūrveṇa kiñcidāgneyasaṃsthitaḥ ..
aparanārāyaṇonāma yasmānnāsti paro bhuvi .. 1 ..
16.307.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
सांबादित्याच्च पूर्वेण किञ्चिदाग्नेयसंस्थितः ..
अपरनारायणोनाम यस्मान्नास्ति परो भुवि .. 1 ..
16.307.m: Īśvara said: / East of Sāmbāditya, situated slightly towards the southeast, / is the one named Apara-Nārāyaṇa, than whom none is higher on earth. // 1

16.307.s:
sa tu sāṃbasya deveśi sūryo viṣṇusvarūpavān ..
aparāṃ mūrtimāsthāya viṣṇurūpo varaṃ dadau .. 2 ..
16.307.d:
स तु सांबस्य देवेशि सूर्यो विष्णुस्वरूपवान् ..
अपरां मूर्तिमास्थाय विष्णुरूपो वरं ददौ .. 2 ..
16.307.m: O ruler of the gods, the sun, having the form of Viṣṇu, / assumed a second form, having the form of Viṣṇu, and granted a boon to Sāmba. // 2

16.307.s:
tenāpareti nāmnā vai khyāto viṣṇuḥ purā'bhavat ..
phālgunāmalapakṣe tu ekādaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ .. 3 ..
16.307.d:
तेनापरेति नाम्ना वै ख्यातो विष्णुः पुराऽभवत् ..
फाल्गुनामलपक्षे तु एकादश्यां विधानतः .. 3 ..
16.307.m: Therefore, Viṣṇu became famous in ancient times under the name 'Apara' ('the Other'). / Properly, on the eleventh lunar day in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, // 3

16.307.s:
pūjayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ tatra sūryasvarūpiṇam ..
mukto bhavati pāpebhyaḥ sarvakāmaiḥ samṛdhyate .. 4 ..
16.307.d:
पूजयेत्पुण्डरीकाक्षं तत्र सूर्यस्वरूपिणम् ..
मुक्तो भवति पापेभ्यः सर्वकामैः समृध्यते .. 4 ..
16.307.m: one should worship the lotus-eyed one there, who has the form of the sun. / He is freed from sins and prospers with all desired objects. // 4

16.307.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātsye'paranārāyaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 307 ..
16.307.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्स्येऽपरनारायणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 307 ..
16.307.m: Thus ends the three hundred and seventh chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Apara-Nārāyaṇa," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.308.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmānnārāyaṇātpūrve kiṃcidīśānasaṃsthitam ..
mūlacaṇḍīśanāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ .. 1 ..
16.308.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मान्नारायणात्पूर्वे किंचिदीशानसंस्थितम् ..
मूलचण्डीशनाम्ना तु विख्यातं भुवनत्रयं .. 1 ..
16.308.m: Īśvara said: / East of that Nārāyaṇa, situated slightly towards the northeast, / is that which is renowned throughout the three worlds by the name Mūlacaṇḍīśa. // 1

16.308.s:
yatra liṃgaṃ purā'smākaṃ pātitaṃ tvṛṣibhiḥ priye ..
krodharaktekṣaṇairdevi mūlacaṇḍīśatā? gatam .. 2 ..
16.308.d:
यत्र लिंगं पुराऽस्माकं पातितं त्वृषिभिः प्रिये ..
क्रोधरक्तेक्षणैर्देवि मूलचण्डीशता? गतम् .. 2 ..
16.308.m: Where in ancient times our liṅga was cast down by the seers, O beloved, / their eyes red with wrath, O goddess, and it attained the state of Mūlacaṇḍīśa. // 2

16.308.s:
ādyaṃ liṃgodbhavaṃ devi ṛṣikopānnipātitam ..
ye kecidṛṣayastatra devadāruvane sthitāḥ .. 3 ..
16.308.d:
आद्यं लिंगोद्भवं देवि ऋषिकोपान्निपातितम् ..
ये केचिदृषयस्तत्र देवदारुवने स्थिताः .. 3 ..
16.308.m: The primeval manifestation of the liṅga was thrown down through the anger of the seers, O goddess. / The seers who were staying there in the pine forest (Devadāruvana)— // 3

16.308.s:
kālāṃtare mahādevi ahaṃ tatra samāgataḥ ..
teṣāṃ jijñāsayā devi tataste roṣitā bhavan ..
śaptastato'haṃ deveśi cakrurme liṃgapātanam .. 4 .. ..
16.308.d:
कालांतरे महादेवि अहं तत्र समागतः ..
तेषां जिज्ञासया देवि ततस्ते रोषिता भवन् ..
शप्तस्ततोऽहं देवेशि चक्रुर्मे लिंगपातनम् .. 4 .. ..
16.308.m: after some time, O great goddess, I went there. / In order to test them, O goddess, [I went]; thereupon they became enraged. / Cursed then by them, O ruler of gods, they brought about the falling of my liṅga. // 4

16.308.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
roṣopahatasadbhāvāḥ kathamete dvijātayaḥ ..
saṃjātā etadākhyāhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 5 ..
16.308.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
रोषोपहतसद्भावाः कथमेते द्विजातयः ..
संजाता एतदाख्याहि परं कौतूहलं मम .. 5 ..
16.308.m: The goddess said: / How did these twice-born ones come to have their true nature destroyed by anger? / Tell me this, for my curiosity is very great. // 5

16.308.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ḍiṃḍi rūpaḥ purā devi bhūtvā'haṃ dāruke vane ..
ṛṣīṇāmāśrame puṇye nagno bhikṣācaro'bhavam ..
bhikṣaṃtamāśrame dṛṣṭvā tāḥ sarvā ṛṣiyoṣitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.308.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
डिंडि रूपः पुरा देवि भूत्वाऽहं दारुके वने ..
ऋषीणामाश्रमे पुण्ये नग्नो भिक्षाचरोऽभवम् ..
भिक्षंतमाश्रमे दृष्ट्वा ताः सर्वा ऋषियोषितः .. 6 ..
16.308.m: Īśvara said: / In ancient times, O goddess, having assumed the form of a naked mendicant (ḍiṇḍi) in the Dāruka forest, / I wandered as an ascetic gathering alms in the holy hermitage of the seers. / Seeing me begging in the hermitage, all those wives of the seers // 6

16.308.s:
kāmasya vaśamāpannāḥ priyamutsṛjya sarvataḥ..
tamūrdhvaliṃgamālokya jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam .. 7 .. ..
16.308.d:
कामस्य वशमापन्नाः प्रियमुत्सृज्य सर्वतः..
तमूर्ध्वलिंगमालोक्य जटामुकुटधारिणम् .. 7 .. ..
16.308.m: fell under the sway of desire, abandoning their beloveds on all sides, / beholding him whose liṅga was erect, wearing a crown of matted locks, // 7

16.308.s:
bhikṣaṃtaṃ bhasmadigdhāṃgaṃ jhaṣaketumivāparam ..
vikṣobhitāśca naḥ sarve dārā etena ḍiṃḍinā .. 8 ..
16.308.d:
भिक्षंतं भस्मदिग्धांगं झषकेतुमिवापरम् ..
विक्षोभिताश्च नः सर्वे दारा एतेन डिंडिना .. 8 ..
16.308.m: begging alms, his body smeared with ashes, like another fish-bannered [Kāma]. / [The seers said:] 'All our wives have been agitated by this naked mendicant! // 8

16.308.s:
tasmācchāpaṃ ca dāsyāma ṛṣayaste tadā'bruvan ..
tataḥ śāpodakaṃ gṛhya saṃdhyātvā'tha tapodhanāḥ .. 9 ..
16.308.d:
तस्माच्छापं च दास्याम ऋषयस्ते तदाऽब्रुवन् ..
ततः शापोदकं गृह्य संध्यात्वाऽथ तपोधनाः .. 9 ..
16.308.m: Therefore, we shall pronounce a curse upon him!' so said those seers then. / Then, taking up the water for the curse and having meditated, the rich in austerities [said]: // 9

16.308.s:
asya liṃgamadho yātu dṛśyate yatsadonnatam ..
ityukte patitaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra devakule mama .. 7.1.308.10 ..
16.308.d:
अस्य लिंगमधो यातु दृश्यते यत्सदोन्नतम् ..
इत्युक्ते पतितं लिंगं तत्र देवकुले मम .. 7.1.308.10 ..
16.308.m: 'Let his liṅga go down, which is seen to be perpetually erect!' / When this was spoken, my liṅga fell there in that temple. // 10

16.308.s:
mūlacaṇḍīśanāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatraye ..
talliṃgaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kopopahatacetasaḥ ..
punarhaṃtuṃ samārabdhā ḍiṃḍinaṃ te tapodhanāḥ .. 11 ..
16.308.d:
मूलचण्डीशनाम्ना तु विख्यातं भुवनत्रये ..
तल्लिंगं पतितं दृष्ट्वा कोपोपहतचेतसः ..
पुनर्हंतुं समारब्धा डिंडिनं ते तपोधनाः .. 11 ..
16.308.m: It became renowned in the three worlds by the name Mūlacaṇḍīśa. / Seeing that liṅga fallen, their minds overcome with wrath, / those rich in austerities set about again to kill the naked mendicant. // 11

16.308.s:
vṛsikāpāṇayaḥ kecitkamaṃḍaludharāḥ pare ..
gṛhītvā pādukāścānye tasya dhāvaṃti pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 12 ..
16.308.d:
वृसिकापाणयः केचित्कमंडलुधराः परे ..
गृहीत्वा पादुकाश्चान्ये तस्य धावंति पृष्ठतः .. 12 ..
16.308.m: Some had grass cushions in hand, others held water-pots, / and others, grabbing wooden sandals, ran behind him. // 12

16.308.s:
ḍiṃḍiścāṃtarhito bhūtvā tvāmuvāca sumadhyamām ..
roṣopahatacetaskānpaśyaitāṃstvaṃ tapodhanān .. 13 ..
16.308.d:
डिंडिश्चांतर्हितो भूत्वा त्वामुवाच सुमध्यमाम् ..
रोषोपहतचेतस्कान्पश्यैतांस्त्वं तपोधनान् .. 13 ..
16.308.m: And the naked mendicant, disappearing, spoke to you of slender waist: / 'Look at these rich in austerities, whose minds are afflicted by wrath! // 13

16.308.s:
etasmātkāraṇāddevi tava vākyānmayā'naghe ..
na kṛto'nugrahasteṣāṃ saroṣāṇāṃ tapasvinām .. 14 ..
16.308.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्देवि तव वाक्यान्मयाऽनघे ..
न कृतोऽनुग्रहस्तेषां सरोषाणां तपस्विनाम् .. 14 ..
16.308.m: For this reason, O sinless goddess, according to your words, / no grace was granted by me to those angry ascetics.' // 14

16.308.s:
atrāṃtare te munayo hyapaśyaṃto hi ḍiṃḍinam ..
nirānaṃdaṃ gatāḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ devaṃ pitāmaham.. 15 ..
16.308.d:
अत्रांतरे ते मुनयो ह्यपश्यंतो हि डिंडिनम् ..
निरानंदं गताः सर्वे द्रष्टुं देवं पितामहम्.. 15 ..
16.308.m: Meanwhile, those sages, no longer seeing the naked mendicant, / all became devoid of joy and went to see the god, the grandfather [Brahmā]. // 15

16.308.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudheśānaṃ viraṃciṃ vigatajvaram ..
praṇamya śirasā sarva ṛṣayaḥ prāhuraṃjasā .. 16 ..
16.308.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा विबुधेशानं विरंचिं विगतज्वरम् ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्व ऋषयः प्राहुरंजसा .. 16 ..
16.308.m: Seeing that lord of the gods, Virañci, free from fever, / all the seers bowed with their heads and said straightforwardly: // 16

16.308.s:
bhagavanḍiṃḍi rūpeṇa kaścidasti tapodhanaḥ ..
vidhvaṃsanāya dārāṇāṃ praviṣṭaḥ kila bhikṣitum.. 17 ..
16.308.d:
भगवन्डिंडि रूपेण कश्चिदस्ति तपोधनः ..
विध्वंसनाय दाराणां प्रविष्टः किल भिक्षितुम्.. 17 ..
16.308.m: 'O Lord, there is a certain ascetic in the form of a naked mendicant / who entered, it is said, to beg alms for the ruin of our wives. // 17

16.308.s:
śapto'smābhistu durvṛttastasya liṃgaṃ nipātitam..
tasminnipatite'smākaṃ tathaiva patitāni ca .. 18 ..
16.308.d:
शप्तोऽस्माभिस्तु दुर्वृत्तस्तस्य लिंगं निपातितम्..
तस्मिन्निपतितेऽस्माकं तथैव पतितानि च .. 18 ..
16.308.m: Cursed by us, that wicked one had his liṅga cast down. / When that fell, ours fell in the very same way! // 18

16.308.s:
gato'sau kāraṇāttasmāttalliṃge patite vayam ..
nirānaṃdāḥ sthitāḥ sarva ācakṣvaitaddhi kāraṇam ..19... ..
16.308.d:
गतोऽसौ कारणात्तस्मात्तल्लिंगे पतिते वयम् ..
निरानंदाः स्थिताः सर्व आचक्ष्वैतद्धि कारणम् ..19... ..
16.308.m: For that reason he departed; and with that liṅga fallen, / we have all remained joyless. Tell us, indeed, the cause of this!' // 19

16.308.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
aśobhanamidaṃ kāryaṃ yuṣmābhiryatkṛtaṃ mahat.
rudrasyātisurūpasya serṣyā ye hantumudyatāḥ ..7.1.308.20..
16.308.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
अशोभनमिदं कार्यं युष्माभिर्यत्कृतं महत्.
रुद्रस्यातिसुरूपस्य सेर्ष्या ये हन्तुमुद्यताः ..7.1.308.20..
16.308.m: Brahmā said: / 'This is a terrible and improper deed that has been done by you, / who with jealousy set out to kill Rudra of exceedingly handsome form! // 20

16.308.s:
āsurīṃ dānavīṃ daivīṃ yakṣiṇīṃ kiṃnarīṃ tathā ..
vidyādharīṃ ca gandharvīṃ nāgakanyāṃ manoramām ..
etā varastriyastyaktvā yuṣmadīyāsu tāsvapi .. 21 ..
16.308.d:
आसुरीं दानवीं दैवीं यक्षिणीं किंनरीं तथा ..
विद्याधरीं च गन्धर्वीं नागकन्यां मनोरमाम् ..
एता वरस्त्रियस्त्यक्त्वा युष्मदीयासु तास्वपि .. 21 ..
16.308.m: Forsaking the beautiful women of the Asuras, Dānavas, gods, / Yakṣas, Kiṃnaras, Vidyādharas, Gandharvas, and charming daughters of the Nāgas— / having forsaken all these excellent women, [would he find] // 21

16.308.s:
āhlādaṃ kurute sarve naiva jānīta bho dvijāḥ ..
trailokyanāyakāṃ sarvāṃ rūpātiśayasaṃyutām .. 22 ..
16.308.d:
आह्लादं कुरुते सर्वे नैव जानीत भो द्विजाः ..
त्रैलोक्यनायकां सर्वां रूपातिशयसंयुताम् .. 22 ..
16.308.m: delight in those wives of yours? You do not know at all, O brahmins! / [His consort is] the mistress of the three worlds, endowed with the perfection of beauty; // 22

16.308.s:
tāṃ tyaktvā munipatnīnāmāhlādaṃ kurute katham ..
tayā rudro hi vijñapta ṛṣīṇāṃ kurvanugraham .. 23 ..
16.308.d:
तां त्यक्त्वा मुनिपत्नीनामाह्लादं कुरुते कथम् ..
तया रुद्रो हि विज्ञप्त ऋषीणां कुर्वनुग्रहम् .. 23 ..
16.308.m: leaving her, how could he delight in the wives of sages? / For Rudra was requested by her: "Bestow grace upon the seers." // 23

16.308.s:
tena vākyena pārvatyā jijñāsārthaṃ kṛtaṃ manaḥ ..
caturddaśavidhasyāpi bhūtagrāmasya yaḥ prabhuḥ .. 24 ..
16.308.d:
तेन वाक्येन पार्वत्या जिज्ञासार्थं कृतं मनः ..
चतुर्द्दशविधस्यापि भूतग्रामस्य यः प्रभुः .. 24 ..
16.308.m: Due to those words of Pārvatī, his mind was resolved to test [you]. / He who is the master of all the fourteen classes of living beings, // 24

16.308.s:
sa śapto ḍiṃḍirūpastu bhavadbhiḥ karaṇeśvaraḥ ..
tacchāpācchaptamevaitatsamastaṃ tadguṇāspadam ..
devatiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāṃ nirānaṃdamiti sthitam .. 25 ..
16.308.d:
स शप्तो डिंडिरूपस्तु भवद्भिः करणेश्वरः ..
तच्छापाच्छप्तमेवैतत्समस्तं तद्गुणास्पदम् ..
देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्याणां निरानंदमिति स्थितम् .. 25 ..
16.308.m: that Lord of the senses in the form of a naked mendicant was cursed by you! / Because of that curse, this entire abode of his qualities has been cursed; / thus gods, animals, and humans have come to be joyless! // 25

16.308.s:
śāpenānena bhavatāṃ mahā doṣaḥ prajāyate ..
ārādhyaṃ nānyathā liṃgamunnatiṃ yātyadhogatam .. 26 ..
16.308.d:
शापेनानेन भवतां महा दोषः प्रजायते ..
आराध्यं नान्यथा लिंगमुन्नतिं यात्यधोगतम् .. 26 ..
16.308.m: A great fault arises for you on account of this curse. / The fallen liṅga cannot otherwise rise again unless propitiated.' // 26

16.308.s:
evamukte'tha devena viprā ūcuḥ pitāmaham ..
draṣṭavyaḥ kutra so'smābhiḥ kathayasva yathāsthitam .. 27 ..
16.308.d:
एवमुक्तेऽथ देवेन विप्रा ऊचुः पितामहम् ..
द्रष्टव्यः कुत्र सोऽस्माभिः कथयस्व यथास्थितम् .. 27 ..
16.308.m: When this was spoken by the god, the brahmins said to the grandfather: / 'Where should he be seen by us? Tell us as it really is!' // 27

16.308.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
āste gajasvarūpeṇa kuberāśramasaṃsthitaḥ ..
tatra gatvā tamāsādya toṣayadhvaṃ pinākinam .. .. 28 ..
16.308.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
आस्ते गजस्वरूपेण कुबेराश्रमसंस्थितः ..
तत्र गत्वा तमासाद्य तोषयध्वं पिनाकिनम् .. .. 28 ..
16.308.m: Brahmā said: / 'He dwells in the form of an elephant, staying at Kubera’s hermitage. / Having gone there and approached him, propitiate the wielder of the Pināka!' // 28

16.308.s:
etacchrutvā vacastasya sarve te hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
gaṃtuṃ pravṛttāḥ sahasā koṭisaṃkhyāstapodhanāḥ .. 29 ..
16.308.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य सर्वे ते हृष्टमानसाः ..
गंतुं प्रवृत्ताः सहसा कोटिसंख्यास्तपोधनाः .. 29 ..
16.308.m: Hearing his words, all those rich in austerities, glad at heart, / numbering in the tens of millions, set out at once to go, // 29

16.308.s:
ciṃtayaṃtaḥ śubhaṃ deśaṃ draṣṭuṃ taṃ gajarūpiṇam ..
rudraṃ pitāmahākhyātaṃ kuberāśramavāsinam .. 7.1.308.30 ..
16.308.d:
चिंतयंतः शुभं देशं द्रष्टुं तं गजरूपिणम् ..
रुद्रं पितामहाख्यातं कुबेराश्रमवासिनम् .. 7.1.308.30 ..
16.308.m: pondering the auspicious place to see that one having the form of an elephant, / Rudra dwelling in the hermitage of Kubera, described by the grandfather. // 30

16.308.s:
