kṣutkāmakaṃṭhāstṛṣitāngaurī matvā tapodhanān ..
ādāya gorasaṃ teṣāṃ kāruṇyātsā puraḥ sthitā .. 31 ..
16.308.d:
क्षुत्कामकंठास्तृषितान्गौरी मत्वा तपोधनान् ..
आदाय गोरसं तेषां कारुण्यात्सा पुरः स्थिता .. 31 ..
16.308.m: Perceiving the ascetics to be thirsty, with their throats parched by hunger, / Gaurī, out of compassion, took milk and stood before them. // 31

16.308.s:
asitāṃ kuṭilāṃ snigdhāmāyatāṃ bhujagīmiva ..
veṇīṃ śirasi bibhrāṇā gaurī gorasasaṃyutā .. 32 ..
16.308.d:
असितां कुटिलां स्निग्धामायतां भुजगीमिव ..
वेणीं शिरसि बिभ्राणा गौरी गोरससंयुता .. 32 ..
16.308.m: Wearing on her head a braid of hair—black, curled, glossy, / and long like a female serpent—Gaurī stood endowed with milk. // 32

16.308.s:
sā tānāha munīnsarvānyanmayā parvatāhṛtam..
kapitthaphalasaṃgaṃdhaṃ gorasaṃ tvamṛtopamam ..33..
16.308.d:
सा तानाह मुनीन्सर्वान्यन्मया पर्वताहृतम्..
कपित्थफलसंगंधं गोरसं त्वमृतोपमम् ..33..
16.308.m: She said to all those sages: 'Drink this milk like nectar, / smelling of kapittha fruit, which has been brought by me from the mountain!' // 33

16.308.s:
tayaivamuktā viprāstu āhustāṃ vipulekṣaṇām ..
snātvā ca sarve pāsyāmo gorasaṃ tu tvayāhṛtam .. 34 ..
16.308.d:
तयैवमुक्ता विप्रास्तु आहुस्तां विपुलेक्षणाम् ..
स्नात्वा च सर्वे पास्यामो गोरसं तु त्वयाहृतम् .. 34 ..
16.308.m: Addressed thus by her, the brahmins said to that large-eyed lady: / “Having bathed, we shall all drink the milk brought by you.”

16.308.s:
tataḥ śrutvā tathā devyā snānārthaṃ tīrthamuttamam ..
taptodakenasaṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ manoramam .. 35 ..
16.308.d:
ततः श्रुत्वा तथा देव्या स्नानार्थं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ..
तप्तोदकेनसंपूर्णं कृतं कुण्डं मनोरमम् .. 35 ..
16.308.m: Then, having heard [this], an excellent sacred ford was made by the goddess for their bath, / a charming pool filled with warm water.

16.308.s:
tatra te saṃplutāḥ sarve vimuktā vipulācchramāt..
kṛtā''hnā gorasasvaiva pānārthaṃ samupasthitāḥ..36..
16.308.d:
तत्र ते संप्लुताः सर्वे विमुक्ता विपुलाच्छ्रमात्..
कृता'ऽह्ना गोरसस्वैव पानार्थं समुपस्थिताः..36..
16.308.m: Having plunged into it, all of them were freed from their great fatigue; / having performed their daily rites, they approached to drink the milk.

16.308.s:
patrairdivākaratarorvidhāya puṭakāñchubhān ..
upaviśya kramātsarve te pibaṃti sma gorasam .. 37 ..
16.308.d:
पत्रैर्दिवाकरतरोर्विधाय पुटकाञ्छुभान् ..
उपविश्य क्रमात्सर्वे ते पिबंति स्म गोरसम् .. 37 ..
16.308.m: Fashioning auspicious cups from the leaves of the sun-tree (Arka), / and sitting down in order, all of them drank the milk.

16.308.s:
gorasena tadā teṣāmamṛteneva pūritān..
bubhukṣitānāṃ puṭakānmunīnāṃ tṛptikāraṇāt ..38..
16.308.d:
गोरसेन तदा तेषाममृतेनेव पूरितान्..
बुभुक्षितानां पुटकान्मुनीनां तृप्तिकारणात् ..38..
16.308.m: Then, to satisfy those hungry sages, / their cups were filled with milk as if with nectar.

16.308.s:
punaḥ pūrayate gaurī pītvā te tṛptimāgatāḥ..
kṣuttṛṣāśramanirmuktāḥ punarjātā iva sthitāḥ ..39..
16.308.d:
पुनः पूरयते गौरी पीत्वा ते तृप्तिमागताः..
क्षुत्तृषाश्रमनिर्मुक्ताः पुनर्जाता इव स्थिताः ..39..
16.308.m: Gaurī filled them again, and having drunk, they attained satisfaction; / freed from hunger, thirst, and fatigue, they stood as though reborn.

16.308.s:
svasthacittaistato jñātvā neyaṃ gopālisaṃjñikā ..
anugrahārthamasmākaṃ gaurīyaṃ samupāgatā ..7.1.308.40..
16.308.d:
स्वस्थचित्तैस्ततो ज्ञात्वा नेयं गोपालिसंज्ञिका ..
अनुग्रहार्थमस्माकं गौरीयं समुपागता ..7.1.308.40..
16.308.m: Then, with calm minds, they realized: “She is not a cowherdess; / this Gaurī has come here to bestow grace upon us.”

16.308.s:
praṇamya śirasā sarve tāmūcuste sumadhyamām..
ume kathaya kutrasthaṃ drakṣyāmo rudramekadā .. 41 ..
16.308.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्वे तामूचुस्ते सुमध्यमाम्..
उमे कथय कुत्रस्थं द्रक्ष्यामो रुद्रमेकदा .. 41 ..
16.308.m: Bowing their heads, they all said to that slender-waisted lady: / “O Umā, tell us where we may someday see Rudra!”

16.308.s:
tathoktāste mahātmānastaṃ paśyata mahāgajam ..
gajatāṃ ca samāsādya saṃcaraṃtaṃ mahābalam .. 42 ..
16.308.d:
तथोक्तास्ते महात्मानस्तं पश्यत महागजम् ..
गजतां च समासाद्य संचरंतं महाबलम् .. 42 ..
16.308.m: Thus addressed, she said to those high-souled ones: “Look upon that great elephant; / having assumed the form of an elephant, he roams about, full of great might.

16.308.s:
bhavadbhirnijabhaktyāyaṃ saṃgrāhyo hi yathāsukham ..
te tadvacanamāsādya sametyaikatra ca dvijāḥ .. .. 43 ..
16.308.d:
भवद्भिर्निजभक्त्यायं संग्राह्यो हि यथासुखम् ..
ते तद्वचनमासाद्य समेत्यैकत्र च द्विजाः .. .. 43 ..
16.308.m: He should indeed be comfortably captured by you through your own devotion.” / Hearing her word, those twice-born assembled in one place.

16.308.s:
pavitrāstaṃ gajaṃ draṣṭuṃ bhāvitenāṃtarātmanā ..
yatraikatra sthitā viprāstatra tīrthaṃ mahodayam ..
saṃgameśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu pūrvaṃ sarvatra viśrutam .. 44 ..
16.308.d:
पवित्रास्तं गजं द्रष्टुं भावितेनांतरात्मना ..
यत्रैकत्र स्थिता विप्रास्तत्र तीर्थं महोदयम् ..
संगमेश्वरसंज्ञं तु पूर्वं सर्वत्र विश्रुतम् .. 44 ..
16.308.m: Purified, with hearts concentrated, in order to behold that elephant— / where the brahmins stood together in one place, there is a most auspicious sacred ford / known as Saṅgameśvara, celebrated everywhere from of old.

16.308.s:
tatastasmātpravṛttāste draṣṭukāmā mahāgajam ..
kuṃḍikāḥ saṃparityajya saṃnahyātmānamātmanā ..45..
16.308.d:
ततस्तस्मात्प्रवृत्तास्ते द्रष्टुकामा महागजम् ..
कुंडिकाः संपरित्यज्य संनह्यात्मानमात्मना ..45..
16.308.m: Then they set out from there, desirous of seeing the great elephant, / abandoning their water-pots and girding themselves up.

16.308.s:
yatra tāḥ kuṃḍikāstyaktāstattīrthaṃ kuṇḍikāhvayam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṃsāṃ dṛṣṭā'dṛṣṭaphalapradam .. 46 ..
16.308.d:
यत्र ताः कुंडिकास्त्यक्तास्तत्तीर्थं कुण्डिकाह्वयम् ..
सर्वपापहरं पुंसां दृष्टाऽदृष्टफलप्रदम् .. 46 ..
16.308.m: Where those water-pots were cast aside, that sacred ford is called Kuṇḍikā; / it removes all sins of mortals and grants both seen and unseen rewards.

16.308.s:
kuberasyāśramaṃ prāpya tataste munisattamāḥ ..
nālikeravanīsaṃsthaṃ dadṛśustaṃ dvipaṃ tadā .. 47 ..
16.308.d:
कुबेरस्याश्रमं प्राप्य ततस्ते मुनिसत्तमाः ..
नालिकेरवनीसंस्थं ददृशुस्तं द्विपं तदा .. 47 ..
16.308.m: Reaching Kubera’s hermitage, those best of sages / then saw that elephant stationed in a coconut grove.

16.308.s:
kare grahītumārabdhāḥ svakarairhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
gajastānkarasaṃlagnānvicikṣepa tapodhanān .. 48 ..
16.308.d:
करे ग्रहीतुमारब्धाः स्वकरैर्हृष्टमानसाः ..
गजस्तान्करसंलग्नान्विचिक्षेप तपोधनान् .. 48 ..
16.308.m: With joyful minds, they began to seize his trunk with their hands; / the elephant flung off those rich in austerity who clung to his trunk,

16.308.s:
kāścidaṃgasamālagnānsamaṃtādbhayavarjitān ..
evaṃ sa taiḥ punaḥ sarvairmaśakairiva ceṣṭitam .. 49 ..
16.308.d:
काश्चिदंगसमालग्नान्समंताद्भयवर्जितान् ..
एवं स तैः पुनः सर्वैर्मशकैरिव चेष्टितम् .. 49 ..
16.308.m: and some who clung to his limbs, free of fear from every side. / In this manner, all of them acted around him like gnats.

16.308.s:
krīḍāṃ karoti vividhāṃ vanasaṃstho haradvipaḥ ..
tadrūpaṃ saṃparityajya rudro raudragajātmakam .. 7.1.308.50 ..
16.308.d:
क्रीडां करोति विविधां वनसंस्थो हरद्विपः ..
तद्रूपं संपरित्यज्य रुद्रो रौद्रगजात्मकम् .. 7.1.308.50 ..
16.308.m: Standing in the forest, Hara's elephant engaged in various sports; / then Rudra abandoned that form consisting of a fierce elephant,

16.308.s:
punaranyaccakārāsau ḍiṃḍirūpaṃ manoramam ..
jayaśabdapraghoṣeṇa vedamaṅgalagītakaiḥ .. 51 ..
16.308.d:
पुनरन्यच्चकारासौ डिंडिरूपं मनोरमम् ..
जयशब्दप्रघोषेण वेदमङ्गलगीतकैः .. 51 ..
16.308.m: and assumed another charming form as Ḍiṇḍi. / With the roaring sound of “Victory!” and auspicious Vedic chants,

16.308.s:
unnāmitaṃ punastena yatra liṃgaṃ mahodayam ..
tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam .. 52 ..
16.308.d:
उन्नामितं पुनस्तेन यत्र लिंगं महोदयम् ..
तदुन्नतमिति प्रोक्तं स्थानं स्थानवतां वरम् .. 52 ..
16.308.m: he was raised up again where the most auspicious liṅga was; / that place, the best among places, is called Unnata.

16.308.s:
gajarūpadharastatra sthitaḥ sthāne mahābalaḥ ..
gaṇanāthasvarūpeṇa hyunnato jagati sthitaḥ .. 53 ..
16.308.d:
गजरूपधरस्तत्र स्थितः स्थाने महाबलः ..
गणनाथस्वरूपेण ह्युन्नतो जगति स्थितः .. 53 ..
16.308.m: Bearing the form of an elephant, that mighty one stayed in that place; / in the form of Gaṇanātha, Unnata is established in the world.

16.308.s:
ḍiṃḍirūpa dharo bhūtvā rudraḥ prāha tapodhanān ..
yanmayā bhavatāṃ kāryaṃ kartavyaṃ tadihocyatām .. 54 ..
16.308.d:
डिंडिरूप धरो भूत्वा रुद्रः प्राह तपोधनान् ..
यन्मया भवतां कार्यं कर्तव्यं तदिहोच्यताम् .. 54 ..
16.308.m: Having assumed the form of Ḍiṇḍi, Rudra said to those rich in austerity: / “What service is to be done by me for you, let that be stated here.”

16.308.s:
evamuktastu tairuktaḥ sarvajñānakriyāparaiḥ ..
sānandāḥ prāṇinaḥ saṃtu tvatprasādātpurā yathā .. 55 ..
16.308.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु तैरुक्तः सर्वज्ञानक्रियापरैः ..
सानन्दाः प्राणिनः संतु त्वत्प्रसादात्पुरा यथा .. 55 ..
16.308.m: Being thus addressed, he was spoken to by those devoted to all knowledge and rituals: / “May living beings be joyful through your grace, just as before.

16.308.s:
kṣaṃtavyaṃ devadeveśa kṛtaṃ yanmūḍhamānasaiḥ ..
tvatprasādātsureśāna tattvaṃ sānugraho bhava .. 56 ..
16.308.d:
क्षंतव्यं देवदेवेश कृतं यन्मूढमानसैः ..
त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेशान तत्त्वं सानुग्रहो भव .. 56 ..
16.308.m: O Lord of the gods of gods, forgive what was done by us with foolish minds; / by your grace, O Lord of gods, be gracious unto us!”

16.308.s:
evamastviti tenoktāste sarve vigatajvarāḥ ..
talliṃgānukṛtiṃ liṃgamījire munayastathā ..
cakruste munayaḥ sarve stutiṃ vigatamatsarāḥ .. 57 ..
16.308.d:
एवमस्त्विति तेनोक्तास्ते सर्वे विगतज्वराः ..
तल्लिंगानुकृतिं लिंगमीजिरे मुनयस्तथा ..
चक्रुस्ते मुनयः सर्वे स्तुतिं विगतमत्सराः .. 57 ..
16.308.m: Told by him, “So be it,” all of them were freed from feverish distress. / Then the sages worshipped that liṅga in imitation of the divine liṅga, / and all those sages, freed from malice, offered praise:

16.308.s:
kṣamasva devadeveśa kurvasmākamanugraham ..
asmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gaccha mūlacaṇḍīśasaṃjñake ..
trikālaṃ devadeveśa grāhyā hyatra kalā tvayā .. 58 .. ..
16.308.d:
क्षमस्व देवदेवेश कुर्वस्माकमनुग्रहम् ..
अस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे लयं गच्छ मूलचण्डीशसंज्ञके ..
त्रिकालं देवदेवेश ग्राह्या ह्यत्र कला त्वया .. 58 .. ..
16.308.m: “Forgive us, O Lord of the gods of gods! Bestow your grace upon us! / Enter into dissolution in this liṅga named Mūlacaṇḍīśa; / a portion of you should be received here at the three junctures of the day, O Lord of the gods of gods.”

16.308.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
caṇḍī tu procyate devī tasyā īśastvahaṃ smṛtaḥ ..
tasya mūlaṃ smṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ tadatra patitaṃ yataḥ .. 59 ..
16.308.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
चण्डी तु प्रोच्यते देवी तस्या ईशस्त्वहं स्मृतः ..
तस्य मूलं स्मृतं लिंगं तदत्र पतितं यतः .. 59 ..
16.308.m: The Lord said: / “The goddess is called Caṇḍī, and I am considered her lord (īśa); / this liṅga is considered its root (mūla), since it fell here.

16.308.s:
tasmāttanmūla caṇḍīśa iti khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. vā
pīkūpataḍāgānāṃ śataistu vipulairapi .. 7.1.308.60 ..
16.308.d:
तस्मात्तन्मूल चण्डीश इति ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. वा
पीकूपतडागानां शतैस्तु विपुलैरपि .. 7.1.308.60 ..
16.308.m: Therefore, it will attain renown as Mūlacaṇḍīśa. / Whatever merit arises from digging hundreds of large stepwells, / wells, and reservoirs,

16.308.s:
kṛtairyajjāyate puṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ liṃgadarśanāt ..
brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyaphalamāpnuyāt .. 61 ..
16.308.d:
कृतैर्यज्जायते पुण्यं तत्पुण्यं लिंगदर्शनात् ..
ब्रह्माण्डं सकलं दत्त्वा यत्पुण्यफलमाप्नुयात् .. 61 ..
16.308.m: that merit comes from the darśana of this liṅga. / Whatever meritorious fruit one would attain by giving the entire universe,

16.308.s:
tatpuṇyaṃ labhate devi mūlacaṇḍīśadarśanāt ..
tatra dānāni deyāni ṣoḍaśaiva narottamaiḥ .. 62 ..
16.308.d:
तत्पुण्यं लभते देवि मूलचण्डीशदर्शनात् ..
तत्र दानानि देयानि षोडशैव नरोत्तमैः .. 62 ..
16.308.m: that merit one obtains, O goddess, from the darśana of Mūlacaṇḍīśa; / there, the sixteen gifts should indeed be given by the best of men.

16.308.s:
evaṃ tadbhavitā sarvaṃ yanmayoktaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
yāta dāruvanaṃ viprāḥ sarve yūyaṃ tapodhanāḥ ..
mayā sarve samādiṣṭā yāta dāruvanaṃ dvijāḥ .. 63 ..
16.308.d:
एवं तद्भविता सर्वं यन्मयोक्तं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
यात दारुवनं विप्राः सर्वे यूयं तपोधनाः ..
मया सर्वे समादिष्टा यात दारुवनं द्विजाः .. 63 ..
16.308.m: All that I have spoken will happen thus, O best of the twice-born! / Go to the Dāruvana, O brahmins, all of you rich in austerity! / You are all commanded by me: go to the Dāruvana, O twice-born!”

16.308.s:
tatastu saṃprāpya mahadvaco mama sarve prahṛṣṭā munayo mahodayam ..
gatvā ca taddāruvanaṃ maheśvari punaśca ceruḥ sutapastapodhanāḥ .. 64 ..
16.308.d:
ततस्तु संप्राप्य महद्वचो मम सर्वे प्रहृष्टा मुनयो महोदयम् ..
गत्वा च तद्दारुवनं महेश्वरि पुनश्च चेरुः सुतपस्तपोधनाः .. 64 ..
16.308.m: Then, having received that great and highly prosperous command of mine, all the sages rejoiced; / and going to that Dāruvana, O Maheśvarī, those rich in austerity performed great austerity again.

16.308.s:
etasmātkāraṇāddevi mūlacaṇḍīśasaṃjñitam ..
liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāmarddhacandreṇa bhūṣitam .. 65 ..
16.308.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्देवि मूलचण्डीशसंज्ञितम् ..
लिंगं पापहरं नृणामर्द्धचन्द्रेण भूषितम् .. 65 ..
16.308.m: For this reason, O goddess, the liṅga named Mūlacaṇḍīśa, / adorned with a crescent moon, removes the sins of mortals.

16.308.s:
dohanī dugthadānena munīnāṃ tṛṣitātmanām ..
śramāpahāraṃ yaddevi tvayā kṛtamanuttamam ..
tattaptodakanāmnā vā abhūtkuṇḍaṃ dharātale ..66 ..
16.308.d:
दोहनी दुग्थदानेन मुनीनां तृषितात्मनाम् ..
श्रमापहारं यद्देवि त्वया कृतमनुत्तमम् ..
तत्तप्तोदकनाम्ना वा अभूत्कुण्डं धरातले ..66 ..
16.308.m: Because of the milking vessel, through the gift of milk to the thirsty sages, / the supreme removal of exhaustion was accomplished by you, O goddess, / that pool on the surface of the earth came to be named Taptodaka.

16.308.s:
ṛṣitoyājale snātvā caṇḍīśaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet ..
sa pracaṇḍo bhavedbhūmau bhuvanānāmadhīśvaraḥ .. 67 ..
16.308.d:
ऋषितोयाजले स्नात्वा चण्डीशं यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
स प्रचण्डो भवेद्भूमौ भुवनानामधीश्वरः .. 67 ..
16.308.m: Whoever bathes in the water of Ṛṣitoyā and worships Caṇḍīśa / shall become formidable on earth, a sovereign lord of the worlds.

16.308.s:
etatsaṃkṣepato devi māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ tava ..
mūlacaṇḍīśadevasya śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam .. 68 ..
16.308.d:
एतत्संक्षेपतो देवि माहात्म्यं कीर्तितं तव ..
मूलचण्डीशदेवस्य श्रुतं पातकनाशनम् .. 68 ..
16.308.m: Thus, O goddess, has the māhātmya of Lord Mūlacaṇḍīśa been briefly proclaimed to you; / heard, it destroys sin.

16.308.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye taptodakakuṇḍotpattau mūlacaṇḍīśotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottara triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 308 ..
16.308.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तप्तोदककुण्डोत्पत्तौ मूलचण्डीशोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टोत्तर त्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 308 ..
16.308.m: Thus ends the three hundred and eighth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Origin of Mūlacaṇḍīśa in the Context of the Origin of the Taptodaka Pool,” in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.309.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vināyakamanuttamam ..
caturmukheti vikhyātaṃ caṇḍīśāduttare sthitam .. 1 ..
16.309.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विनायकमनुत्तमम् ..
चतुर्मुखेति विख्यातं चण्डीशादुत्तरे स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.309.m: The Lord said: / “Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed Vināyaka / renowned as Caturmukha, situated to the north of Caṇḍīśa,

16.309.s:
kiñcidīśānadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ ca catuṣṭaye ..
taṃ prayatnācca saṃpūjya sarvavighnaiḥ pramucyate .. 2 ..
16.309.d:
किञ्चिदीशानदिग्भागे धनुषां च चतुष्टये ..
तं प्रयत्नाच्च संपूज्य सर्वविघ्नैः प्रमुच्यते .. 2 ..
16.309.m: slightly toward the northeast, at a distance of four bows. / Having worshipped him with diligence, one is freed from all obstacles.

16.309.s:
gandhapuṣpādibhistatra bhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ samodakaiḥ ..
caturmukhaṃ caturthyāṃ tu saṃpūjya siddhibhāgbhavet .. 3 ..
16.309.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिस्तत्र भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैः समोदकैः ..
चतुर्मुखं चतुर्थ्यां तु संपूज्य सिद्धिभाग्भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.309.m: Worshipping Caturmukha there on the fourth lunar day / with perfumes, flowers, and the like, and with edible foods, feasts, and modakas, one shares in accomplishment.

16.309.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahapurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye caturmukhavināyaka māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 309 ..
16.309.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महपुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चतुर्मुखविनायक माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 309 ..
16.309.m: Thus ends the three hundred and ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Caturmukha Vināyaka', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.310.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādvāyavyadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ dvitaye sthitam ..
kalaṃbeśvaranāmānaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. .. 1 ..
16.310.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माद्वायव्यदिग्भागे धनुषां द्वितये स्थितम् ..
कलंबेश्वरनामानं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. .. 1 ..
16.310.m:
Īśvara said:
In the north-western direction from that [place], situated at a distance of two bows,
is the one named Kalambeśvara, the destroyer of all sins.

16.310.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ...
somavāre tvamāvāsyā tatraiva bahupuṇyadā ..
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ deyaṃ tatra puṇya phalepsubhiḥ .. 2 ..
16.310.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा च मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वकिल्बिषैः...
सोमवारे त्वमावास्या तत्रैव बहुपुण्यदा ..
विप्राणां भोजनं देयं तत्र पुण्य फलेप्सुभिः .. 2 ..
16.310.m: Having seen and worshipped him, one is freed from all sins. / The new moon day on a Monday brings great merit there indeed. / Food should be given to brahmins there by those who wish for meritorious fruits.

16.310.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kalaṃbeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma daśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 310 ..
16.310.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कलंबेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम दशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 310 ..
16.310.m: Thus ends the three hundred and tenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kalambeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.311.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gopālasvāminaṃ harim ..
caṇḍīśātpūrvadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ viṃśatau sthitam .. 1 ..
16.311.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गोपालस्वामिनं हरिम् ..
चण्डीशात्पूर्वदिग्भागे धनुषां विंशतौ स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.311.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to Hari, Gopālasvāmin, / situated to the east of Caṇḍīśa at a distance of twenty bows.

16.311.s:
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca māghe māsi viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjā jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tatra gacchetparaṃ padam .. 2 ..
16.311.d:
सर्वपापोपशमनं दारिद्र्यौघविनाशनम्..
तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा च माघे मासि विशेषतः ..
पूजा जागरणं कृत्वा तत्र गच्छेत्परं पदम् .. 2 ..
16.311.m: He pacifies all sins and destroys the flood of poverty. / Having seen and worshipped him, especially in the month of Māgha, / and having performed worship and a vigil there, one attains the supreme state.

16.311.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gopāla svāmiharimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 311 ..
16.311.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गोपाल स्वामिहरिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकादशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 311 ..
16.311.m: Thus ends the three hundred and eleventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gopālasvāmin Hari', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.312.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmāduttaradigbhāge dhanuṣāmaṣṭabhiḥ priye ..
bakulasvāminaṃ sūryaṃ taṃ paśyedduḥkhanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.312.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादुत्तरदिग्भागे धनुषामष्टभिः प्रिये ..
बकुलस्वामिनं सूर्यं तं पश्येद्दुःखनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.312.m:
Īśvara said:
In the northern direction from that [place], O beloved, at eight bows, / one should behold Bakulasvāmin, the sun god, the destroyer of sorrow.

16.312.s:
ravivāreṇa saptamyāṃ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ naraḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sūryaloke mahīyate .. .. 2 ..
16.312.d:
रविवारेण सप्तम्यां कुर्याज्जागरणं नरः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति सूर्यलोके महीयते .. .. 2 ..
16.312.m: If a man performs a vigil on the seventh lunar day falling on a Sunday, / he attains all desires and is glorified in the world of the Sun.

16.312.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bakulasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāda śottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 312 ..
16.312.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बकुलस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाद शोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 312 ..
16.312.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twelfth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bakulasvāmin', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.313.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādvāyavyadigbhāge dhanuḥṣoḍaśabhiḥ sthitaḥ ..
uttarārkaśca nāmnā vai sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ ..
mucyate sarvarogaistu kṛtvā vai niṃbasaptamīm.. 1 ..
16.313.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माद्वायव्यदिग्भागे धनुःषोडशभिः स्थितः ..
उत्तरार्कश्च नाम्ना वै सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकः ..
मुच्यते सर्वरोगैस्तु कृत्वा वै निंबसप्तमीम्.. 1 ..
16.313.m:
Īśvara said:
In the north-western direction from that [place], situated at sixteen bows, / is the one named Uttarārka, who grants immediate confidence. / Having observed the Nimbasaptamī, one is indeed freed from all diseases.

16.313.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya uttarārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 313 ..
16.313.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उत्तरार्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 313 ..
16.313.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Uttarārka', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.314.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha devakulāgneyyāṃ gavyūtyā tatra saṃsthitam ..
samudrasya taṭe ramyamṛṣitīrthamanuttamam .. 1 ..
16.314.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ देवकुलाग्नेय्यां गव्यूत्या तत्र संस्थितम् ..
समुद्रस्य तटे रम्यमृषितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
16.314.m:
Īśvara said:
Now, south-east of Devakula, situated at a distance of one gavyūti, / on the shore of the ocean, is the charming, unsurpassed Ṛṣitīrtha.

16.314.s:
pāṣāṇākṛtayastatra ṛṣayo'dyāpi saṃsthitāḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte mānuṣe devi sarvapātakanāśanāḥ .. 2 ..
16.314.d:
पाषाणाकृतयस्तत्र ऋषयोऽद्यापि संस्थिताः ..
दृश्यंते मानुषे देवि सर्वपातकनाशनाः .. 2 ..
16.314.m: There the ṛṣis, in the form of stones, remain even today. / They are seen in human form, O goddess, destroying all sins.

16.314.s:
tatra jyeṣṭhe tvamāvāsyāṃ prāpyate nādhamairnnaraiḥ ..
piṃḍadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.314.d:
तत्र ज्येष्ठे त्वमावास्यां प्राप्यते नाधमैर्न्नरैः ..
पिंडदानं विशेषेण स्नानं श्रद्धासमन्वितैः .. 3 ..
16.314.m: There, the new moon day in Jyeṣṭha cannot be attained by base men. / Offering of piṇḍas, and especially ritual ablution, should be performed by those endowed with faith.

16.314.s:
ṛṣitoyāsaṃgame tu snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ sudurlabham ..
gopradānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tatra te munipugavāḥ ..
bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu yathāśaktyā pradāpayet ..4..
16.314.d:
ऋषितोयासंगमे तु स्नानं श्राद्धं सुदुर्लभम् ..
गोप्रदानं प्रशंसंति तत्र ते मुनिपुगवाः ..
भोजनं ब्राह्मणानां तु यथाशक्त्या प्रदापयेत् ..4..
16.314.m: Ritual ablution and śrāddha at the confluence of the Ṛṣitoyā are exceedingly difficult to attain. / Those best among sages praise the gift of a cow there. / One should feed brahmins according to one's capacity.

16.314.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mūlacaṃḍīśamāhātmya ṛṣitīrthasaṃgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 314 ..
16.314.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मूलचंडीशमाहात्म्य ऋषितीर्थसंगममाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 314 ..
16.314.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fourteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Mūlacaṇḍīśa and the Confluence at Ṛṣitīrtha', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.315.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi marudāryāṃ mahāprabhām ..
tasmātpaścimadigbhāge krośārddhena vyavasthitām .. 1 ..
16.315.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि मरुदार्यां महाप्रभाम् ..
तस्मात्पश्चिमदिग्भागे क्रोशार्द्धेन व्यवस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.315.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to Marudāryā of great splendor, / situated half a krośa to the west of that [place],

16.315.s:
marudbhiḥ pūjitāṃ devīṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām ..
mahānavamyāṃ yatnena saptamyāṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
gaṃdhapuṣpādividhinā sarvakāmaprasiddhaye .. 2 ..
16.315.d:
मरुद्भिः पूजितां देवीं सर्वकामफलप्रदाम् ..
महानवम्यां यत्नेन सप्तम्यां पूजयेन्नरः ..
गंधपुष्पादिविधिना सर्वकामप्रसिद्धये .. 2 ..
16.315.m: the goddess worshipped by the Maruts, who bestows the fruit of all desires. / A man should diligently worship her on Mahānavamī or on the seventh day / with scents, flowers, and other prescribed rites, for the attainment of all desires.

16.315.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye marudāryādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 315 ..
16.315.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मरुदार्यादेवीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचदशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 315 ..
16.315.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fifteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Goddess Marudāryā', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.316.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha devakulātpūrve paṃcagavyūtimātrataḥ ..
śaṃbarasthāna madhye tu kṣemādityeti viśrutaḥ .. 1 ..
16.316.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ देवकुलात्पूर्वे पंचगव्यूतिमात्रतः ..
शंबरस्थान मध्ये तु क्षेमादित्येति विश्रुतः .. 1 ..
16.316.m:
Īśvara said:
Now, five gavyūtis to the east of Devakula, / in the midst of the site of Śambara, is the one celebrated as Kṣemāditya.

16.316.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi bhavetkṣemārthasiddhibhāk ..
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa pūjitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ .. 2 ..
16.316.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि भवेत्क्षेमार्थसिद्धिभाक् ..
सप्तम्यां रविवारेण पूजितः सर्वकामदः .. 2 ..
16.316.m: Having seen him, O goddess, a mortal attains safety and the realization of his goals. / Worshipped on a Sunday on the seventh lunar day, he grants all desires.
Thus has the location of the tīrthas in the locality of Devakula been described.

16.316.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye kṣemādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 316 ..
16.316.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये क्षेमादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षोडशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 316 ..
16.316.m: Thus ends the three hundred and sixteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kṣemāditya', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.317.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ kaṃṭakaśoṣiṇīm ..
uttareṇa devakulāddakṣiṇenonnatātsthitāt .. 1 ..
16.317.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवीं कंटकशोषिणीम् ..
उत्तरेण देवकुलाद्दक्षिणेनोन्नतात्स्थितात् .. 1 ..
16.317.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the goddess Kaṇṭakaśoṣiṇī, / situated north of Devakula and south of Unnata.

16.317.s:
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanāḥ priye ..
unnatāddakṣiṇe bhāge yajaṃte dvijasattamāḥ .. 2 ..
16.317.d:
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु ह्येकमनाः प्रिये ..
उन्नताद्दक्षिणे भागे यजंते द्विजसत्तमाः .. 2 ..
16.317.m: I shall relate her origin; listen attentively, O beloved. / To the south of Unnata, the best among the twice-born were performing sacrifices:

16.317.s:
bhṛguratrirmarīciśca bharadvājo'tha kaśyapaḥ ..
kaṇvo maṃkiśca sāvarṇirjātūkarṇyastathaiva ca .. 3 ..
16.317.d:
भृगुरत्रिर्मरीचिश्च भरद्वाजोऽथ कश्यपः ..
कण्वो मंकिश्च सावर्णिर्जातूकर्ण्यस्तथैव च .. 3 ..
16.317.m: Bhṛgu, Atri, Marīci, Bharadvāja, and Kaśyapa, / Kaṇva, Maṅki, Sāvarṇi, and likewise Jātūkarṇya,

16.317.s:
vatsaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ..
manuryamoṃ'girā viṣṇuḥ śātātapaparāśarau .. 4 ..
16.317.d:
वत्सश्चैव वसिष्ठश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ..
मनुर्यमोंऽगिरा विष्णुः शातातपपराशरौ .. 4 ..
16.317.m: Vatsa, Vasiṣṭha, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Manu, Yama, Aṅgiras, Viṣṇu, Śātātapa, Parāśara,

16.317.s:
śāṃḍilyaḥ kauśikaścaiva gautamo gārgya eva ca ..
dālbhyaśca śaunakaścaiva śākalyo gālavastathā .. 5 ..
16.317.d:
शांडिल्यः कौशिकश्चैव गौतमो गार्ग्य एव च ..
दाल्भ्यश्च शौनकश्चैव शाकल्यो गालवस्तथा .. 5 ..
16.317.m: Śāṇḍilya, Kauśika, Gautama, Gārgya, / Dālbhya, Śaunaka, Śākalya, and Gālava,

16.317.s:
jābālirmudgalaścaiva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṃḍakaḥ ..
viśvāmitraḥ śatānaṃdo jahnurviśvāvasustathā .. 6 ..
16.317.d:
जाबालिर्मुद्गलश्चैव ऋष्यशृंगो विभांडकः ..
विश्वामित्रः शतानंदो जह्नुर्विश्वावसुस्तथा .. 6 ..
16.317.m: Jābāli, Mudgala, Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Vibhāṇḍaka, / Viśvāmitra, Śatānanda, Jahnu, and Viśvāvasu.

16.317.s:
ete cānye ca munayo yajaṃte vividhairmakhaiḥ ..
yajñavāṭaṃ ca nirmāya ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe .. 7 ..
16.317.d:
एते चान्ये च मुनयो यजंते विविधैर्मखैः ..
यज्ञवाटं च निर्माय ऋषितोयातटे शुभे .. 7 ..
16.317.m: These and other sages were sacrificing with various offerings, / having erected a sacrificial enclosure on the auspicious bank of the Ṛṣitoyā,

16.317.s:
devagandharvanṛtyaiśca veṇuvīṇānināditam ..
vedadhvanitaghoṣeṇa yajñahomāgnihotrajaiḥ .. 8 ..
16.317.d:
देवगन्धर्वनृत्यैश्च वेणुवीणानिनादितम् ..
वेदध्वनितघोषेण यज्ञहोमाग्निहोत्रजैः .. 8 ..
16.317.m: resounding with the dances of gods and gandharvas, with flutes and viṇās, / with the echoing sound of Vedic chanting, and with the sounds born of sacrifices, homas, and agnihotras;

16.317.s:
dhūpaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ sarvamājyagaṃdhibhirarcitam ..
śobhitaṃ munibhirdivyaiścāturvedyairdvijottamaiḥ .. 9 ..
16.317.d:
धूपैः समावृतं सर्वमाज्यगंधिभिरर्चितम् ..
शोभितं मुनिभिर्दिव्यैश्चातुर्वेद्यैर्द्विजोत्तमैः .. 9 ..
16.317.m: entirely enveloped in incenses, fragrant with ghee, and worshipped, / adorned by divine sages, the best of the twice-born learned in the four Vedas.

16.317.s:
evaṃvidhaṃ pradeśaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā daityā mahābalāḥ ..
samudramadhyādāyātā yajñavidhvaṃsahetave .. 7.1.317.10 ..
16.317.d:
एवंविधं प्रदेशं तु दृष्ट्वा दैत्या महाबलाः ..
समुद्रमध्यादायाता यज्ञविध्वंसहेतवे .. 7.1.317.10 ..
16.317.m: Seeing such a place, the demons of great strength / emerged from the midst of the ocean to destroy the sacrifice.

16.317.s:
māyāvino mahākāyāḥ śyāmavarṇā mahodarāḥ ..
laṃbabhrūśmaśrunāsāgrā raktākṣā raktamūrdhajāḥ .. 11 ..
16.317.d:
मायाविनो महाकायाः श्यामवर्णा महोदराः ..
लंबभ्रूश्मश्रुनासाग्रा रक्ताक्षा रक्तमूर्धजाः .. 11 ..
16.317.m: Deceitful, huge-bodied, dark in complexion, large-bellied, / with drooping eyebrows, beards, and noses, red-eyed, and red-haired,

16.317.s:
yajñaṃ samāgatāḥ sarve daityāścaiva varānane ..
tāndṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve raudrarūpānbhayaṃkarān .. 12 ..
16.317.d:
यज्ञं समागताः सर्वे दैत्याश्चैव वरानने ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे रौद्ररूपान्भयंकरान् .. 12 ..
16.317.m: all those Daityas arrived at the sacrifice, O fair-faced one! / Seeing them, fearful and of terrible forms,

16.317.s:
kecinnipatitā bhūmau tathānye 'gnau srucīkarāḥ ..
patnīśālāṃ samāviṣṭā havirdhānaṃ tathā pare .. 13 ..
16.317.d:
केचिन्निपतिता भूमौ तथान्ये ऽग्नौ स्रुचीकराः ..
पत्नीशालां समाविष्टा हविर्धानं तथा परे .. 13 ..
16.317.m: some [munis] fell to the ground, while others stood holding sacrificial ladles near the fire; / some entered the hall of the wife, and others the storeroom for offerings;

16.317.s: ṛtvijastu sadomadhye sthitā vācaṃyamāstathā .. 14 ..
16.317.d: ऋत्विजस्तु सदोमध्ये स्थिता वाचंयमास्तथा .. 14 ..
16.317.m: while the officiating priests remained silent in the sacrificial assembly.

16.317.s:
evaṃ devi yadā vṛttaṃ munīnāṃ ca mahātmanām ..
tadādhvaryurmahātejā dhairyamālambya sādaraḥ .. 15 ..
16.317.d:
एवं देवि यदा वृत्तं मुनीनां च महात्मनाम् ..
तदाध्वर्युर्महातेजा धैर्यमालम्ब्य सादरः .. 15 ..
16.317.m: When this happened to the high-souled sages, O goddess, / the Adhvaryu priest of great splendour, taking courage and acting with care,

16.317.s:
agnihotraṃ haviṣyaṃ ca havirvinyasya mantravit ..
susamiddhaṃ juhāvāgniṃ rakṣasāṃ nāśahetave .. 16 ..
16.317.d:
अग्निहोत्रं हविष्यं च हविर्विन्यस्य मन्त्रवित् ..
सुसमिद्धं जुहावाग्निं रक्षसां नाशहेतवे .. 16 ..
16.317.m: knowing the mantras, arranged the fire offering and the sacrificial food, / and offered oblations into the well-kindled fire to destroy the Rākṣasas.

16.317.s:
hute haviṣi deveśi tatkṣaṇādeva cotthitā ..
śaktiḥ śaktitriśūlāḍhyā carmahastā mahojjvalā .. 17 ..
16.317.d:
हुते हविषि देवेशि तत्क्षणादेव चोत्थिता ..
शक्तिः शक्तित्रिशूलाढ्या चर्महस्ता महोज्ज्वला .. 17 ..
16.317.m: When the oblation was offered, O ruler of the gods, instantly there arose / a Śakti, equipped with a spear and a trident, holding a shield, intensely blazing.

16.317.s:
tayā te nihatā daityā yajñavidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ ..
tatastāṃ vividhaiḥ stotrairmunayastuṣṭuvustadā .. 18 ..
16.317.d:
तया ते निहता दैत्या यज्ञविध्वंसकारिणः ..
ततस्तां विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्मुनयस्तुष्टुवुस्तदा .. 18 ..
16.317.m: By her those Daityas, who were destroying the sacrifice, were slain. / Then the sages praised her with various hymns.

16.317.s:
prasannā bhūyasī devī tānṛṣīnpratyuvāca ha ..
varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ munayo dāsyāmi varamuttamam.. 19 ..
16.317.d:
प्रसन्ना भूयसी देवी तानृषीन्प्रत्युवाच ह ..
वरं वृणुध्वं मुनयो दास्यामि वरमुत्तमम्.. 19 ..
16.317.m: Greatly pleased, the goddess spoke to those seers: / “Choose a boon, O sages; I shall grant an excellent boon.”

16.317.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kṛtaṃ vai sakalaṃ kāryaṃ yajñā no rakṣitāstvayā ..
yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ tvayā cāsuramarddini .. 7.1.317.20 ..
16.317.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कृतं वै सकलं कार्यं यज्ञा नो रक्षितास्त्वया ..
यदि देयो वरोऽस्माकं त्वया चासुरमर्द्दिनि .. 7.1.317.20 ..
16.317.m: The seers said: / “All our purpose has indeed been achieved; our sacrifices have been protected by you. / If a boon is to be given to us by you, O crusher of Asuras,

16.317.s:
asminsthāne sadā tiṣṭha munīnāṃ hitakāmyayā ..
kaṃṭakāḥ śoṣitā daityāstena kaṃṭakaśoṣiṇī ..
adyaprabhṛti nāmāstu tena devi sadā tviha .. 21 ..
16.317.d:
अस्मिन्स्थाने सदा तिष्ठ मुनीनां हितकाम्यया ..
कंटकाः शोषिता दैत्यास्तेन कंटकशोषिणी ..
अद्यप्रभृति नामास्तु तेन देवि सदा त्विह .. 21 ..
16.317.m: remain always in this place out of desire for the welfare of the sages. / The Daityas, who were thorns, have been withered; hence let your name / always be Kaṇṭakaśoṣiṇī (‘Withering the Thorns’) here from this day forward, O goddess.”

16.317.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā sā devyantarhitā tadā ..
aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā pūjayiṣyati mā navaḥ .. 22 ..
16.317.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा सा देव्यन्तर्हिता तदा ..
अष्टम्यां वा नवम्यां वा पूजयिष्यति मा नवः .. 22 ..
16.317.m: Īśvara said: / Having said, “So it shall be,” the goddess vanished then. / If a man worships me on the eighth or ninth lunar day,

16.317.s:
rākṣasebhyaḥ piśācebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate ..
prāpnuyātparamāṃ siddhiṃ mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 23 ..
16.317.d:
राक्षसेभ्यः पिशाचेभ्यो भयं तस्य न जायते ..
प्राप्नुयात्परमां सिद्धिं मानवो नात्र संशयः .. 23 ..
16.317.m: no fear arises for him from Rākṣasas or Piśācas. / That man would attain supreme perfection; of this there is no doubt.

16.317.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kaṃṭakaśoṣaṇīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..317.. ..
16.317.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कंटकशोषणीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः ..317.. ..
16.317.m: Thus ends the three hundred and seventeenth chapter, entitled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Kaṇṭakaśoṣaṇī’, in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.318.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.318.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्याश्च पूर्वदिग्भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.318.m: Īśvara said: / In the eastern direction from it, not very far away, / is situated a liṅga of great power, destroying all sins,

16.318.s:
brahmeśvareti nāmāḍhyaṃ brāhmaṇaiśca pratiṣṭhitam ..
ṛṣitoyājale snātvā talliṃgaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet ..
sa bhavedvedavidvipro jāḍyabhāvavivarjitaḥ .. 2 ..
16.318.d:
ब्रह्मेश्वरेति नामाढ्यं ब्राह्मणैश्च प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
ऋषितोयाजले स्नात्वा तल्लिंगं यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
स भवेद्वेदविद्विप्रो जाड्यभावविवर्जितः .. 2 ..
16.318.m: known by the name Brahmeśvara, consecrated by brahmins. / Whoever bathes in the waters of the Ṛṣitoyā and worships that liṅga / will become a brahmin versed in the Vedas, freed from dullness.

16.318.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaratriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 318 ..
16.318.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोत्तरत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 318 ..
16.318.m: Thus ends the three hundred and eighteenth chapter, entitled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Brahmeśvara’, in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.319.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi hyunnatasthānamuttamam ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāga ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe .. 1 ..
16.319.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि ह्युन्नतस्थानमुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भाग ऋषितोयातटे शुभे .. 1 ..
16.319.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent, elevated place / in the northern direction of that very [shrine], on the auspicious bank of the Ṛṣitoyā.

16.319.s:
etatsthānaṃ mahādevi viprebhyaḥ prādadāṃ balāt ..
sarvasīmāsamāyuktaṃ caṃḍīgaṇasurakṣitam .. 2 ..
16.319.d:
एतत्स्थानं महादेवि विप्रेभ्यः प्राददां बलात् ..
सर्वसीमासमायुक्तं चंडीगणसुरक्षितम् .. 2 ..
16.319.m: This place, O great goddess, I gave by force to the brahmins, / endowed with all boundaries and well protected by the attendants of Caṇḍī.

16.319.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathamunnatanāmāsya babhūva surasattama ..
kathaṃ tvayā balāddattaṃ kiyatsīmāsamanvitam .. 3 ..
16.319.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथमुन्नतनामास्य बभूव सुरसत्तम ..
कथं त्वया बलाद्दत्तं कियत्सीमासमन्वितम् .. 3 ..
16.319.m: The goddess said: / How did its name become Unnata, O best of gods? / How was it given by you by force, and with what extent of boundaries?

16.319.s: etatsarvaṃ mamācakṣva saṃkṣepānnātivistarāt .. 4 ..
16.319.d: एतत्सर्वं ममाचक्ष्व संक्षेपान्नातिविस्तरात् .. 4 ..
16.319.m: Explain all this to me in brief, not in great detail.

16.319.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.319.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 5 ..
16.319.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall tell the story that destroys sins, / hearing which a man is freed from all sins, O goddess.

16.319.s:
etatsarvaṃ purā proktaṃ sthānasaṃketakāraṇam ..
tṛtīye brahmaṇaḥ kuṃḍe sṛṣṭisaṃkṣepasūcake .. 6 ..
16.319.d:
एतत्सर्वं पुरा प्रोक्तं स्थानसंकेतकारणम् ..
तृतीये ब्रह्मणः कुंडे सृष्टिसंक्षेपसूचके .. 6 ..
16.319.m: All this reason for the designation of the place was told formerly, / in the third pool of Brahmā, which indicates the summary of creation.

16.319.s: tathāpi te pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepācchuṇu pārvati .. 7 ..
16.319.d: तथापि ते प्रवक्ष्यामि संक्षेपाच्छुणु पार्वति .. 7 ..
16.319.m: Even so, I will tell you in brief; listen, O Pārvatī.

16.319.s:
unnāmitaṃ punastatra yatra liṃgaṃ mahodaye ..
tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam.. 8 ..
16.319.d:
उन्नामितं पुनस्तत्र यत्र लिंगं महोदये ..
तदुन्नतमिति प्रोक्तं स्थानं स्थानवतां वरम्.. 8 ..
16.319.m: Because the liṅga was raised up there again in Mahodaya, / that place is called Unnata (‘Elevated’), the best of places.

16.319.s:
athavā connataṃ dvāraṃ pūrvaṃ prābhāsikasya vai ..
tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam .. 9 ..
16.319.d:
अथवा चोन्नतं द्वारं पूर्वं प्राभासिकस्य वै ..
तदुन्नतमिति प्रोक्तं स्थानं स्थानवतां वरम् .. 9 ..
16.319.m: Or because the eastern gate of the Prabhāsa region is high, / that place is called Unnata, the best of places.

16.319.s:
vidyayā tapasā caiva yatrotkṛṣṭā maharṣayaḥ ..
tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam .. 7.1.319.10 ..
16.319.d:
विद्यया तपसा चैव यत्रोत्कृष्टा महर्षयः ..
तदुन्नतमिति प्रोक्तं स्थानं स्थानवतां वरम् .. 7.1.319.10 ..
16.319.m: Because the great seers became elevated there through knowledge and austerity, / that place is called Unnata, the best of places.

16.319.s:
yadā devakule viprā mūlacaṃḍīśasaṃjñakam ..
prasādya ca mahādevaṃ punaḥ prāptā mahodayam .. 11 ..
16.319.d:
यदा देवकुले विप्रा मूलचंडीशसंज्ञकम् ..
प्रसाद्य च महादेवं पुनः प्राप्ता महोदयम् .. 11 ..
16.319.m: When the brahmins in Devakula propitiated Mahādeva, / called Mūlacaṇḍīśa, and came again to Mahodaya,

16.319.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepurmaharṣayaḥ ..
dhyāyamānā maheśānamanādinidhanaṃ param .. 12 ..
16.319.d:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तेपुर्महर्षयः ..
ध्यायमाना महेशानमनादिनिधनं परम् .. 12 ..
16.319.m: the great seers performed austerities for sixty thousand years, / meditating on Maheśāna, the supreme, without beginning or end.

16.319.s:
teṣu vai tapyamāneṣu koṭisaṃkhyeṣu pārvati ..
ṛṣitoyātaṭe ramye pavitre pāpanāśane ..
bhikṣurbhūtvā gataścāhaṃ punastatraiva bhāmini .. 13 ..
16.319.d:
तेषु वै तप्यमानेषु कोटिसंख्येषु पार्वति ..
ऋषितोयातटे रम्ये पवित्रे पापनाशने ..
भिक्षुर्भूत्वा गतश्चाहं पुनस्तत्रैव भामिनि .. 13 ..
16.319.m: While they, numbered in tens of millions, were practicing austerity, O Pārvatī, / on the lovely, pure, sin-destroying bank of the Ṛṣitoyā, / I went there again as a mendicant, O passionate lady.

16.319.s:
trikālaṃ darśibhistatra doṣarāgavivarjitaiḥ ..
tapasvibhistadā sarvairlakṣito'haṃ varānane .. 14 ..
16.319.d:
त्रिकालं दर्शिभिस्तत्र दोषरागविवर्जितैः ..
तपस्विभिस्तदा सर्वैर्लक्षितोऽहं वरानने .. 14 ..
16.319.m: Then, by those ascetics who saw the three divisions of time and were free from fault and passion, / I was noticed by them all, O fair-faced one.

16.319.s:
dṛṣṭamātrastadā viprairvirarāma maheśvaraḥ ..
kva yāsi vidito deva ityuktvānuyayurdvijāḥ .. 15 ..
16.319.d:
दृष्टमात्रस्तदा विप्रैर्विरराम महेश्वरः ..
क्व यासि विदितो देव इत्युक्त्वानुययुर्द्विजाः .. 15 ..
16.319.m: As soon as he was seen by the brahmins, Maheśvara paused. / Saying, “Where are you going, O God, [now that you are] recognised?”, the twice-born followed.

16.319.s:
yāvadāyāṃti munaya īśeśeti prabhāṣakāḥ ..
dhāvamānāḥ svatapasā dyotayanto diśodaśa .. 16 ..
16.319.d:
यावदायांति मुनय ईशेशेति प्रभाषकाः ..
धावमानाः स्वतपसा द्योतयन्तो दिशोदश .. 16 ..
16.319.m: While the sages were coming, calling out, “O Lord, O Lord!”, / running and illuminating the ten directions with their austerity,

16.319.s: liṃgameva prapaśyaṃti na paśyaṃti maheśvaram .. 17 ..
16.319.d: लिंगमेव प्रपश्यंति न पश्यंति महेश्वरम् .. 17 ..
16.319.m: they saw only the liṅga; they did not see Maheśvara.

16.319.s:
yeye ca dadṛśurliṃgaṃ mūlacaṇḍīśasaṃjñakam ..
tadā ca munayaḥ sarve sadehāḥ svargamāyayuḥ .. 18 ..
16.319.d:
येये च ददृशुर्लिंगं मूलचण्डीशसंज्ञकम् ..
तदा च मुनयः सर्वे सदेहाः स्वर्गमाययुः .. 18 ..
16.319.m: And whoever saw the liṅga called Mūlacaṇḍīśa, / all those sages then went to heaven along with their physical bodies.

16.319.s:
yadā triviṣṭapaṃ vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vai śatayajvanā ..
āyāṃti ca tathaivānye munayastapasojvalāḥ .. 19 ..
16.319.d:
यदा त्रिविष्टपं व्याप्तं दृष्टं वै शतयज्वना ..
आयांति च तथैवान्ये मुनयस्तपसोज्वलाः .. 19 ..
16.319.m: When heaven was seen filled [with sages] by Indra, / and other sages blazing with austerity were coming in the same way,

16.319.s:
etadaṃtaramāsādya samāgatya mahītale ..
liṃgamācchādayāmāsa vajreṇaiva śatakratuḥ .. 7.1.319.20 ..
16.319.d:
एतदंतरमासाद्य समागत्य महीतले ..
लिंगमाच्छादयामास वज्रेणैव शतक्रतुः .. 7.1.319.20 ..
16.319.m: finding this interval, Indra arrived on the earth / and covered that liṅga with his thunderbolt.

16.319.s:
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ..
sthitāni na tu paśyaṃti liṃgametadanuttamam .. 21 ..
16.319.d:
अष्टादशसहस्राणि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
स्थितानि न तु पश्यंति लिंगमेतदनुत्तमम् .. 21 ..
16.319.m: Eighteen thousand sages of celibate vows / stood there, but they could not see this peerless liṅga.

16.319.s:
śakrastu sahasā dṛṣṭo vajreṇaiva samanvitaḥ ..
yāvadvadaṃti śāpaṃ te tāvannaṣṭaḥ puraṃdaraḥ .. 22..
16.319.d:
शक्रस्तु सहसा दृष्टो वज्रेणैव समन्वितः ..
यावद्वदंति शापं ते तावन्नष्टः पुरंदरः .. 22..
16.319.m: Śakra was suddenly seen endowed with his thunderbolt; / but as soon as they began to pronounce a curse, Puraṃdara vanished.

16.319.s:
dṛṣṭvā tānkopasaṃyuktānbhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ ..
uvāca sāṃtvayandevo vācā madhurayā munīn .. 23 ..
16.319.d:
दृष्ट्वा तान्कोपसंयुक्तान्भगवांस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
उवाच सांत्वयन्देवो वाचा मधुरया मुनीन् .. 23 ..
16.319.m: Seeing them filled with anger, the Lord, the destroyer of Tripura, / consoled the sages, speaking with sweet words:

16.319.s:
kathaṃ khinnā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sadā śāṃtiparāyaṇāḥ ..
prasannavadanā bhūtvā śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama .. 24 ..
16.319.d:
कथं खिन्ना द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सदा शांतिपरायणाः ..
प्रसन्नवदना भूत्वा श्रूयतां वचनं मम .. 24 ..
16.319.m: “Why are you distressed, O best of twice-born, who are always devoted to peace? / Becoming joyful in countenance, listen to my words.

16.319.s:
bhavadbhirjñānasaṃyuktaiḥ svargaḥ kiṃ manyate bahu ..
yatraike vasavaḥ proktā ādityāśca tathā pare ..25 ..
16.319.d:
भवद्भिर्ज्ञानसंयुक्तैः स्वर्गः किं मन्यते बहु ..
यत्रैके वसवः प्रोक्ता आदित्याश्च तथा परे ..25 ..
16.319.m: Why is heaven considered so great by you who are endowed with knowledge? / Where some are called Vasus and others are Ādityas.

16.319.s:
rudrasaṃjñāstathā caike hyaśvināvapi cāparau ..
eteṣāmadhipaḥ kaścideka indraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 26 ..
16.319.d:
रुद्रसंज्ञास्तथा चैके ह्यश्विनावपि चापरौ ..
एतेषामधिपः कश्चिदेक इन्द्रः प्रकीर्तितः .. 26 ..
16.319.m: And others are named Rudras, and two others are the Aśvins; / a certain single Indra is proclaimed as their ruler.

16.319.s:
svapuṇyasaṃkhyayā prāpte yasmādvibhraśyate naraiḥ ..
evaṃ duḥkhasamāyuktaḥ svargo naiveṣyate budhaiḥ .. 27 ..
16.319.d:
स्वपुण्यसंख्यया प्राप्ते यस्माद्विभ्रश्यते नरैः ..
एवं दुःखसमायुक्तः स्वर्गो नैवेष्यते बुधैः .. 27 ..
16.319.m: Because mortals fall from it when the tally of their merits is exhausted, / heaven, being attended with such sorrow, is not desired by the wise.

16.319.s:
etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama ..
gṛhṇīdhvaṃ nagaraṃ ramyaṃ nivāsāya mahāprabham .. 28 ..
16.319.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्राः कुरुध्वं वचनं मम ..
गृह्णीध्वं नगरं रम्यं निवासाय महाप्रभम् .. 28 ..
16.319.m: For this reason, brahmins, heed my word: / accept this lovely, glorious city for your dwelling.

16.319.s:
hūyaṃtāmagnihotrāṇi devatāḥ sarvadā dvijāḥ ..
ijyaṃtāṃ vividhairyāgaiḥ kriyatāṃ pitṛpūjanam .. 29 ..
16.319.d:
हूयंतामग्निहोत्राणि देवताः सर्वदा द्विजाः ..
इज्यंतां विविधैर्यागैः क्रियतां पितृपूजनम् .. 29 ..
16.319.m: Let agnihotra offerings be made, brahmins, and let the gods always / be worshipped with diverse sacrifices, and let ancestral rites be performed.

16.319.s: ātithyaṃ kriyatā nityaṃ vedābhyāsastathaiva hi .. 7.1.319.30 ..
16.319.d: आतिथ्यं क्रियता नित्यं वेदाभ्यासस्तथैव हि .. 7.1.319.30 ..
16.319.m: Let hospitality always be extended, and likewise the study of the Vedas.

16.319.s:
evaṃ hi kurvatāṃ nityaṃ vinā jñānasya saṃcayaiḥ ..
prasādānmama viprendrāḥ prāṃte muktirbhaviṣyati .. 31 ..
16.319.d:
एवं हि कुर्वतां नित्यं विना ज्ञानस्य संचयैः ..
प्रसादान्मम विप्रेन्द्राः प्रांते मुक्तिर्भविष्यति .. 31 ..
16.319.m: For to those who act thus constantly, even without acquiring [metaphysical] knowledge, / liberation will come in the end through my grace, O foremost of brahmins.”

16.319.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
asamarthāḥ paritrāṇe jitāhārāstaponvitāḥ ..
nagareṇeha kiṃ kurmastava bhaktimabhīpsavaḥ .. .. 32 ..
16.319.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
असमर्थाः परित्राणे जिताहारास्तपोन्विताः ..
नगरेणेह किं कुर्मस्तव भक्तिमभीप्सवः .. .. 32 ..
16.319.m: The seers said: / “Incapable of worldly maintenance, having conquered our appetite and devoted to austerity, / what shall we do with a city here, we who desire devotion to you?”

16.319.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyati sadā bhaktiryuṣmākaṃ parameśvare ..
gṛhṇīdhvaṃ nagaraṃ ramyaṃ kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama .. 33 ..
16.319.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
भविष्यति सदा भक्तिर्युष्माकं परमेश्वरे ..
गृह्णीध्वं नगरं रम्यं कुरुध्वं वचनं मम .. 33 ..
16.319.m: Īśvara said: / “You will always possess devotion to the Supreme Lord. / Accept the lovely city and heed my word.”

16.319.s:
ityuktvā bhagavāndeva īṣanmīlitalocanaḥ ..
sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ sarvaśilpavatāṃ varam .. 34 ..
16.319.d:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्देव ईषन्मीलितलोचनः ..
सस्मार विश्वकर्माणं सर्वशिल्पवतां वरम् .. 34 ..
16.319.m: Having spoken thus, the blessed Lord, his eyes slightly closed, / remembered Viśvakarman, the foremost of all craftsmen.

16.319.s:
smṛtamātro viśvakarmā prāṃjaliścāgrataḥ sthitaḥ ..
ājñāpayatu māṃ devo vacanaṃ karavāṇi te .. 35 ..
16.319.d:
स्मृतमात्रो विश्वकर्मा प्रांजलिश्चाग्रतः स्थितः ..
आज्ञापयतु मां देवो वचनं करवाणि ते .. 35 ..
16.319.m: As soon as he was remembered, Viśvakarman stood before him with folded hands: / “May the Lord command me; I shall carry out your bidding.”

16.319.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
nagaraṃ kriyatāṃ tvaṣṭarviprārthaṃ suṃdaraṃ śubham .. 36 ..
16.319.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
नगरं क्रियतां त्वष्टर्विप्रार्थं सुंदरं शुभम् .. 36 ..
16.319.m: Īśvara said: / “Tvaṣṭṛ, let a beautiful, auspicious city be built for the brahmins.”

16.319.s:
ityukto viśvakarmā sa bhūmiṃ vīkṣya samaṃtataḥ ..
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram .. 37 ..
16.319.d:
इत्युक्तो विश्वकर्मा स भूमिं वीक्ष्य समंततः ..
उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा शंकरं लोकशंकरम् .. 37 ..
16.319.m: Thus addressed, Viśvakarman surveyed the land all around / and, bowing down, spoke to Śaṃkara, the benefactor of the world:

16.319.s:
parīkṣitā mayā bhūmirna yuktaṃ nagaraṃ tviha ..
atra devakulaṃ sākṣālliṃgasya patanaṃ tathā .. 38 ..
16.319.d:
परीक्षिता मया भूमिर्न युक्तं नगरं त्विह ..
अत्र देवकुलं साक्षाल्लिंगस्य पतनं तथा .. 38 ..
16.319.m: “I have examined the ground, but a city here is not fitting. / Here is a temple of the gods directly, and likewise the falling of the liṅga.

16.319.s: yatibhiścātra vastavyaṃ na yuktaṃ gṛhamedhinām .. 39 ..
16.319.d: यतिभिश्चात्र वस्तव्यं न युक्तं गृहमेधिनाम् .. 39 ..
16.319.m: Ascetics must dwell here; it is not fitting for householders.

16.319.s:
trirātraṃ paṃcarātraṃ vā saptarātraṃ maheśvara ..
pakṣaṃ māsamṛtuṃ vāpi hyayanaṃ yāvadeva ca ..
putradārayutaistīrthe vastavyaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ .. 7.1.319.40 ..
16.319.d:
त्रिरात्रं पंचरात्रं वा सप्तरात्रं महेश्वर ..
पक्षं मासमृतुं वापि ह्ययनं यावदेव च ..
पुत्रदारयुतैस्तीर्थे वस्तव्यं गृहमेधिभिः .. 7.1.319.40 ..
16.319.m: For three nights, or five nights, or seven nights, O Maheśvara, / a fortnight, a month, a season, or even up to a half-year: / for so long may householders dwell at a sacred ford accompanied by sons and wives.

16.319.s:
vasatyūrdhvaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsādyadā tīrthe gṛhādhipaḥ ..
avajñā jāyate tasya manaścāpalyabhāvataḥ ..
tadā dharmādvinaśyaṃti sakalā gṛhamedhinaḥ .. 41 ..
16.319.d:
वसत्यूर्ध्वं तु षण्मासाद्यदा तीर्थे गृहाधिपः ..
अवज्ञा जायते तस्य मनश्चापल्यभावतः ..
तदा धर्माद्विनश्यंति सकला गृहमेधिनः .. 41 ..
16.319.m: When a householder dwells at a sacred ford beyond six months, / disregard arises in him due to the fickleness of the mind; / then all householders fall away from dharma.”

16.319.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā devastena vai viśvakarmaṇā ..
punaḥ provāca taṃ tasya praśasya vacanaṃ śivaḥ .. 42 ..
16.319.d:
इत्युक्तः स तदा देवस्तेन वै विश्वकर्मणा ..
पुनः प्रोवाच तं तस्य प्रशस्य वचनं शिवः .. 42 ..
16.319.m: Thus addressed at that time by Viśvakarman, / the divine Śiva praised his words and spoke to him again:

16.319.s:
rocate me na vāso'tra viprāṇāṃ gṛhamedhinām ..
yatra connāmitaṃ liṃgamṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe ..
tatra nirmāpaya tvaṣṭarnagaraṃ śilpināṃ vara .. 43 ..
16.319.d:
रोचते मे न वासोऽत्र विप्राणां गृहमेधिनाम् ..
यत्र चोन्नामितं लिंगमृषितोयातटे शुभे ..
तत्र निर्मापय त्वष्टर्नगरं शिल्पिनां वर .. 43 ..
16.319.m: “The dwelling of householder brahmins here does not please me either. / Where the liṅga was raised on the auspicious bank of the Ṛṣitoyā, / build the city there, Tvaṣṭṛ, O foremost of craftsmen.”

16.319.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā tvarānvitaḥ ..
gatvā cakāra nagaraṃ śilpikoṭibhirāvṛtaḥ .. 44 ..
16.319.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्मा त्वरान्वितः ..
गत्वा चकार नगरं शिल्पिकोटिभिरावृतः .. 44 ..
16.319.m: Hearing his words, Viśvakarman hastened / and, surrounded by millions of craftsmen, went and built the city,

16.319.s:
unnataṃ nāma yalloke vikhyātaṃ surasundari ..
tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā vilokya nagaraṃ śivaḥ ..
āhūya brāhmaṇānsarvānuvācānatakandharaḥ ..45 ..
16.319.d:
उन्नतं नाम यल्लोके विख्यातं सुरसुन्दरि ..
ततो हृष्टमना भूत्वा विलोक्य नगरं शिवः ..
आहूय ब्राह्मणान्सर्वानुवाचानतकन्धरः ..45 ..
16.319.m: known in the world by the name Unnata, O beautiful goddess of the gods. / Then, pleased at heart, Śiva gazed upon the city, / and having summoned all the brahmins, spoke with his neck bent low:

16.319.s:
idaṃ sthānaṃ varaṃ ramyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ..
grāmāṇāṃ ca sahasraistu proktaṃ sarvāsu dikṣu ca..46 ..
16.319.d:
इदं स्थानं वरं रम्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ..
ग्रामाणां च सहस्रैस्तु प्रोक्तं सर्वासु दिक्षु च..46 ..
16.319.m: “This excellent, delightful place was fashioned by Viśvakarman; / it is declared [to extend] in all directions along with thousands of villages.

16.319.s:
nagarātsarvataḥ puṇyo deśo nagnaharaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
aṣṭayojanavistīrṇa āyāmavyāsatastathā .. 47 ..
16.319.d:
नगरात्सर्वतः पुण्यो देशो नग्नहरः स्मृतः ..
अष्टयोजनविस्तीर्ण आयामव्यासतस्तथा .. 47 ..
16.319.m: All around the city is the sacred region remembered as Nagnahara, / measuring eight yojanas in length and breadth.

16.319.s:
nagno bhūtvā haro yatra deśe bhrāṃto yadṛcchayā ..
taṃ nagnaharamityāhurdeśaṃ puṇyatamaṃ janāḥ .. 48 ..
16.319.d:
नग्नो भूत्वा हरो यत्र देशे भ्रांतो यदृच्छया ..
तं नग्नहरमित्याहुर्देशं पुण्यतमं जनाः .. 48 ..
16.319.m: The region where Hara wandered at will having become naked, / people call that most sacred region Nagnahara.

16.319.s:
pūrve tu śāṃkarī cā''ryā paścime nyaṃkumatyapi ..
uttare kanakanaṃdā dakṣiṇe sāgarāvadhiḥ ..
etadaṃtaramāsādya deśo nagnaharaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 49 ..
16.319.d:
पूर्वे तु शांकरी चा'ऽर्या पश्चिमे न्यंकुमत्यपि ..
उत्तरे कनकनंदा दक्षिणे सागरावधिः ..
एतदंतरमासाद्य देशो नग्नहरः स्मृतः .. 49 ..
16.319.m: To the east is the noble Śāṃkarī, and to the west the Nyaṅkumatī, / to the north the Kanakanandā, and to the south the ocean is its boundary; / reaching this intermediate space, the region is remembered as Nagnahara.

16.319.s:
aṣṭayojanamānena āyāmavyāsatastathā ..
prokto'yaṃ sakalo deśa unnatena samaṃ mayā .. 7.1.319.50 ..
16.319.d:
अष्टयोजनमानेन आयामव्यासतस्तथा ..
प्रोक्तोऽयं सकलो देश उन्नतेन समं मया .. 7.1.319.50 ..
16.319.m: With a measure of eight yojanas in length and breadth, / this entire region together with Unnata has been proclaimed by me.

16.319.s:
gṛhyatāṃ nagaraśreṣṭhaṃ prasīdadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
atra bhaktiśca muktiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 51 ..
16.319.d:
गृह्यतां नगरश्रेष्ठं प्रसीदध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
अत्र भक्तिश्च मुक्तिश्च भविष्यति न संशयः .. 51 ..
16.319.m: Accept this foremost of cities, be pleased, O best of brahmins; / here both devotion and liberation will come to pass, no doubt.”

16.319.s: ityuktāste tadā sarve viprā ūcurmaheśvaram .. 52 ..
16.319.d: इत्युक्तास्ते तदा सर्वे विप्रा ऊचुर्महेश्वरम् .. 52 ..
16.319.m: Thus addressed, all the brahmins then spoke to Maheśvara.

16.319.s:
.. viprā ūcuḥ .. ..
īśvarājñā vṛthā kartuṃ na śakyā paramātmanaḥ ..
tapo'gnihotraniṣṭhānāṃ vedādhyayanaśālinām ..53..
16.319.d:
.. विप्रा ऊचुः .. ..
ईश्वराज्ञा वृथा कर्तुं न शक्या परमात्मनः ..
तपोऽग्निहोत्रनिष्ठानां वेदाध्ययनशालिनाम् ..53..
16.319.m: The brahmins said: / “The command of the Lord, the Supreme Self, cannot be rendered futile / by those devoted to austerity and agnihotra and accomplished in Vedic recitation.

16.319.s:
asmākaṃ rakṣitā ko'sti kalikāle ca dāruṇe ..
ko dātā''rogyadaḥ kaśca ko vai muktiṃ pradāsyati .. 54 ..
16.319.d:
अस्माकं रक्षिता कोऽस्ति कलिकाले च दारुणे ..
को दाता'ऽरोग्यदः कश्च को वै मुक्तिं प्रदास्यति .. 54 ..
16.319.m: Who is our protector in the dreadful Kali age? / Who will be the giver of health, and who indeed will bestow liberation?”

16.319.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
mahākāla svarūpeṇa sthitvā tīrthe mahodaye ..
nāśayiṣyāmi śatrūnvaḥ samyagārādhito hyaham .. 55 ..
16.319.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
महाकाल स्वरूपेण स्थित्वा तीर्थे महोदये ..
नाशयिष्यामि शत्रून्वः सम्यगाराधितो ह्यहम् .. 55 ..
16.319.m: Īśvara said: / “Remaining in the form of Mahākāla at the Mahodaya sacred ford, / I will destroy your enemies when properly worshipped.

16.319.s:
unnato vighnarājastu vighnacchettā bhaviṣyati ..
gaṇanāthasvarūpo'yaṃ dhanado nidhīnāṃ patiḥ .. 56 ..
16.319.d:
उन्नतो विघ्नराजस्तु विघ्नच्छेत्ता भविष्यति ..
गणनाथस्वरूपोऽयं धनदो निधीनां पतिः .. 56 ..
16.319.m: Unnata, the lord of obstacles, will be the remover of hindrances. / This [other] form of the lord of gaṇas, the giver of wealth, the lord of treasures,

16.319.s:
yuṣmabhyaṃ dāsyati dravyaṃ samyagārādhito'pi saḥ ..
ārogyadāyako nityaṃ durgādityo bhaviṣyati .. 57 ..
16.319.d:
युष्मभ्यं दास्यति द्रव्यं सम्यगाराधितोऽपि सः ..
आरोग्यदायको नित्यं दुर्गादित्यो भविष्यति .. 57 ..
16.319.m: will give you wealth when he too is properly worshipped. / Durgāditya will constantly be the bestower of health.

16.319.s:
mahodayaṃ mahānandadāyakaṃ vo bhaviṣyati ..
samyagārādhito brahmā sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā ..
sarvānkāmāṃśca muktiṃ ca yuṣmabhyaṃ saṃpradāsyati .. 58 ..
16.319.d:
महोदयं महानन्ददायकं वो भविष्यति ..
सम्यगाराधितो ब्रह्मा सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ..
सर्वान्कामांश्च मुक्तिं च युष्मभ्यं संप्रदास्यति .. 58 ..
16.319.m: Mahodaya will be the bestower of great bliss upon you. / Brahmā, when properly worshipped in all undertakings at all times, / will grant you all desires and liberation.”

16.319.s:
.. viprā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tīrthāni tiṣṭhaṃti sarvāṇi surasattama ..
saṃgāleśvaratīrthe ca tathā devakule śive .. .. 59 ..
16.319.d:
.. विप्रा ऊचुः .. ..
यदि तीर्थानि तिष्ठंति सर्वाणि सुरसत्तम ..
संगालेश्वरतीर्थे च तथा देवकुले शिवे .. .. 59 ..
16.319.m: The brahmins said: / “If all the sacred fords remain, O best among the gods, / at the Saṅgāleśvara sacred ford and likewise at the auspicious Devakula,

16.319.s:
kalāvapi mahāraudre hyasmākaṃ pāvanāya vai ..
sthātavyaṃ tarhi gṛhṇīmo nānyathā ca maheśvara .. 7.1.319.60 ..
16.319.d:
कलावपि महारौद्रे ह्यस्माकं पावनाय वै ..
स्थातव्यं तर्हि गृह्णीमो नान्यथा च महेश्वर .. 7.1.319.60 ..
16.319.m: for our purification even in the extremely terrible Kali age, / and if you dwell [there], then we accept it, not otherwise, O Maheśvara.”

16.319.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya dadau tebhyaḥ puraṃ varam ..
saptabhaumaiḥ śaśāṃkābhaiḥ prāsādaiḥ paribhūṣitam ..
nānāgrāmasamāyuktaṃ sarvataḥ sīmayānvitam .. 61 ..
16.319.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय ददौ तेभ्यः पुरं वरम् ..
सप्तभौमैः शशांकाभैः प्रासादैः परिभूषितम् ..
नानाग्रामसमायुक्तं सर्वतः सीमयान्वितम् .. 61 ..
16.319.m: Promising ‘So be it,’ he gave them the excellent city, / adorned with moon-white, seven-storeyed palaces, / endowed with diverse villages, and bounded on all sides.

16.319.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tebhyo hi nagaraṃ dattvā devo maheśvaraḥ ..
dadarśa viśvakarmāṇaṃ prāñjaliṃ purataḥ sthitam .. 62 ..
16.319.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तेभ्यो हि नगरं दत्त्वा देवो महेश्वरः ..
ददर्श विश्वकर्माणं प्राञ्जलिं पुरतः स्थितम् .. 62 ..
16.319.m: Sūta said: / Having thus given the city to them, the divine Maheśvara / saw Viśvakarman standing before him with folded hands.

16.319.s:
.. viśvakarmovāca .. ..
vilokyatāṃ mahādeva nagaraṃ nagaropamam ..
sauvarṇasthalamāruhya nirmitaṃ tvatprasādataḥ .. 63 ..
16.319.d:
.. विश्वकर्मोवाच .. ..
विलोक्यतां महादेव नगरं नगरोपमम् ..
सौवर्णस्थलमारुह्य निर्मितं त्वत्प्रसादतः .. 63 ..
16.319.m: Viśvakarman said: / “Behold, Mahādeva, the city like a city [of the gods], / fashioned by your grace, having ascended this golden terrace.”

16.319.s:
viśvakarmavacaḥ śrutvā bhagavāṃstripurāntakaḥ ..
samāruroha sthalakaṃ saha sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ .. 64 ..
16.319.d:
विश्वकर्मवचः श्रुत्वा भगवांस्त्रिपुरान्तकः ..
समारुरोह स्थलकं सह सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः .. 64 ..
16.319.m: Hearing Viśvakarman's words, the blessed destroyer of Tripura / ascended the terrace together with all the great seers.

16.319.s:
nagaraṃ vilokayāmāsa ramyaṃ prākāramaṇḍitam ..
ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuḥ sarve tatrasthaṃ tripurāntakam ..
tānuvāca mahādevo vṛṇudhvaṃ varamutta mam.. 65 ..
16.319.d:
नगरं विलोकयामास रम्यं प्राकारमण्डितम् ..
ऋषयस्तुष्टुवुः सर्वे तत्रस्थं त्रिपुरान्तकम् ..
तानुवाच महादेवो वृणुध्वं वरमुत्त मम्.. 65 ..
16.319.m: He beheld the delightful city adorned with ramparts. / All the seers praised the destroyer of Tripura who stood there; / Mahādeva said to them: ‘Choose an excellent boon.’”

16.319.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva sthalakeśvaranāmabhṛt ..
avalokayaṃśca nagaraṃ sadā tiṣṭha sthale hara .. 66 ..
16.319.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदि तुष्टो महादेव स्थलकेश्वरनामभृत् ..
अवलोकयंश्च नगरं सदा तिष्ठ स्थले हर .. 66 ..
16.319.m: The seers said: / If you are pleased, O Mahādeva, bearing the name Sthalakeśvara, / gazing upon the city, dwell perpetually on this plateau, O Hara. 66

16.319.s:
ityuktastaistadā devaḥ sthalake'sminsadā sthitaḥ ..
kṛte ratnamayaṃ devi tretāyāṃ ca hiraṇmayam .. 67 ..
16.319.d:
इत्युक्तस्तैस्तदा देवः स्थलकेऽस्मिन्सदा स्थितः ..
कृते रत्नमयं देवि त्रेतायां च हिरण्मयम् .. 67 ..
16.319.m: Thus addressed by them at that time, the god took up perpetual residence on this plateau. / In the Kṛta [Yuga] it was made of gems, O goddess, and in the Tretā made of gold; 67

16.319.s:
raupyaṃ ca dvāpare proktaṃ sthalamaśmamayaṃ kalau ..
evaṃ tatra sthito devaḥ sthalakeśvaranāmataḥ .. 68 ..
16.319.d:
रौप्यं च द्वापरे प्रोक्तं स्थलमश्ममयं कलौ ..
एवं तत्र स्थितो देवः स्थलकेश्वरनामतः .. 68 ..
16.319.m: and in the Dvāpara the plateau is declared to be of silver, and made of stone in the Kali. / Thus the god remained there under the name Sthalakeśvara. 68

16.319.s:
sadā pūjyo mahādeva unnatasthānavāsibhiḥ ..
māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣastatra jāgare .. 69 ..
16.319.d:
सदा पूज्यो महादेव उन्नतस्थानवासिभिः ..
माघे मासि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषस्तत्र जागरे .. 69 ..
16.319.m: Mahādeva is always to be worshipped by dwellers of the Unnata place; / especially on the fourteenth day in the month of Māgha, during the night vigil there. 69

16.319.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi hyunnatasya mahodyam ..
śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 7.1.319.70 ..
16.319.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि ह्युन्नतस्य महोद्यम् ..
श्रुतं पापहरं नॄणां सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 7.1.319.70 ..
16.319.m: Thus this great greatness of Unnata has been told, O goddess; / when heard, it removes mortals' sins and grants the fruits of all desires. 70

16.319.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 319 ..
16.319.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उन्नतस्थानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 319 ..
16.319.m: Thus ends the three hundred and nineteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of the Unnata Place', in the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, the first [part] in the Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 319

16.320.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmācca pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidāgneyasaṃsthitam ..
liṃgadvayaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ viśvakarmapratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.320.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माच्च पूर्वदिग्भागे किञ्चिदाग्नेयसंस्थितम् ..
लिंगद्वयं महापुण्यं विश्वकर्मप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.320.m: Īśvara said: / And to the east of that, situated slightly to the south-east, / is a pair of most holy liṅgas installed by Viśvakarman. 1

16.320.s:
yadā vai nagaraṃ kartuṃ tvaṣṭā tatra samāgataḥ ..
pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ nagaraṃ kṛtavāṃstataḥ .. 2 ..
16.320.d:
यदा वै नगरं कर्तुं त्वष्टा तत्र समागतः ..
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महादेवं नगरं कृतवांस्ततः .. 2 ..
16.320.m: Indeed, when Tvaṣṭṛ arrived there to build the city, / he installed Mahādeva first and then built the city. 2

16.320.s:
kṛtvā ca nagaraṃ ramyaṃ liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
punaḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ rligaṃ tena vai viśvakarmaṇā .. 3 ..
16.320.d:
कृत्वा च नगरं रम्यं लिंगस्यास्य प्रभावतः ..
पुनः प्रतिष्ठितं र्लिगं तेन वै विश्वकर्मणा .. 3 ..
16.320.m: And having built the charming city by the power of this liṅga, / another liṅga was installed by that very Viśvakarman. 3

16.320.s:
karmādau karmaṇaścānte yātrodvāhagṛhādike ..
liṃgadvayaṃ pūjayitvā siddhimāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt .. 4 ..
16.320.d:
कर्मादौ कर्मणश्चान्ते यात्रोद्वाहगृहादिके ..
लिंगद्वयं पूजयित्वा सिद्धिमाप्नोति तत्क्षणात् .. 4 ..
16.320.m: At the beginning and end of any undertaking, on a journey, at a wedding, in housebuilding and the like, / by worshipping the pair of liṅgas, one attains success that very moment. 4

16.320.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena gaṃdhāmṛtarasodakaiḥ ..
naivedyai vividhairdevi liṃgayugmaṃ prapūjayet .. 5 ..
16.320.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन गंधामृतरसोदकैः ..
नैवेद्यै विविधैर्देवि लिंगयुग्मं प्रपूजयेत् .. 5 ..
16.320.m: Therefore, with every effort, with perfumes, nectar-like juices, and water, / and various food offerings, O goddess, one should worship the pair of liṅgas. 5

16.320.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasthānamāhātmye liṃgadvayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 320 ..
16.320.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उन्नतस्थानमाहात्म्ये लिंगद्वयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम विंशोत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 320 ..
16.320.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twentieth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of the Pair of Liṅgas' in the Greatness of the Unnata Place, in the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, the first [part] in the Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 320

16.321.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha te kīrtayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ sthānamuttamam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṝṇāmunnatasthānavāsinām .. 1 ..
16.321.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ ते कीर्तयिष्यामि रहस्यं स्थानमुत्तमम् ..
सर्वपापहरं नॄणामुन्नतस्थानवासिनाम् .. 1 ..
16.321.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall proclaim to you the secret supreme place / that removes all sins for mortals who dwell in the Unnata place: 1

16.321.s:
śreṣṭhadevasya māhātmyaṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
unnatasthānasaṃsthasya devasya bālarūpiṇaḥ ..
yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 2 ..
16.321.d:
श्रेष्ठदेवस्य माहात्म्यं ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ..
उन्नतस्थानसंस्थस्य देवस्य बालरूपिणः ..
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 2 ..
16.321.m: The māhātmya of the foremost god, Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, / of that god residing in the Unnata place in the form of a child, / merely by the sight of whom one is released from all sins. 2

16.321.s:
.. devyuvāca ..
bālarūpīti yatproktamunnataṃ tatkathaṃ vada ..
sthāneṣvanyeṣu sarvatra vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ .. 3 ..
16.321.d:
.. देव्युवाच ..
बालरूपीति यत्प्रोक्तमुन्नतं तत्कथं वद ..
स्थानेष्वन्येषु सर्वत्र वृद्धरूपी पितामहः .. 3 ..
16.321.m: The goddess said: / Tell me how he who is called 'in the form of a child' came to Unnata; / in all other places the Grandfather is in the form of an old man. 3

16.321.s:
kasminsthāne sthitastatra kimarthaṃ tatra vā gataḥ ..
kathaṃ sa pūjyo viprendraistithau kasyāṃ kramādvada .. 4 .. ..
16.321.d:
कस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितस्तत्र किमर्थं तत्र वा गतः ..
कथं स पूज्यो विप्रेन्द्रैस्तिथौ कस्यां क्रमाद्वद .. 4 .. ..
16.321.m: In what place did he dwell there, and for what purpose did he go there? / How is he to be worshipped by the lords of brahmins, and on which lunar day? Explain in order. 4

16.321.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ṛṣitoyāpaścime tu aiśānyāṃ sthalakeśvarāt ..
brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaloka ivāparaḥ .. 5 ..
16.321.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ऋषितोयापश्चिमे तु ऐशान्यां स्थलकेश्वरात् ..
ब्रह्मणः परमं स्थानं ब्रह्मलोक इवापरः .. 5 ..
16.321.m: Īśvara said: / To the west of the Ṛṣitoyā, but to the north-east of Sthalakeśvara, / is the supreme place of Brahmā, like a second Brahmaloka. 5

16.321.s:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca pūjyāḥ prābhāsike sadā ..
brahmabhāge sthito brahmā ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe .. 6 ..
16.321.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च पूज्याः प्राभासिके सदा ..
ब्रह्मभागे स्थितो ब्रह्मा ऋषितोयातटे शुभे .. 6 ..
16.321.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are always to be worshipped in the Prabhāsa region. / Brahmā resides in the Brahmā sector on the auspicious bank of the Ṛṣitoyā; 6

16.321.s:
rudrabhāge'gnitīrthe ca pūjyo rudraḥ sanātanaḥ ..
girau raivatake ramye pūjyo dāmodaro hariḥ .. 7 ..
16.321.d:
रुद्रभागेऽग्नितीर्थे च पूज्यो रुद्रः सनातनः ..
गिरौ रैवतके रम्ये पूज्यो दामोदरो हरिः .. 7 ..
16.321.m: the eternal Rudra is to be worshipped in the Rudra sector at Agnitīrtha; / Hari as Dāmodara is to be worshipped on the delightful Mount Raivataka. 7

16.321.s:
somena prārthito devo bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ ..
āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu hyunnate sthāna uttame .. 8 ..
16.321.d:
सोमेन प्रार्थितो देवो बालरूपी पितामहः ..
आगतश्चाष्टवर्षस्तु ह्युन्नते स्थान उत्तमे .. 8 ..
16.321.m: Requested by Soma, the divine Grandfather assumed the form of a child / and, being eight years old, arrived at the excellent Unnata place. 8

16.321.s: dṛṣṭvā brahmā dvijāñchreṣṭhāṃstatra sthāne sthito vibhuḥ .. 9 ..
16.321.d: दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा द्विजाञ्छ्रेष्ठांस्तत्र स्थाने स्थितो विभुः .. 9 ..
16.321.m: Beholding the foremost brahmins, the all-pervading Brahmā took up residence in that place. 9

16.321.s:
nāsti brahmasamo devo nāsti brahmasamo guruḥ ..
nāsti brahmasamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti brahmasamaṃ tapaḥ .. 7.1.321.10 ..
16.321.d:
नास्ति ब्रह्मसमो देवो नास्ति ब्रह्मसमो गुरुः ..
नास्ति ब्रह्मसमं ज्ञानं नास्ति ब्रह्मसमं तपः .. 7.1.321.10 ..
16.321.m: There is no god equal to Brahmā; there is no guru equal to Brahmā; / there is no knowledge equal to Brahmā; there is no austerity equal to Brahmā. 10

16.321.s:
tāvadbhramaṃti saṃsāre duḥkhaśokabhayāplutāḥ ..
na bhavaṃti surajyeṣṭhe yāvadbhaktāḥ pitāmahe .. 11 ..
16.321.d:
तावद्भ्रमंति संसारे दुःखशोकभयाप्लुताः ..
न भवंति सुरज्येष्ठे यावद्भक्ताः पितामहे .. 11 ..
16.321.m: They wander in saṃsāra, overwhelmed by misery, grief, and fear, / only so long as they do not become devoted to the eldest of the gods, the Grandfather. 11

16.321.s:
samāsaktaṃ yathā cittaṃ jaṃtorviṣayagocare ..
yadyevaṃ brahmaṇi nyastaṃ ko na mucyeta baṃdhanāt .. 12 ..
16.321.d:
समासक्तं यथा चित्तं जंतोर्विषयगोचरे ..
यद्येवं ब्रह्मणि न्यस्तं को न मुच्येत बंधनात् .. 12 ..
16.321.m: Just as a creature's mind is deeply attached to the sphere of sense objects, / if it were fixed upon Brahmā in that same way, who would not be liberated from bondage? 12

16.321.s:
paramāyuḥ smṛto brahmā parārdhaṃ tasya vai gatam ..
unnatasthānasaṃsthasya dvitīyaṃ bhavitā'dhunā .. 13 ...
16.321.d:
परमायुः स्मृतो ब्रह्मा परार्धं तस्य वै गतम् ..
उन्नतस्थानसंस्थस्य द्वितीयं भविताऽधुना .. 13 ...
16.321.m: The utmost life-span is attributed to Brahmā, and one half of his span has indeed passed; / for him who dwells in the Unnata place, the second half will occur now. 13

16.321.s:
yadāsāvunnate sthāne brahmalokātpitāmahaḥ ..
āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu bālarūpī tadocyate .. 14 ..
16.321.d:
यदासावुन्नते स्थाने ब्रह्मलोकात्पितामहः ..
आगतश्चाष्टवर्षस्तु बालरूपी तदोच्यते .. 14 ..
16.321.m: When this Grandfather came to the Unnata place from Brahmaloka / at eight years of age, he is then said to be 'in the form of a child'. 14

16.321.s:
sthāneṣvanyeṣu viprāṇāṃ vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ ..
yuktaṃ tadunnatasthānaṃ sadā ca brahmaṇaḥ priyam .. 15 ..
16.321.d:
स्थानेष्वन्येषु विप्राणां वृद्धरूपी पितामहः ..
युक्तं तदुन्नतस्थानं सदा च ब्रह्मणः प्रियम् .. 15 ..
16.321.m: In other places of the brahmins the Grandfather is in the form of an old man; / that Unnata place is endowed [with merit] and is always dear to Brahmā. 15

16.321.s:
snātvā ca vidhivatpūrvaṃ brahmakuṃḍe narottama ..
pūjayetpuṣpadhūpādyairbrahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam .. 16 ..
16.321.d:
स्नात्वा च विधिवत्पूर्वं ब्रह्मकुंडे नरोत्तम ..
पूजयेत्पुष्पधूपाद्यैर्ब्रह्माणं बालरूपिणम् .. 16 ..
16.321.m: Having first bathed according to rule in the Brahmakuṇḍa, O best of men, / one should worship Brahmā in the form of a child with flowers, incense, and the like. 16

16.321.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasthāne brahmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatyuttara triśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. 321 ..
16.321.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उन्नतस्थाने ब्रह्ममाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकविंशत्युत्तर त्रिशततमोध्यायः .. 321 ..
16.321.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of Brahmā at the Unnata Place', in the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, the first [part] in the Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 321

16.322.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇasaṃsthitam ..
durgādityetināmānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
16.322.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्य दक्षिणसंस्थितम् ..
दुर्गादित्येतिनामानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.322.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the [shrine] situated to his south / named Durgāditya, which destroys all sins. 1

16.322.s:
yadā duḥkhamanuprāptā durgā duḥkhavināśinī ..
sūryamārādhayāmāsa tadā duḥkhavinuttaye .. 2 ..
16.322.d:
यदा दुःखमनुप्राप्ता दुर्गा दुःखविनाशिनी ..
सूर्यमाराधयामास तदा दुःखविनुत्तये .. 2 ..
16.322.m: When Durgā, the destroyer of sorrow, was overcome by sorrow, / she propitiated the Sun to dispel her sorrow at that time. 2

16.322.s:
tataḥ kālena bahunā tasyāstuṣṭo divākaraḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ durgāṃ devo mahāprabhām ..
varaṃ varaya deveśi tapasā tuṣṭavānaham .. 3 ..
16.322.d:
ततः कालेन बहुना तस्यास्तुष्टो दिवाकरः ..
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं दुर्गां देवो महाप्रभाम् ..
वरं वरय देवेशि तपसा तुष्टवानहम् .. 3 ..
16.322.m: Then, after a long time, the Sun was pleased with her / and, the radiant god, spoke gentle words to Durgā: / 'Choose a boon, O queen of the gods; I am pleased with your austerity.' 3

16.322.s:
.. durgovāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo divānātha duḥkhasaṃghaṃ vināśaya .. 4 ..
16.322.d:
.. दुर्गोवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टो दिवानाथ दुःखसंघं विनाशय .. 4 ..
16.322.m: Durgā said: / If you are pleased, O lord of the day, destroy the host of my sorrows. 4

16.322.s:
.. sūrya uvāca .. ..
acireṇaiva kālena bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ ..
saṃprāpsyatyuttamaṃ liṃgamunnate sthāna uttame .. 5 ..
16.322.d:
.. सूर्य उवाच .. ..
अचिरेणैव कालेन भगवांस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
संप्राप्स्यत्युत्तमं लिंगमुन्नते स्थान उत्तमे .. 5 ..
16.322.m: The Sun said: / In no long time the lord who brought about Tripura's end / will obtain an excellent liṅga in the supreme Unnata place. 5

16.322.s:
durgādityeti me nāma iha devi bhaviṣyati ..
evamuktvā mahādevi tatraivāntardadhe raviḥ ..
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa durgādityaṃ prapūjayet .. 6 ..
16.322.d:
दुर्गादित्येति मे नाम इह देवि भविष्यति ..
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवि तत्रैवान्तर्दधे रविः ..
सप्तम्यां रविवारेण दुर्गादित्यं प्रपूजयेत् .. 6 ..
16.322.m: My name here shall be Durgāditya, O goddess. / Having spoken thus, O great goddess, the Sun vanished right there. / On a Sunday that falls on the seventh lunar day, one should worship Durgāditya. 6

16.322.s:
tasya duḥkhāni sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni vividhāni ca ..
vilayaṃ yāṃti deveśi durgādityaprapūjanāt .. 7 ..
16.322.d:
तस्य दुःखानि सर्वाणि कुष्ठानि विविधानि च ..
विलयं यांति देवेशि दुर्गादित्यप्रपूजनात् .. 7 ..
16.322.m: All his sorrows and various forms of leprosy / go to dissolution, O queen of the gods, from the worship of Durgāditya. 7

16.322.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisā haruyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye durgādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 322 ..
16.322.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसा हरुयां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दुर्गादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 322 ..
16.322.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of Durgāditya', in the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, the first [part] in the Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 322

16.323.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tataḥ paśyenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
kṣemeśvareti vikhyātamṛṣitoyātaṭe sthitam .. 1 ..
16.323.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततः पश्येन्महादेवि तस्य दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
क्षेमेश्वरेति विख्यातमृषितोयातटे स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.323.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should behold the [shrine] situated to its south, / known as Kṣemeśvara, situated on the bank of the Ṛṣitoyā. 1

16.323.s:
bhūtīśvareti nāmāsya pūrvaṃ ca parikīrtitam ..
kṣemeśeti kalau devi tasya nāma prakīrtitam ..2..
16.323.d:
भूतीश्वरेति नामास्य पूर्वं च परिकीर्तितम् ..
क्षेमेशेति कलौ देवि तस्य नाम प्रकीर्तितम् ..2..
16.323.m: Formerly, his name was proclaimed as Bhūtīśvara; / in the Kali [age], O goddess, his name is proclaimed as Kṣemeśa.

16.323.s: taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..3..
16.323.d: तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा च मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वकिल्बिषैः ..3..
16.323.m: Having seen and worshipped him, one becomes freed from all sins.

16.323.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣemeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 323 ..
16.323.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये क्षेमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोविंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 323 ..
