16.323.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-third chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Kṣemeśvara', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.324.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmāduttaradigbhāge kiṃcidvāyavyamāśritam ..
vināyakaṃ prapaśyecca sarvasiddhipradāyakam .. 1 ..
16.324.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादुत्तरदिग्भागे किंचिद्वायव्यमाश्रितम् ..
विनायकं प्रपश्येच्च सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. 1 ..
16.324.m: Īśvara said: / To the northern direction from there, situated somewhat towards the northwest, / one should look upon Vināyaka, the granter of all perfections.

16.324.s:
yo'sau devi mayā khyātaḥ sakhā me dhanadaḥ purā ..
gaṇanāthasvarūpeṇa nidhīnāṃ paripālakaḥ ..
lokānāṃ siddhidānārthamasminsthāne sthitaḥ priye .. 2 ..
16.324.d:
योऽसौ देवि मया ख्यातः सखा मे धनदः पुरा ..
गणनाथस्वरूपेण निधीनां परिपालकः ..
लोकानां सिद्धिदानार्थमस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितः प्रिये .. 2 ..
16.324.m: He who was formerly described by me, O goddess, as my friend Dhanada [Kubera], / as the guardian of treasures in the form of Gaṇanātha, / stands in this place to bestow perfection upon the people, O beloved.

16.324.s:
caturthyāṃ bhaumavāreṇa bhakṣyabhojyaḥ samodakaiḥ ..
pūjayedvidhivaddevi tasya siddhirbhaveddhruvam .. 3 ..
16.324.d:
चतुर्थ्यां भौमवारेण भक्ष्यभोज्यः समोदकैः ..
पूजयेद्विधिवद्देवि तस्य सिद्धिर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 3 ..
16.324.m: On a fourth lunar day coinciding with Tuesday, with edible snacks, foods, and sweetmeats, / one should worship him according to rule, O goddess; his success is certain.

16.324.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṇanāthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 324 ..
16.324.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गणनाथमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 324 ..
16.324.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Gaṇanātha', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.325.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vināyakamanuttamam ..
ṛṣitoyātaṭe ramye sarvavighnanivāraṇam .. 1 ..
16.325.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विनायकमनुत्तमम् ..
ऋषितोयातटे रम्ये सर्वविघ्ननिवारणम् .. 1 ..
16.325.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unexcelled Vināyaka, / on the delightful bank of the Ṛṣitoyā, who removes all obstacles.

16.325.s:
yo'sau devagaṇādhyakṣaḥ sākṣācca tripurāntakaḥ ..
gajarūpaṃ samāśritya hyunnate jagati sthitaḥ ..
prābhāsike mahākṣetre gaṇānāṃ koṭibhirvṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
16.325.d:
योऽसौ देवगणाध्यक्षः साक्षाच्च त्रिपुरान्तकः ..
गजरूपं समाश्रित्य ह्युन्नते जगति स्थितः ..
प्राभासिके महाक्षेत्रे गणानां कोटिभिर्वृतः .. 2 ..
16.325.m: He who is the lord of the divine hosts, directly the destroyer of Tripura, / having assumed an elephant form, stands in the elevated world, / in the great sacred field of Prabhāsa, surrounded by crores of gaṇas.

16.325.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrā nirvighnahetave ..
ārādhyo gaṇanāthaśca puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ sadā .. 3 ..
16.325.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यात्रा निर्विघ्नहेतवे ..
आराध्यो गणनाथश्च पुष्पधूपादिभिः सदा .. 3 ..
16.325.m: Therefore, with every effort, for the purpose of a journey free from obstacles, / Gaṇanātha should always be propitiated with flowers, incense, and the like.

16.325.s:
caturthyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca sarvairnagaravāsibhiḥ ..
tasminmahotsavaḥ kāryo rāṣṭrakṣemārtha siddhaye .. 4 ..
16.325.d:
चतुर्थ्यां च चतुर्थ्यां च सर्वैर्नगरवासिभिः ..
तस्मिन्महोत्सवः कार्यो राष्ट्रक्षेमार्थ सिद्धये .. 4 ..
16.325.m: On every fourth lunar day, by all inhabitants of the city, / a great festival should be celebrated there for the sake of the welfare and success of the realm.

16.325.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcaviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 325 ..
16.325.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उन्नतस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पंचविंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 325 ..
16.325.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Unnatasvāmin', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.326.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasyaivottarataḥ sthitam ..
mahākāleśvaraṃ devaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param .. 1 ..
16.326.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्यैवोत्तरतः स्थितम् ..
महाकालेश्वरं देवं सर्वरक्षाकरं परम् .. 1 ..
16.326.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme god Mahākāleśvara / situated to the north of him, who grants protection against all [perils].

16.326.s:
adhiṣṭhātā purasyāsya bhairavo rudrarūpadhṛk ..
darśe ca pūrṇimāyāṃ ca mahāpūjāṃ prakārayet .. 2 ..
16.326.d:
अधिष्ठाता पुरस्यास्य भैरवो रुद्ररूपधृक् ..
दर्शे च पूर्णिमायां च महापूजां प्रकारयेत् .. 2 ..
16.326.m: He is the presiding deity of this city, Bhairava bearing the form of Rudra. / On the new moon day and on the full moon day, one should have a great pūjā performed.

16.326.s:
mahodaye naraḥ snātvā mahākālaṃ prapaśyati ..
dhanāḍhyo jāyate loke saptajanmasahasrakam .. 3 ..
16.326.d:
महोदये नरः स्नात्वा महाकालं प्रपश्यति ..
धनाढ्यो जायते लोके सप्तजन्मसहस्रकम् .. 3 ..
16.326.m: Having bathed at Mahodaya, when a person looks upon Mahākāla, / he is born rich in this world for seven thousand lifetimes.

16.326.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mahākālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 326 ..
16.326.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये महाकालमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 326 ..
16.326.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Mahākāla', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.327.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go to Mahodaya, situated to the northeast of that.

16.327.s:
vidhinā tatra yaḥ snāti tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ ..
pratigrahakṛtāddoṣānna bhayaṃ tasya vidyate .. 2 ..
16.327.d:
विधिना तत्र यः स्नाति तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः ..
प्रतिग्रहकृताद्दोषान्न भयं तस्य विद्यते .. 2 ..
16.327.m: Whoever bathes there according to rule and satisfies the ancestors and deities / has no fear arising from the fault of accepting gifts.

16.327.s:
mahodayaṃ mahānandadāyakaṃ ca dvijanmanām ..
pratigrahaprasaktānāṃ viṣayāsaktacetasām ..
teṣāmapi dadenmuktiṃ tena khyātaṃ mahodayam .. 3 ..
16.327.d:
महोदयं महानन्ददायकं च द्विजन्मनाम् ..
प्रतिग्रहप्रसक्तानां विषयासक्तचेतसाम् ..
तेषामपि ददेन्मुक्तिं तेन ख्यातं महोदयम् .. 3 ..
16.327.m: Mahodaya brings great joy to the twice-born; / even to those addicted to accepting gifts whose minds are attached to sensory objects, / it grants liberation: therefore it is celebrated as Mahodaya.

16.327.s:
tasya vai rakṣaṇārthāya mahākālasya cottare ..
niyuktāśca mahādevi mātarastatra saṃsthitāḥ ..
tasminsnātvā naraḥ pūrvaṃ mātṝstāśca prapūjayet .. 4 ..
16.327.d:
तस्य वै रक्षणार्थाय महाकालस्य चोत्तरे ..
नियुक्ताश्च महादेवि मातरस्तत्र संस्थिताः ..
तस्मिन्स्नात्वा नरः पूर्वं मातॄस्ताश्च प्रपूजयेत् .. 4 ..
16.327.m: Indeed, for its protection, to the north of Mahākāla, / the Mothers were appointed and remain there, O great goddess. / Having bathed there, a person should first worship those Mothers.

16.327.s:
evaṃ devi mayā khyātaṃ mahodayamahodayam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāmabhiṣekācca muktidam .. 5 ..
16.327.d:
एवं देवि मया ख्यातं महोदयमहोदयम् ..
सर्वपापहरं नृणामभिषेकाच्च मुक्तिदम् .. 5 ..
16.327.m: Thus, O goddess, has been proclaimed by me the greatly fortunate Mahodaya, / which removes all sins of humans and gives liberation through ritual bathing.

16.327.s:
ardhakrośe ca tattīrthaṃ samaṃtātparimaṃḍalam ..
etanmadhyaṃ mahāsāraṃ sadaiva munivallabham .. 6 ..
16.327.d:
अर्धक्रोशे च तत्तीर्थं समंतात्परिमंडलम् ..
एतन्मध्यं महासारं सदैव मुनिवल्लभम् .. 6 ..
16.327.m: That sacred ford measures half a krośa in circumference on all sides; / its center is of great excellence and ever dear to sages.

16.327.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mahodayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma sapta viṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 327 ..
16.327.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये महोदयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्त विंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 327 ..
16.327.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Mahodaya', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.328.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādvāyavyadigbhāge sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
saṃgameśvaranāmāḍhyamṛṣayo yatra saṃgatāḥ .. 1 ..
16.328.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माद्वायव्यदिग्भागे स्थितं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
संगमेश्वरनामाढ्यमृषयो यत्र संगताः .. 1 ..
16.328.m: Īśvara said: / To the northwest direction from that stands the destroyer of sins, / possessing the name Saṃgameśvara, where the seers gathered.

16.328.s:
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kuṇḍikā pāpanāśinī ..
vaḍavānalasaṃyuktā yatrāyātā sarasvatī .. 2 ..
16.328.d:
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे कुण्डिका पापनाशिनी ..
वडवानलसंयुक्ता यत्रायाता सरस्वती .. 2 ..
16.328.m: To the eastern direction of it is a small pool that destroys sin, / joined with the submarine fire, where Sarasvatī arrived.

16.328.s:
kuṃḍikāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā saṃgameśvaramarcayet ..
tasya janmasahasrāṇi lakṣmyāḥ putrai priyaiḥ saha ..
asaṃgamaṃ mahādevi na kadācitprajāyate .. 3 ..
16.328.d:
कुंडिकायां नरः स्नात्वा संगमेश्वरमर्चयेत् ..
तस्य जन्मसहस्राणि लक्ष्म्याः पुत्रै प्रियैः सह ..
असंगमं महादेवि न कदाचित्प्रजायते .. 3 ..
16.328.m: Having bathed in the pool, a man should worship Saṃgameśvara; / for a thousand births, along with fortune, sons, and loved ones, / separation, O great goddess, never befalls him.
He is freed from all sins, [accumulated] from birth until death.

16.328.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 328..
16.328.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संगमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाविंशत्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 328..
16.328.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Saṃgameśvara', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.329.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
athottare devakulāttatra gavyūtimātrataḥ ..
uttamasthānamiti ca prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale .. 1 ..
16.329.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथोत्तरे देवकुलात्तत्र गव्यूतिमात्रतः ..
उत्तमस्थानमिति च प्रख्यातं धरणीतले .. 1 ..
16.329.m: Īśvara said: / Now, to the north of Devakula, at a distance of just one gavyūti from there, / is [a place] renowned on the surface of the earth as Uttamasthāna.

16.329.s:
tasyottare tu digbhāge dhanurdvādaśakāṃtare ..
unnato vighnarājastu sarvapratyūhanāśanaḥ .. 2 ..
16.329.d:
तस्योत्तरे तु दिग्भागे धनुर्द्वादशकांतरे ..
उन्नतो विघ्नराजस्तु सर्वप्रत्यूहनाशनः .. 2 ..
16.329.m: In its northern direction, at a distance of twelve bows, / is the high Lord of Obstacles, who destroys all hindrances.

16.329.s: caturthyāṃ pūjitaḥ samyaksugaṃdhaiḥ phalamodakaiḥ .. dadāti vāṃchitānkāmāṃstrailokye vijayī bhavet ..3 ..
16.329.d: चतुर्थ्यां पूजितः सम्यक्सुगंधैः फलमोदकैः .. ददाति वांछितान्कामांस्त्रैलोक्ये विजयी भवेत् ..3 ..
16.329.m: Duly worshipped on the fourth lunar day with sweet fragrances, fruits, and modakas, / he grants desired wishes, and one becomes victorious in the three worlds.

16.329.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatavināyakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 329 ..
16.329.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उन्नतविनायकमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 329 ..
16.329.m: Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Unnatavināyaka', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.330.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmāttadunnatasthānāduttare yojanatrayāt ..
tatra taptodakasvāmī talo yatra hataḥ purā .. 1 ..
16.330.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मात्तदुन्नतस्थानादुत्तरे योजनत्रयात् ..
तत्र तप्तोदकस्वामी तलो यत्र हतः पुरा .. 1 ..
16.330.m: Īśvara said: / Three yojanas to the north from that elevated place, / there is Taptodakasvāmin, where Tala was slain formerly.

16.330.s:
daityānāmadhipo devi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
kṛtvā varṣaśataṃ yuddhaṃ talasvāmī tato'bhavat .. 2 ..
16.330.d:
दैत्यानामधिपो देवि विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
कृत्वा वर्षशतं युद्धं तलस्वामी ततोऽभवत् .. 2 ..
16.330.m: After fighting for a hundred years with the sovereign lord of the Daityas, / O goddess, the powerful Viṣṇu then became Talasvāmin.

16.330.s:
taptakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā talasvāminamarcayet ..
hṛtvā piṃḍapradānaṃ tu koṭiyātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
16.330.d:
तप्तकुण्डे नरः स्नात्वा तलस्वामिनमर्चयेत् ..
हृत्वा पिंडप्रदानं तु कोटियात्राफलं लभेत् .. 3 ..
16.330.m: Having bathed in the hot pool, a person should worship Talasvāmin; / by performing the offering of funeral cakes, one obtains the fruit of ten million pilgrimages.

16.330.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye talasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaratriśa tatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 330 ..
16.330.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तलस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिश ततमोऽध्यायः .. 330 ..
16.330.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirtieth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Talasvāmin', in the first [part], the 'Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra', of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection.

16.331.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kālamegheti viśrutam ..
tasmāttaṃ pūrvadigbhāge kṣetrapaṃ liṃgarūpiṇam .. 1 ..
16.331.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कालमेघेति विश्रुतम् ..
तस्मात्तं पूर्वदिग्भागे क्षेत्रपं लिंगरूपिणम् .. 1 ..
16.331.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the one celebrated as Kālamegha; / to the eastern side from there, to the guardian of the field in the form of a liṅga. / 1

16.331.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturddaśyāṃ pūjyo'sau balibhirnaraiḥ ..
vāṃchitārthapradaḥ samyaksa kalau kalpapādapaḥ .. 2 ..
16.331.d:
अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्द्दश्यां पूज्योऽसौ बलिभिर्नरैः ..
वांछितार्थप्रदः सम्यक्स कलौ कल्पपादपः .. 2 ..
16.331.m: On the eighth or the fourteenth [tithi], he is to be worshiped by men with offerings. / He completely bestows desired wishes; in the Kali age, he is a wish-fulfilling tree. / 2

16.331.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kālameghamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 331 .. ..
16.331.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कालमेघमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 331 .. ..
16.331.m: Thus ends the three hundred thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kālamegha,' in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. // 331

16.332.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmāddakṣiṇadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ paṃcabhiḥ priye ..
tatra taptodakuṃḍāni saṃtyadyāpi varānane .. 1 ..
16.332.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माद्दक्षिणदिग्भागे धनुषां पंचभिः प्रिये ..
तत्र तप्तोदकुंडानि संत्यद्यापि वरानने .. 1 ..
16.332.m: Īśvara said: / To the southern side from there, at a distance of five bows, my dear, / there are ponds of hot water, even today, O fair-faced one. / 1

16.332.s:
kuṇḍataḥ pūrvadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ pañcaviṃśatau ..
rukmiṇī saṃsthitā devī sarvapātakanāśinī .. 2..
16.332.d:
कुण्डतः पूर्वदिग्भागे धनुषां पञ्चविंशतौ ..
रुक्मिणी संस्थिता देवी सर्वपातकनाशिनी .. 2..
16.332.m: To the eastern side of the pond, at twenty-five bows, / goddess Rukmiṇī is situated, the destroyer of all sins. / 2

16.332.s:
snātvā taptodake kuṇḍe koṭihatyāvināśane..
tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevīṃ rukmiṇīṃ rukmadāyinīm ..
sapta janmāni nārīṇāṃ gṛhabhaṃgo na jāyate .. 3 ..
16.332.d:
स्नात्वा तप्तोदके कुण्डे कोटिहत्याविनाशने..
ततः संपूजयेद्देवीं रुक्मिणीं रुक्मदायिनीम् ..
सप्त जन्मानि नारीणां गृहभंगो न जायते .. 3 ..
16.332.m: Having bathed in the hot-water pond, which destroys ten million murders, / one should then worship goddess Rukmiṇī, the bestower of gold; / for women, there is no ruin of the household for seven lifetimes. / 3

16.332.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rukmiṇīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāya .. 332 ..
16.332.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रुक्मिणीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्याय .. 332 ..
16.332.m: Thus ends the three hundred thirty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Rukmiṇī,' in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. // 332

16.333.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
balabhadrācca pūrveṇa sthitā cāsītsaridvarā ..
durvāseśvaranāmeti balaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.333.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
बलभद्राच्च पूर्वेण स्थिता चासीत्सरिद्वरा ..
दुर्वासेश्वरनामेति बललिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.333.m: Īśvara said: / To the east of Balabhadra, there was the excellent river. / An installation of a liṅga of Bala named Durvāseśvara was established. / 1

16.333.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sarvasukhāvaham..
snātvā cāsya tvamāvāsyāṃ piṃḍadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ .. 2 ..
16.333.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं दृष्टं सर्वसुखावहम्..
स्नात्वा चास्य त्वमावास्यां पिंडदानं ददाति यः .. 2 ..
16.333.m: Seen, it pacifies all sins and brings all happiness. / Having bathed, whoever makes an offering of rice-balls on the new moon day / 2

16.333.s:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet ..
durvāseśvaranāmānaṃ tatra pūjya vidhānataḥ .. 3 ..
16.333.d:
कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं पितॄणां तृप्तिमावहेत् ..
दुर्वासेश्वरनामानं तत्र पूज्य विधानतः .. 3 ..
16.333.m: will bring satisfaction to the ancestors for a full hundred crore kalpas. / Having worshiped the one named Durvāseśvara there according to rule, / 3

16.333.s:
koṭiyajñaphalaṃ prāpya sarvānkāmā navāpnuyāt..
tatra liṃgānyanekāni ṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitāni tu .. 4 ..
16.333.d:
कोटियज्ञफलं प्राप्य सर्वान्कामा नवाप्नुयात्..
तत्र लिंगान्यनेकानि ऋषिभिः स्थापितानि तु .. 4 ..
16.333.m: having attained the fruit of ten million sacrifices, he will obtain all desires. / Many liṅgas were established there by the seers. / 4

16.333.s:
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..
ityetatkathitaṃ devi kṣetrādyaṃ taṃ yathākramam .. 5 ..
16.333.d:
दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वकिल्बिषैः ..
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि क्षेत्राद्यं तं यथाक्रमम् .. 5 ..
16.333.m: Having seen, touched, and worshiped [them], one becomes freed from all sins. / Thus has been recounted, O goddess, the sacred field and the rest in order, / 5

16.333.s:
bhadrāyāḥ paścimātpūrvaṃ yathānukramamāditaḥ ..
śrutaṃ pāpopaśamanaṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradam .. 6 ..
16.333.d:
भद्रायाः पश्चिमात्पूर्वं यथानुक्रममादितः ..
श्रुतं पापोपशमनं कोटियज्ञफलप्रदम् .. 6 ..
16.333.m: from the west of Bhadrā to the east, in succession from the beginning. / Heard, it pacifies sins and grants the fruit of ten million sacrifices. / 6

16.333.s:
atha kṣetrasya paridhisthānaṃ madhumatīti ca ..
tasmānnairṛtyadigbhāge sthānaṃ khaṃḍaghaṭeti ca .. 7 ..
16.333.d:
अथ क्षेत्रस्य परिधिस्थानं मधुमतीति च ..
तस्मान्नैरृत्यदिग्भागे स्थानं खंडघटेति च .. 7 ..
16.333.m: Now the peripheral place of the field is called Madhumatī. / To the south-west of that is the place called Khaṇḍaghaṭā. / 7

16.333.s:
tatra piṃgeśvaro devaḥ samudrataṭasannidhau ..
kūpānāṃ saptakaṃ tatra pitṝṇāṃ yatra pāṇayaḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi deveśi yatra parvaṇiparvaṇi .. 8 ..
16.333.d:
तत्र पिंगेश्वरो देवः समुद्रतटसन्निधौ ..
कूपानां सप्तकं तत्र पितॄणां यत्र पाणयः ..
दृश्यंतेऽद्यापि देवेशि यत्र पर्वणिपर्वणि .. 8 ..
16.333.m: There is the god Piṅgeśvara, near the seashore. / There is a group of seven wells where the hands of the ancestors / are seen even today, O queen of the gods, on every conjunction. / 8

16.333.s:
tatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā gayākoṭiguṇaṃ phalam ..
labhate nā'tra sandehaḥ somāmā yadi jāyate .. 9 ..
16.333.d:
तत्र श्राद्धं नरः कृत्वा गयाकोटिगुणं फलम् ..
लभते नाऽत्र सन्देहः सोमामा यदि जायते .. 9 ..
16.333.m: Performing a śrāddha there, a man obtains fruit ten million times that of Gayā; / there is no doubt about this, especially if it occurs on a Monday new moon. / 9

16.333.s:
tatraiva nātidūre tu bhadrāyāḥ saṃgamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
paścimātsaṃgamātpūrvaḥ saṃgamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ .. 7.1.333.10 ..
16.333.d:
तत्रैव नातिदूरे तु भद्रायाः संगमः स्मृतः ..
पश्चिमात्संगमात्पूर्वः संगमः समुदाहृतः .. 7.1.333.10 ..
16.333.m: Right there, not very far away, the confluence of Bhadrā is commemorated. / The eastern confluence is proclaimed following the western confluence. / 10

16.333.s:
yatpuṇyaṃ labhate devi pūrva paścimasaṃgame ..
gaṃgāsāgarayostatra tadbhadrāsaṃgame labhet .. 11 ..
16.333.d:
यत्पुण्यं लभते देवि पूर्व पश्चिमसंगमे ..
गंगासागरयोस्तत्र तद्भद्रासंगमे लभेत् .. 11 ..
16.333.m: Whatever merit one obtains, O goddess, at the eastern and western confluences / of Gaṅgā and the ocean, one obtains that at the confluence of Bhadrā. / 11

16.333.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye taptodakasvāmimāhātmye madhumatyāṃ piṃgeśvarabhadrāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 333 .. ..
16.333.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तप्तोदकस्वामिमाहात्म्ये मधुमत्यां पिंगेश्वरभद्रामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयस्त्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 333 .. ..
16.333.m: Thus ends the three hundred thirty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Piṅgeśvara and Bhadrā at Madhumatī in the Māhātmya of Taptodakasvāmin,' in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. // 333

16.334.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka .. pṛcchāmi tvāmahaṃ bhaktyā kiñcitkautūhalātpunaḥ .. 1 ..
16.334.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
भगवन्देवदेवेश संसारार्णवतारक .. पृच्छामि त्वामहं भक्त्या किञ्चित्कौतूहलात्पुनः .. 1 ..
16.334.m: [The Goddess] said: / O Lord, O god of gods, O ferryman across the ocean of transmigration, / out of devotion and curiosity, I ask you once again: / 1

16.334.s:
yattvayā kathitaṃ deva talasvāmimahodayam ..
kiṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ deva talo yena nipātitaḥ .. 2 ..
16.334.d:
यत्त्वया कथितं देव तलस्वामिमहोदयम् ..
किं तत्र कारणं देव तलो येन निपातितः .. 2 ..
16.334.m: Regarding the great glory of Talasvāmin that was spoken of by you, O god: / what was the reason there, O god, by which Tala was struck down? / 2

16.334.s:
ko'sau talaḥ samākhyātaḥ kiṃvīryaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ ..
kasmātsthānātsamutpannaḥ kathaṃ jātaśca me vada .. 3 ..
16.334.d:
कोऽसौ तलः समाख्यातः किंवीर्यः किंपरायणः ..
कस्मात्स्थानात्समुत्पन्नः कथं जातश्च मे वद .. 3 ..
16.334.m: Who is this one known as Tala? What was his valor, what was his nature? / From what place did he arise, and how was he born? Tell me! / 3

16.334.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmya śeṣataḥ .. 4 ..
16.334.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ..
यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं तत्ते वक्ष्याम्य शेषतः .. 4 ..
16.334.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall explain the secret that destroys sins; / that which has not been told to anyone, I will tell you completely. / 4

16.334.s:
devā api na jānaṃti talasotpattikāraṇam ..
pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge devi govindeti prakīrtitaḥ .. 5 ..
16.334.d:
देवा अपि न जानंति तलसोत्पत्तिकारणम् ..
पूर्वं कृतयुगे देवि गोविन्देति प्रकीर्तितः .. 5 ..
16.334.m: Even the gods do not know the cause of Tala's origin. / Formerly, in the Kṛta age, O goddess, he was celebrated as Govinda. / 5

16.334.s:
tretāyāṃ vāmanaḥ svāmī stutisvāmī tṛtīyake ..
kalau yuge mahādevi talasvāmī prakīrtitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.334.d:
त्रेतायां वामनः स्वामी स्तुतिस्वामी तृतीयके ..
कलौ युगे महादेवि तलस्वामी प्रकीर्तितः .. 6 ..
16.334.m: In the Tretā [age], he was Vāmanasvāmin; in the third, Stutisvāmin; / in the Kali age, O great goddess, he is celebrated as Talasvāmin. / 6

16.334.s:
tathā taptodakasvāmī tasya nāmāṃtaraṃ priye ..
adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi talotpattiṃ tava priye .. 7 ..
16.334.d:
तथा तप्तोदकस्वामी तस्य नामांतरं प्रिये ..
अधुना संप्रवक्ष्यामि तलोत्पत्तिं तव प्रिये .. 7 ..
16.334.m: Likewise, Taptodakasvāmin is another name of his, my dear. / Now I shall relate to you the origin of Tala, my dear. / 7

16.334.s:
āsīnmahendranāmā ca dānavo raudrarūpadhṛk ..
koṭivarṣāṇi tenaiva tapastaptaṃ purā priye .. 8 ..
16.334.d:
आसीन्महेन्द्रनामा च दानवो रौद्ररूपधृक् ..
कोटिवर्षाणि तेनैव तपस्तप्तं पुरा प्रिये .. 8 ..
16.334.m: There was a Dānava named Mahendra who took a terrible form. / In former times, my dear, he performed austerity for a crore of years. / 8

16.334.s:
sa tapobalamāviṣṭo jigye devānsavāsavān ..
jitvā devāṃstataḥ sarvāṃstataḥ kāle samāgataḥ .. 9 ..
16.334.d:
स तपोबलमाविष्टो जिग्ये देवान्सवासवान् ..
जित्वा देवांस्ततः सर्वांस्ततः काले समागतः .. 9 ..
16.334.m: Endowed with the power of austerity, he conquered the gods along with Indra. / Having conquered all the gods, then, in due course of time, / 9

16.334.s:
yuddhaṃ sa prārthayāmāsa mayā sārddhaṃ subhīṣaṇam ..
tato'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ brahmāṇḍakṣayakārakam .. 7.1.334.10 ..
16.334.d:
युद्धं स प्रार्थयामास मया सार्द्धं सुभीषणम् ..
ततोऽभवन्महायुद्धं ब्रह्माण्डक्षयकारकम् .. 7.1.334.10 ..
16.334.m: he sought a battle with me, an exceedingly terrifying one. / Then a great battle took place, causing the destruction of the universe. / 10

16.334.s:
tataḥ kopānmahāyuddhe mama dehādvarānane ..
jvālā tatra samutpannā tanmadhye sa talo'bhavat .. 11 ..
16.334.d:
ततः कोपान्महायुद्धे मम देहाद्वरानने ..
ज्वाला तत्र समुत्पन्ना तन्मध्ये स तलोऽभवत् .. 11 ..
16.334.m: Then, out of fury in the great battle, O fair-faced one, from my body / a flame arose there; in the midst of it, that Tala came into being. / 11

16.334.s: tena dṛṣṭo mahendro'sau garjangiriguhāśrayaḥ .. 12 ..
16.334.d: तेन दृष्टो महेन्द्रोऽसौ गर्जन्गिरिगुहाश्रयः .. 12 ..
16.334.m: By him was seen that Mahendra, roaring and taking refuge in a mountain cave. / 12

16.334.s:
kathaṃ garjasi he mūḍha yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha ..
ityukte tatra deveśi tena yuddhamavartata .. 13 ..
16.334.d:
कथं गर्जसि हे मूढ युद्धं कुरु मया सह ..
इत्युक्ते तत्र देवेशि तेन युद्धमवर्तत .. 13 ..
16.334.m: 'Why are you roaring, O fool? Fight with me!' / When this was spoken, O queen of gods, a fight began with him. / 13

16.334.s: tatra pravarttite yuddhe talamāhendrayostayoḥ .. 14 ..
16.334.d: तत्र प्रवर्त्तिते युद्धे तलमाहेन्द्रयोस्तयोः .. 14 ..
16.334.m: When the fight between them, Tala and Mahendra, had commenced there, / 14

16.334.s:
rudravīryasya yuktena talenodārakarmaṇā ..
mallayuddhena balinā mahendro vinipātitaḥ .. 15 ..
16.334.d:
रुद्रवीर्यस्य युक्तेन तलेनोदारकर्मणा ..
मल्लयुद्धेन बलिना महेन्द्रो विनिपातितः .. 15 ..
16.334.m: Mahendra was struck down in a wrestling match / by the mighty Tala of noble deeds, who was endowed with Rudra's vigor. / 15

16.334.s:
tatastaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ sa talo gataḥ ..
gataprāṇaṃ tadā jñātvā harṣānnṛtyamathākarot .. 16 ..
16.334.d:
ततस्तं पतितं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं स तलो गतः ..
गतप्राणं तदा ज्ञात्वा हर्षान्नृत्यमथाकरोत् .. 16 ..
16.334.m: Then, seeing him fallen, that Tala was filled with wonder. / Knowing him to be dead, he then danced out of joy. / 16

16.334.s:
tasminsaṃnṛtyamāne tu sarve sthāvarajaṃgamam ..
cakaṃpe tu varārohe prabhāvāttasya vīryataḥ .. 17 ..
16.334.d:
तस्मिन्संनृत्यमाने तु सर्वे स्थावरजंगमम् ..
चकंपे तु वरारोहे प्रभावात्तस्य वीर्यतः .. 17 ..
16.334.m: While he was dancing, everything stationary and moving / trembled, O woman of shapely limbs, from his power and vigor. / 17

16.334.s:
tato bhārabharākāntā dharaṇī talapīḍitā ..
atīvabhayasaṃtrastāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ .. 18 ..
16.334.d:
ततो भारभराकान्ता धरणी तलपीडिता ..
अतीवभयसंत्रस्ताः सदेवासुरमानुषाः .. 18 ..
16.334.m: Then the earth, afflicted by Tala, was overcome by a heavy burden; / [all creatures,] together with gods, asuras, and humans, were terrified with intense fear. / 18

16.334.s:
kṣubhitā girayaḥ sarve vidrutāśca mahārṇavāḥ..
taravo nidhanaṃ jagmurnadyo vāhāṃśca tatyajuḥ..19..
16.334.d:
क्षुभिता गिरयः सर्वे विद्रुताश्च महार्णवाः..
तरवो निधनं जग्मुर्नद्यो वाहांश्च तत्यजुः..19..
16.334.m: All the mountains were agitated, and the great oceans were scattered; / the trees met their destruction, and the rivers abandoned their courses. / 19

16.334.s:
gataprabhāvāḥ sūryādyā jyotīṃṣi na virejire..
trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ talanṛtyaprabhāvataḥ .. 7.1.334.20 ..
16.334.d:
गतप्रभावाः सूर्याद्या ज्योतींषि न विरेजिरे..
त्रैलोक्यं व्याकुलीभूतं तलनृत्यप्रभावतः .. 7.1.334.20 ..
16.334.m: The sun and other celestial bodies lost their brilliance and ceased to shine; / the threefold world was confounded by the power of Tala's dance. / 20

16.334.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve śaraṇaṃ rudramāyayuḥ ..
vṛttaṃ yathāvatkathitaṃ tato rudra uvāca tān ..21..
16.334.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे शरणं रुद्रमाययुः ..
वृत्तं यथावत्कथितं ततो रुद्र उवाच तान् ..21..
16.334.m: Then all the hosts of gods went to Rudra for refuge. / What had happened was reported properly, and then Rudra said to them: / 21

16.334.s:
avadhyo me talo devāḥ putratve hi pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinam .. 22 ..
16.334.d:
अवध्यो मे तलो देवाः पुत्रत्वे हि प्रतिष्ठितः ..
एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनम् .. 22 ..
16.334.m: 'Tala is not to be slain by me, O gods, for he is established in the status of a son.' / Having spoken thus to Hṛṣīkeśa, who resides in the sacred field of Prabhāsa— / 22

16.334.s:
stutisvāmītināmānaṃ sthitaṃ durvāsasaḥ puraḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetrasāmīpye pūrvabhāge pratiṣṭhitam .. 23 ..
16.334.d:
स्तुतिस्वामीतिनामानं स्थितं दुर्वाससः पुरः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रसामीप्ये पूर्वभागे प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 23 ..
16.334.m: named Stutisvāmin, who stands before Durvāsas, / stationed in the eastern part near the Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.334.s:
taptodakuṃḍasāmīpye tatra gacchata bhoḥ surāḥ ..
kalpekalpe tu tenaiva vidhyate'sau hi dānavaḥ .. 24 ..
16.334.d:
तप्तोदकुंडसामीप्ये तत्र गच्छत भोः सुराः ..
कल्पेकल्पे तु तेनैव विध्यतेऽसौ हि दानवः .. 24 ..
16.334.m: "Go there, O gods, near the Taptodakuṇḍa. / Indeed, eon after eon, that Dānava is pierced by him alone."

16.334.s:
evamukte tadā devāḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ ..
tatra te vibudhā jagmuryatra taptodakādhipaḥ .. 25 ..
16.334.d:
एवमुक्ते तदा देवाः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः ..
तत्र ते विबुधा जग्मुर्यत्र तप्तोदकाधिपः .. 25 ..
16.334.m: When this was said, the gods then came to the Prabhāsa sacred field; / there those deities went to where the lord of Taptodaka is.

16.334.s:
dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ tatra devāḥ śraddhāsamanvitāḥ ..
tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā devadevaṃ janārddanam.. 26 ..
16.334.d:
दृष्ट्वा नारायणं तत्र देवाः श्रद्धासमन्विताः ..
तुष्टुवुः परया भक्त्या देवदेवं जनार्द्दनम्.. 26 ..
16.334.m: Seeing Nārāyaṇa there, the gods, endowed with faith, / praised the god of gods, Janārdana, with supreme devotion:

16.334.s:
vaikuṃṭha trāhi no devāṃstalenoccāṭitā vayam ..
mahendrakrodhasaṃbhūtarudratejodbhavena vai .. 27 ..
16.334.d:
वैकुंठ त्राहि नो देवांस्तलेनोच्चाटिता वयम् ..
महेन्द्रक्रोधसंभूतरुद्रतेजोद्भवेन वै .. 27 ..
16.334.m: "O Vaikuṇṭha, protect us gods! We have been driven out by Tala, / who was born from the fiery brilliance of Rudra that arose from Mahendra's anger.

16.334.s:
asmābhī rudrasāmīpye kāryaṃ sarvaṃ niveditam ..
tataḥ prasthāpitāḥ sarve rudreṇa parameṣṭhinā ..
tava pārśve mahādeva nastvaṃ deva gatirbhava .. 28 ..
16.334.d:
अस्माभी रुद्रसामीप्ये कार्यं सर्वं निवेदितम् ..
ततः प्रस्थापिताः सर्वे रुद्रेण परमेष्ठिना ..
तव पार्श्वे महादेव नस्त्वं देव गतिर्भव .. 28 ..
16.334.m: All the matter was reported by us in the presence of Rudra; / then we were all sent by Rudra, the highest lord, / to your side, O Great God! Become our refuge, O God!"

16.334.s:
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ devadevo janārddanaḥ ..
dānavasyavadhārthāya devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ..
cakre yatnaṃ mahābāhuḥ prabhāsakṣetravallabhaḥ .. 29 ..
16.334.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां देवदेवो जनार्द्दनः ..
दानवस्यवधार्थाय देवानां रक्षणाय च ..
चक्रे यत्नं महाबाहुः प्रभासक्षेत्रवल्लभः .. 29 ..
16.334.m: Hearing their words, the god of gods, Janārdana, / the mighty-armed one, fond of the Prabhāsa sacred field, / made an effort to slay the Dānava and protect the gods.

16.334.s:
samāhūya tadā daityaṃ prabhāsakṣetramadhyataḥ ..
yuddhaṃ cakre tato devi viśvapralayakārakam ..7.1.334.30 ..
16.334.d:
समाहूय तदा दैत्यं प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यतः ..
युद्धं चक्रे ततो देवि विश्वप्रलयकारकम् ..7.1.334.30 ..
16.334.m: Summoning the Daitya then from the midst of the Prabhāsa sacred field, / he then waged a battle, O Goddess, that brought about universal dissolution.

16.334.s:
tatastu devāḥ sarve ca svasainyaparivāritāḥ ..
cakruryuddhaṃ ca daityena sumahallomaharṣaṇam .. 31 ..
16.334.d:
ततस्तु देवाः सर्वे च स्वसैन्यपरिवारिताः ..
चक्रुर्युद्धं च दैत्येन सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम् .. 31 ..
16.334.m: Then all the gods, surrounded by their own armies, / fought a tremendous, hair-raising battle with the Daitya.

16.334.s:
tataḥ parvatasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ mahābalam ..
uvāca capalāpāṃgo garuḍakṛtavāhanaḥ .. 32 ..
16.334.d:
ततः पर्वतसंकाशं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यं महाबलम् ..
उवाच चपलापांगो गरुडकृतवाहनः .. 32 ..
16.334.m: Then, seeing the Daitya resembling a mountain and endowed with great might, / the glance-darting one whose mount is Garuḍa said:

16.334.s:
aho daitya mahābāho mallayuddhaṃ dadasva me ..
tvadbāhuyugalaṃ dṛṣṭvā na yuddhe vāṃchitaṃ mama .. 33 ..
16.334.d:
अहो दैत्य महाबाहो मल्लयुद्धं ददस्व मे ..
त्वद्बाहुयुगलं दृष्ट्वा न युद्धे वांछितं मम .. 33 ..
16.334.m: "Ah, Daitya of mighty arms, give me wrestling combat! / Having seen your pair of arms, I have no desire for [ordinary] battle."

16.334.s:
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā karamudyamya dānavaḥ ..
abhyadhāvattadā daityaḥ kālāntakasamaprabhaḥ .. 34 ..
16.334.d:
नारायणवचः श्रुत्वा करमुद्यम्य दानवः ..
अभ्यधावत्तदा दैत्यः कालान्तकसमप्रभः .. 34 ..
16.334.m: Hearing Nārāyaṇa's words, the Dānava, raising his hand, / the Daitya with radiance like the Time of Death, ran forward.

16.334.s:
tataḥ pravartitaṃ yuddhamanyonyaṃ jayakāṃkṣiṇoḥ ..
jaṃghābhyāṃ pādabandhena bāhubhyāṃ bāhubaṃdhanam .. 35 ..
16.334.d:
ततः प्रवर्तितं युद्धमन्योन्यं जयकांक्षिणोः ..
जंघाभ्यां पादबन्धेन बाहुभ्यां बाहुबंधनम् .. 35 ..
16.334.m: Then a battle began between the two desiring victory over each other: / locking legs with shanks, and locking arms with arms,

16.334.s: kaṃṭhena bandhayankaṃṭhamudareṇodaraṃ tathā .. etasminnantare devāḥ sabhayāḥ saṃbabhūvire .. 36 ..
16.334.d: कंठेन बन्धयन्कंठमुदरेणोदरं तथा .. एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सभयाः संबभूविरे .. 36 ..
16.334.m: binding neck with neck, and belly with belly. / In the meantime, the gods were filled with fear.

16.334.s:
tataḥ pīḍāsamākrāṃto viṣṇuḥ saṃsmarate haram ..
tatkṣaṇādāgato rudraḥ kiṃ karomi mahābalaḥ .. 37 .. ..
16.334.d:
ततः पीडासमाक्रांतो विष्णुः संस्मरते हरम् ..
तत्क्षणादागतो रुद्रः किं करोमि महाबलः .. 37 .. ..
16.334.m: Then Viṣṇu, overcome with exhaustion, remembered Hara. / Instantly Rudra of great might arrived: "What shall I do?"

16.334.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
śrāṃto'haṃ devadeveśa mallayuddhena śaṃkara ..
taptodakaṃ kuruṣveha śramanāśāya sāṃpratam .. 38 ..
16.334.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
श्रांतोऽहं देवदेवेश मल्लयुद्धेन शंकर ..
तप्तोदकं कुरुष्वेह श्रमनाशाय सांप्रतम् .. 38 ..
16.334.m:
Viṣṇu said:
"I am tired, O Lord of the gods of gods, from wrestling combat, O Śaṃkara! / Create hot water here now to dispel my fatigue.

16.334.s: tatastalaṃ haniṣyāmi kṣaṇa mātreṇa bhairavam .. 39 ..
16.334.d: ततस्तलं हनिष्यामि क्षण मात्रेण भैरवम् .. 39 ..
16.334.m: Then I shall kill the terrifying Tala in a mere moment."

16.334.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ādau kṛtayuge kṛṣṇa umayā yatkṛtaṃ purā ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ śramanāśārthaṃ taptodaṃ tatra nirmitam .. 7.1.334.40 ..
16.334.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आदौ कृतयुगे कृष्ण उमया यत्कृतं पुरा ..
ऋषीणां श्रमनाशार्थं तप्तोदं तत्र निर्मितम् .. 7.1.334.40 ..
16.334.m:
Īśvara said:
"Formerly, in the Kṛta age, O Kṛṣṇa, what was created by Umā / to dispel the fatigue of the seers—the hot water (Taptoda)—was fashioned there.

16.334.s:
taddaityapāpamāhātmyātpunaḥ śītalatāṃ gatam ..
punastaduṣṇatāṃ nītaṃ tataḥ kalpāṃtasaṃsthitau .. 41 ..
16.334.d:
तद्दैत्यपापमाहात्म्यात्पुनः शीतलतां गतम् ..
पुनस्तदुष्णतां नीतं ततः कल्पांतसंस्थितौ .. 41 ..
16.334.m: Due to the power of that Daitya's sin, it had become cold again. / Then it was brought to heat again at the end of the eon."

16.334.s:
evamuktvā tadā devaṃ vīkṣāṃcakre maheśvaraḥ ..
tṛtīya locanenaiva jvālāmālopaśobhinā .. 42 ..
16.334.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवं वीक्षांचक्रे महेश्वरः ..
तृतीय लोचनेनैव ज्वालामालोपशोभिना .. 42 ..
16.334.m: Having spoken thus, Maheśvara then cast his gaze upon the god / with his very third eye, adorned with a wreath of flames.

16.334.s:
tena jvālāsamūhena vyāptaṃ kuṇḍaṃ caturdiśam ..
taptodakuṇḍamabhavattena khyātaṃ dharātale .. 43 ..
16.334.d:
तेन ज्वालासमूहेन व्याप्तं कुण्डं चतुर्दिशम् ..
तप्तोदकुण्डमभवत्तेन ख्यातं धरातले .. 43 ..
16.334.m: By that mass of flames, the pool was pervaded on all four sides; / it became the Taptodakuṇḍa, renowned by that [name] on the surface of the earth.

16.334.s:
tato nārāyaṇeneha kṣālitaṃ gātrasuttamam..
kṣālanāttasya devasya śramo nāśamupāgamat .. 44 ..
16.334.d:
ततो नारायणेनेह क्षालितं गात्रसुत्तमम्..
क्षालनात्तस्य देवस्य श्रमो नाशमुपागमत् .. 44 ..
16.334.m: Then the best of limbs was washed here by Nārāyaṇa; / from the washing of that god, his fatigue met its destruction.

16.334.s:
tatastuṣṭamanā devastīrthānāṃ daśakoṭikāḥ ..
sa smṛtvā tatra vidhivatkṣiptvā snātvā varānane .. 45 ..
16.334.d:
ततस्तुष्टमना देवस्तीर्थानां दशकोटिकाः ..
स स्मृत्वा तत्र विधिवत्क्षिप्त्वा स्नात्वा वरानने .. 45 ..
16.334.m: Then, delighted in mind, the god remembered the ten crores of sacred fords, / and having properly cast them there, O lovely-faced one, and bathed,

16.334.s:
tataścakre mahāyuddhaṃ talenātibhayaṃkaram ..
jaghāna sa talaṃ daityaṃ muṣṭighātena mastake .. 46 ..
16.334.d:
ततश्चक्रे महायुद्धं तलेनातिभयंकरम् ..
जघान स तलं दैत्यं मुष्टिघातेन मस्तके .. 46 ..
16.334.m: he then fought a great, extremely terrifying battle with Tala. / He struck the Daitya Tala on the head with the blow of a fist.

16.334.s:
tasminpravṛtte tumule tu yuddhe cakaṃpire bhūbhisametalokāḥ ..
vitrastadevā na diśo virejurmahāṃdhakārāvṛtamūrchitaṃ jagat .. 47 ..
16.334.d:
तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते तुमुले तु युद्धे चकंपिरे भूभिसमेतलोकाः ..
वित्रस्तदेवा न दिशो विरेजुर्महांधकारावृतमूर्छितं जगत् .. 47 ..
16.334.m: When that tumultuous battle began, the worlds together with the earth trembled; / the terrified gods and the quarters did not shine, and the world fainted, enveloped in great darkness.

16.334.s:
naṣṭāśca siddhā jagato'sya śāṃtiṃ karotu vai pāpavināśano hariḥ ..
trāhīti deveśi maharṣisaṃghā bhūtāni bhītāni tathā vadanti ..48..
16.334.d:
नष्टाश्च सिद्धा जगतोऽस्य शांतिं करोतु वै पापविनाशनो हरिः ..
त्राहीति देवेशि महर्षिसंघा भूतानि भीतानि तथा वदन्ति ..48..
16.334.m: The perfected beings vanished, [praying:] "May Hari, the destroyer of sin, indeed bring peace to this world! / Protect us!" O ruler of the gods, the hosts of great seers and the frightened beings spoke thus.

16.334.s:
tato vai mallayuddhena pātito bhuvi dānavaḥ..
kaṃṭhamākramya pādena khaṅgena paripīḍitaḥ .. 49 ..
16.334.d:
ततो वै मल्लयुद्धेन पातितो भुवि दानवः..
कंठमाक्रम्य पादेन खङ्गेन परिपीडितः .. 49 ..
16.334.m: Then the Dānava was thrown to the ground in wrestling combat; / stepping on his neck with his foot, he was pressed down with a sword.

16.334.s:
hāsyaṃ cakāra daityo'tha viṣṇunā''krāṃtakaṃdharaḥ ..
tamāha puṇḍarīkākṣa kimetaddhāsyakāraṇam ..7.1.334.50..
16.334.d:
हास्यं चकार दैत्योऽथ विष्णुना'ऽक्रांतकंधरः ..
तमाह पुण्डरीकाक्ष किमेतद्धास्यकारणम् ..7.1.334.50..
16.334.m: Then the Daitya, his neck pinned down by Viṣṇu, laughed. / The lotus-eyed one said to him: "What is this cause for laughter?

16.334.s:
vṛddhau harṣamavāpnoti kṣaye bhavati duḥkhitaḥ ..
ityeṣā laukikī gāthā tatte daitya viparyayaḥ ..51..
16.334.d:
वृद्धौ हर्षमवाप्नोति क्षये भवति दुःखितः ..
इत्येषा लौकिकी गाथा तत्ते दैत्य विपर्ययः ..51..
16.334.m: One feels joy in prosperity, and becomes sorrowful in ruin; / this is the worldly saying. For you, Daitya, it is the reverse."

16.334.s:
ityuktastu tadā daityaḥ pratyuvāca janārddanam ..
agniṣṭomādibhiryajñaivedābhyāsairanekadhā .. 52 ..
16.334.d:
इत्युक्तस्तु तदा दैत्यः प्रत्युवाच जनार्द्दनम् ..
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैवेदाभ्यासैरनेकधा .. 52 ..
16.334.m: Addressed thus, the Daitya then replied to Janārdana: / "By sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma, by Vedic study in various ways,

16.334.s:
nityopavāsaniyamaiḥ snānadānairjapādibhiḥ ..
nirmalairyogayuktaiśca prāpyate yatparaṃ padam .. 53 ..
16.334.d:
नित्योपवासनियमैः स्नानदानैर्जपादिभिः ..
निर्मलैर्योगयुक्तैश्च प्राप्यते यत्परं पदम् .. 53 ..
16.334.m: by daily fasts, vows, baths, gifts, recitations, and so forth, / that supreme abode is attained by the pure who are devoted to yoga.

16.334.s:
tanmayā duṣṭabhāvena prāptaṃ viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ..
ityukte bhagavānviṣṇurvaradānaparo'bhavat .. 54 ..
16.334.d:
तन्मया दुष्टभावेन प्राप्तं विष्णोः परं पदम् ..
इत्युक्ते भगवान्विष्णुर्वरदानपरोऽभवत् .. 54 ..
16.334.m: That supreme abode of Viṣṇu has been attained by me through wicked intent!" / When this was said, the blessed Viṣṇu became intent on bestowing a boon.

16.334.s:
uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ talaṃ daityādhināyakam ..
varaṃ varaya daityeṃdra yatte manasi saṃsthitam .. 55 ..
16.334.d:
उवाच परमं वाक्यं तलं दैत्याधिनायकम् ..
वरं वरय दैत्येंद्र यत्ते मनसि संस्थितम् .. 55 ..
16.334.m: He spoke supreme words to Tala, the supreme lord of the Daityas: / "Choose a boon, O lord of Daityas, whatever resides in your mind."

16.334.s:
iti viṣṇorvacaḥ śrutvā prārthayāmāsa dānavaḥ ..
mamākhyā varttate loke tathā kuru mahīdhara .. 56 ..
16.334.d:
इति विष्णोर्वचः श्रुत्वा प्रार्थयामास दानवः ..
ममाख्या वर्त्तते लोके तथा कुरु महीधर .. 56 ..
16.334.m: Hearing Viṣṇu's words, the Dānava made a request: / "O supporter of the earth, act in such a way that my name endures in the world.

16.334.s:
mārgamāse tu śuklāyāmekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
yastvāṃ paśyati bhāvena tasya pāpaṃ vinaśyatu .. 57 ..
16.334.d:
मार्गमासे तु शुक्लायामेकादश्यां समाहितः ..
यस्त्वां पश्यति भावेन तस्य पापं विनश्यतु .. 57 ..
16.334.m: During the bright fortnight of the month of Mārga, on the eleventh day, / may the sin of whoever sees you with devotion with a concentrated mind be destroyed."

16.334.s:
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā devo harṣamupāgataḥ ..
nānāduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ca .. 58 ..
16.334.d:
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा देवो हर्षमुपागतः ..
नानादुंदुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवर्षं पपात च .. 58 ..
16.334.m: Saying, "It shall be so," the god experienced joy. / Various kettledrums sounded, and a rain of flowers fell.

16.334.s:
viṣṇormūrdhni mahābhāge lokāḥ svasthā babhūvire ..
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve nṛtyaṃti ca mudānvitāḥ ..
vadaṃti harṣasaṃyuktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ .. 59 ..
16.334.d:
विष्णोर्मूर्ध्नि महाभागे लोकाः स्वस्था बभूविरे ..
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे नृत्यंति च मुदान्विताः ..
वदंति हर्षसंयुक्ता नारायणपरायणाः .. 59 ..
16.334.m: Upon the head of Viṣṇu, O fortunate lady, the worlds became at ease. / Then all the hosts of gods danced, filled with delight; / filled with joy, devoted to Nārāyaṇa, they said:

16.334.s:
etattīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
śramāpanodanaṃ viṣṇorbrahmahatyādiśodhanam ..7.1.334.60..
16.334.d:
एतत्तीर्थं महातीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
श्रमापनोदनं विष्णोर्ब्रह्महत्यादिशोधनम् ..7.1.334.60..
16.334.m: "This sacred ford is a great sacred ford, destroying all sins, / removing Viṣṇu's fatigue, and purifying the killing of a brahmin and other [sins].

16.334.s:
sthito nārāyaṇastatra bhairavastatra śaṃkaraḥ ..
kṣetrapālasvarūpeṇa kālamegheti viśrutaḥ .. 61 ..
16.334.d:
स्थितो नारायणस्तत्र भैरवस्तत्र शंकरः ..
क्षेत्रपालस्वरूपेण कालमेघेति विश्रुतः .. 61 ..
16.334.m: Nārāyaṇa is stationed there, and Śaṃkara is there as Bhairava / in the form of the guardian of the field, renowned as Kālamegha.

16.334.s:
tasya yātrāvidhiṃ vakṣye gatvā tatra śucirnaraḥ ..
smaredviṣṇuṃ mahādevi talasvāmīti yaḥ śrutaḥ .. 62 ..
16.334.d:
तस्य यात्राविधिं वक्ष्ये गत्वा तत्र शुचिर्नरः ..
स्मरेद्विष्णुं महादेवि तलस्वामीति यः श्रुतः .. 62 ..
16.334.m: I shall tell the rite of pilgrimage to it: having gone there, a pure person, / O Great Goddess, should remember Viṣṇu, who is heard of as Talasvāmin.

16.334.s:
stuyādviṣṇuṃ mahādevi idaṃ viṣṇuṛcā priye ..
sahasraśīrṣāmaṃtreṇa tarpaṇādi prakārayet .. 63 ..
16.334.d:
स्तुयाद्विष्णुं महादेवि इदं विष्णुऋचा प्रिये ..
सहस्रशीर्षामंत्रेण तर्पणादि प्रकारयेत् .. 63 ..
16.334.m: He should praise Viṣṇu, O Great Goddess, with this verse, 'Idaṃ Viṣṇur', O beloved; / he should perform the water-offering and other rites with the mantra 'Sahasraśīrṣā...'

16.334.s:
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena dattvā cārghyaṃ janārddane ..
saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca vastraiḥ puṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 64 ..
16.334.d:
एवं स्नात्वा विधानेन दत्त्वा चार्घ्यं जनार्द्दने ..
संपूज्य गंधपुष्पैश्च वस्त्रैः पुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 64 ..
16.334.m: Having bathed thus according to rule, and having offered arghya to Janārdana, / and having worshiped with fragrant flowers, garments, flowers, and ointments,

16.334.s:
madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet ..
karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhiyutena ca .. 65 ..
16.334.d:
मधुनेक्षुरसेनैव कुंकुमेन विलेपयेत् ..
कर्पूरोशीरमिश्रेण मृगनाभियुतेन च .. 65 ..
16.334.m: One should anoint [him] with honey, sugarcane juice, and saffron, / mixed with camphor and uśīra, and combined with musk.

16.334.s:
vastraiḥ saṃveṣṭayetpaścāddadyānnaivedyamuttamam ..
dharmaśravaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kāryaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ .. 66 ..
16.334.d:
वस्त्रैः संवेष्टयेत्पश्चाद्दद्यान्नैवेद्यमुत्तमम् ..
धर्मश्रवणसंयुक्तं कार्यं जागरणं ततः .. 66 ..
16.334.m: Then one should envelop [him] with garments and offer excellent food. / Thereafter, a vigil must be observed, accompanied by the hearing of dharma.

16.334.s:
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ suvarṇaṃ vastrayugmakam .. .
viprāya vedayuktāya śrotriyāya pradāpayet .. 67 ..
16.334.d:
वृषभस्तत्र दातव्यः सुवर्णं वस्त्रयुग्मकम् .. .
विप्राय वेदयुक्ताय श्रोत्रियाय प्रदापयेत् .. 67 ..
16.334.m: A bull should be given there, along with gold and a pair of garments. / One should give [these] to a brahmin who is learned in the Veda and a Śrotriya.

16.334.s:
upavāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttasminnahani bhāmini ..
rukmiṇīṃ ca prapaśyeta namaskṛtya janārddanam .. 68 ..
16.334.d:
उपवासं ततः कुर्यात्तस्मिन्नहनि भामिनि ..
रुक्मिणीं च प्रपश्येत नमस्कृत्य जनार्द्दनम् .. 68 ..
16.334.m: Then, O fair lady, one should observe a fast on that day. / Having bowed to Janārdana, one should also behold Rukmiṇī.

16.334.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā labhate janmajaṃ phalam ..
sarveṣāmeva yajñānāṃ dānānāṃ labhate phalam .. 69 ..
16.334.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या लभते जन्मजं फलम् ..
सर्वेषामेव यज्ञानां दानानां लभते फलम् .. 69 ..
16.334.m: By doing so with devotion, a man attains the fruit of [his whole] lifetime; / he attains the fruit of indeed all sacrifices and all gifts,

16.334.s:
tathā ca sarvatīrthānāṃ vratānāṃ labhate phalam ..
uddharettu piturvargaṃ mātṛvargaṃ tathaiva ca .. 7.1.334.70 ..
16.334.d:
तथा च सर्वतीर्थानां व्रतानां लभते फलम् ..
उद्धरेत्तु पितुर्वर्गं मातृवर्गं तथैव च .. 7.1.334.70 ..
16.334.m: and likewise he attains the fruit of all sacred fords and vows. / He rescues the lineage of his father and likewise the lineage of his mother.

16.334.s:
janmaprabhṛtipāpānāṃ kṛtānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet ..
na duḥkhaṃ ca na dāridryaṃ durbhagatvaṃ na jāyate .. 71 ..
16.334.d:
जन्मप्रभृतिपापानां कृतानां नाशनं भवेत् ..
न दुःखं च न दारिद्र्यं दुर्भगत्वं न जायते .. 71 ..
16.334.m: Destruction of sins committed since birth takes place. / Neither sorrow nor poverty, nor misfortune arises [for him]

16.334.s:
sapta janmāṃtaraṃ yāvattalasvāmipradarśanāt ..
suvarṇānāṃ sahasreṇa brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
dattena yatphalaṃ devi tatkuṇḍe snānato labhet .. 72 ..
16.334.d:
सप्त जन्मांतरं यावत्तलस्वामिप्रदर्शनात् ..
सुवर्णानां सहस्रेण ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
दत्तेन यत्फलं देवि तत्कुण्डे स्नानतो लभेत् .. 72 ..
16.334.m: for seven successive births, through the darśana of Talasvāmin. / Whatever fruit is obtained when a thousand [coins] of gold are given to a brahmin who has mastered the Veda, O goddess, one obtains by bathing in that pool.

16.334.s:
evaṃ talasvāmicaritramuttamaṃ śrutaṃ purā siddhamaharṣisaṃghaiḥ ..
śrutvā prabhāvaṃ taladevasannidhau prāpnoti sarvaṃ manasā yadīpsitam .. 73 ..
16.334.d:
एवं तलस्वामिचरित्रमुत्तमं श्रुतं पुरा सिद्धमहर्षिसंघैः ..
श्रुत्वा प्रभावं तलदेवसन्निधौ प्राप्नोति सर्वं मनसा यदीप्सितम् .. 73 ..
16.334.m: Thus the excellent narrative of Talasvāmin was heard of old by the hosts of perfected beings and great seers. / Having heard of his power, in the presence of the god Talasvāmin one attains all that is desired in one's mind.

16.334.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye talasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 334 ..
16.334.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तलस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुस्त्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 334 ..
16.334.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Talasvāmin,” in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.335.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tataḥ paścimato gacchennyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe ..
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritya sthitaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāprabham .. 1 ..
16.335.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततः पश्चिमतो गच्छेन्न्यंकुमत्यास्तटे शुभे ..
दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रित्य स्थितं तीर्थं महाप्रभम् .. 1 ..
16.335.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go to the west, on the auspicious bank of the Nyaṅkumatī, / where, situated toward the southern quarter, lies a sacred ford of great splendour,

16.335.s:
śaṃkhāvarttamitikhyātaṃ yatra citrāṃkitā śilā ..
svayaṃbhūtā mahādevi raktagarbhā suśobhanā .. 2 ..
16.335.d:
शंखावर्त्तमितिख्यातं यत्र चित्रांकिता शिला ..
स्वयंभूता महादेवि रक्तगर्भा सुशोभना .. 2 ..
16.335.m: renowned as Śaṅkhāvarta, where there is a rock marked with variegated signs, / self-manifest, O great goddess, containing red [veins] within, and exceedingly beautiful.

16.335.s:
chinne tvadyāpi tatraiva suraktaṃ saṃpradṛśyate ..
viṣṇukṣetraṃ hi tatproktaṃ śaṃkho yatra hataḥ purā .. 3 ..
16.335.d:
छिन्ने त्वद्यापि तत्रैव सुरक्तं संप्रदृश्यते ..
विष्णुक्षेत्रं हि तत्प्रोक्तं शंखो यत्र हतः पुरा .. 3 ..
16.335.m: Even today, when it is cut, bright red is seen right there. / For that is declared to be a Viṣṇu-kṣetra, where Śaṅkha was slain of old,

16.335.s:
vedāpahārī deveśi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
kṛtaṃ śakhodakaṃ tīrthaṃ śaṃkhākāraṃ tu dṛśyate .. 4 ..
16.335.d:
वेदापहारी देवेशि विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
कृतं शखोदकं तीर्थं शंखाकारं तु दृश्यते .. 4 ..
16.335.m: who had stolen the Vedas, O ruler of the gods, by the all-powerful Viṣṇu. / The sacred ford Śaṅkhodaka was made [there], and it appears in the shape of a conch shell.

16.335.s:
tatra snātvā naro devi mucyate brahmahatyayā ..
sapta janmāni vipratvaṃ śūdrasyāpi prajā yate .. 5 ..
16.335.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो देवि मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ..
सप्त जन्मानि विप्रत्वं शूद्रस्यापि प्रजा यते .. 5 ..
16.335.m: By bathing there, O goddess, a man is freed from the murder of a brahmin. / Even for a śūdra, the status of a brahmin is produced for seven births.

16.335.s:
pūrvaṃ tatraiva gatvā ca tato rudragayāṃ vrajet ..
godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 6 ..
16.335.d:
पूर्वं तत्रैव गत्वा च ततो रुद्रगयां व्रजेत् ..
गोदानं तत्र देयं तु सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 6 ..
16.335.m: Having gone there first, one should then proceed to Rudragayā. / A gift of a cow must be given there by those who desire the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.335.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkhāvarttatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśaduttaratriśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 335 ..
16.335.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शंखावर्त्ततीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चत्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशत तमोऽध्यायः .. 335 ..
16.335.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirty-fifth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Śaṅkhāvartatīrtha,” in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
